items.title: 一張定期人壽保單保障到受保人 75 歲，每年交保費而且保費唔會遞減，冇可以提取或借貸嘅保單價值，退保最多退返已交保費減費用，亦冇轉讓俾有償受讓人。佢係咪 excluded account？
items.short: 係，符合 ¶3 定期壽險條件
items.detail: 保障期要喺受保人 90 歲前結束；四個條件要全部符合。

quotes.text: A life insurance contract with a coverage period that will end before the insured individual attains age 90 is an excluded account if all of the following conditions are met -
periodic premiums, which do not decrease over time, are payable at least annually during the period the contract is in existence or until the insured attains age 90, whichever is shorter;
the contract has no contract value that any person can access (by withdrawal, loan, or otherwise) without terminating the contract;
the contract is not held by a transferee for value.

options: 要睇受保人係咪香港居民
係：符合 Ch.6 ¶3 定期壽險合約嘅全部條件
唔係：所有壽險都要申報
option_explains: ¶3 定期壽險合約可以係 excluded account。
items.explain:
保障期要喺受保人 90 歲前結束；四個條件要全部符合。
✗ A：¶3 冇呢個條件。
✓ B：Ch.6 ¶3。
✗ C：¶3 定期壽險合約可以係 excluded account。

items.title: 揾錯處：「呢張定期壽險保障到受保人 95 歲，冇現金價值，所以都可以當 excluded 嘅定期壽險合約。」
items.short: 保障期要喺 90 歲前結束

quotes.text: A life insurance contract with a coverage period that will end before the insured individual attains age 90 is an excluded account if all of the following conditions are met -

options: 錯：定期壽險合約嘅保障期要喺受保人 90 歲之前結束
錯：保障期要喺 65 歲前結束
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.6 ¶3 引言。
✗ B：保障期條件都要符合。
✗ C：條文講 90 歲。

items.title: 揾錯處：「保單持有人將定期壽險保單有償轉讓俾第三方，但保單其他條件冇變，所以仍然係 excluded account。」
items.short: 有償受讓人持有就唔符合

quotes.text: the contract is not held by a transferee for value.

options: 錯：轉讓後保險公司要即時取消保單
錯：由有償受讓人（transferee for value）持有嘅合約唔符合 ¶3(d)
option_explains: ¶3(d) 明確排除有償受讓人持有嘅合約。
items.explain:
✗ A：¶3(d) 明確排除有償受讓人持有嘅合約。
✗ B：Guidance 冇咁講。
✓ C：Ch.6 ¶3(d)。

items.title: 定期壽險要當 excluded account，退保或終止時（身故賠償以外）可以付幾多？
items.short: 唔超過已付保費（減收費等）
items.detail: 另外合約唔可以有任何人可以喺唔終止合約下提取或借貸嘅價值（¶3(b)）。

quotes.text: the amount (other than a death benefit) payable on cancellation or termination of the contract cannot exceed the aggregate premiums paid for the contract
the contract has no contract value that any person can access (by withdrawal, loan, or otherwise) without terminating the contract;

options: 唔可以超過已付保費總額，減去死亡率、發病率同費用收費等
items.explain:
另外合約唔可以有任何人可以喺唔終止合約下提取或借貸嘅價值（¶3(b)）。
✗ A：¶3(c) 有上限。
✗ B：冇咁嘅規定。
✓ C：Ch.6 ¶3(c)。

items.title: 客戶過咗身，帳戶而家只由佢嘅遺產（estate）持有。要符合咩先可以當 excluded account？
items.short: 有遺囑副本或死亡證
items.detail: 帳戶要「solely」由遺產持有。

quotes.text: An account held solely by an estate is an excluded account if its documentation includes a copy of the deceased’s will or death certificate.

options: 帳戶文件包括死者遺囑副本或死亡證
option_explains: ¶4 嘅條件係遺囑或死亡證副本。
items.explain:
帳戶要「solely」由遺產持有。
✓ A：Ch.6 ¶4。
✗ B：¶4 嘅條件係遺囑或死亡證副本。
✗ C：¶4 冇結餘門檻。

items.title: 邊條適用？客戶買樓，喺銀行開咗個帳戶，只存放買樓訂金，用嚟保證買方付樓價，成交時款項（連利息）會撥歸買賣雙方。呢個帳戶可能屬邊類 excluded account？
items.short: 託管帳戶（¶5(b)）
items.detail: ¶5(b) 要同時符合 (i)–(v) 五個條件，包括唔係孖展帳戶。

quotes.text: the account is funded solely with a down payment, earnest money, deposit in an amount appropriate to secure an obligation directly related to the transaction, or a similar payment
the account is established and used solely to secure the obligation of the purchaser to pay the purchase price for the property

option_explains: 同物業買賣有關、只存訂金嘅帳戶。
休眠帳戶係睇交易同溝通紀錄。
遺產帳戶係由死者遺產持有。
items.explain:
¶5(b) 要同時符合 (i)–(v) 五個條件，包括唔係孖展帳戶。
✓ A：同物業買賣有關、只存訂金嘅帳戶。
✗ B：休眠帳戶係睇交易同溝通紀錄。
✗ C：遺產帳戶係由死者遺產持有。

items.title: 揾錯處：「證券行嘅孖展帳戶都係為咗保證買賣交易嘅責任而設，所以可以當 ¶5(b) 託管帳戶 excluded。」
items.short: 孖展帳戶唔係託管帳戶

quotes.text: the account is not a margin or similar account established in connection with a sale or exchange of a financial asset; and

options: 錯：只有銀行先可以開託管帳戶
錯：¶5(b)(iv) 要求帳戶唔係就金融資產買賣而設嘅孖展或類似帳戶
items.explain:
✗ A：¶5(b)(iv) 明確排除孖展帳戶。
✗ B：Guidance 冇咁講。
✓ C：Ch.6 ¶5(b)(iv)。

items.title: 以下邊個帳戶屬 Ch.6 ¶5 嘅 excluded 託管帳戶？
items.short: 按揭機構預留稅項／保險款
items.detail: ¶5 其他類別：法院命令或判決（a）、物業買賣或租賃（b）、FI 為日後繳稅而設（d）。

quotes.text: an obligation of a financial institution servicing a loan secured by real property to set aside a portion of a payment solely to facilitate the payment of taxes or insurance related to the real property at a later time;
a court order or judgment;

options: 客戶自己開嚟儲錢交稅嘅普通儲蓄戶口
按揭貸款機構為日後繳交物業稅項或保險而預留部分供款嘅帳戶
option_explains: ¶5 講嘅係 FI 本身嘅責任或特定交易，唔係一般儲蓄。
items.explain:
¶5 其他類別：法院命令或判決（a）、物業買賣或租賃（b）、FI 為日後繳稅而設（d）。
✗ A：¶5 講嘅係 FI 本身嘅責任或特定交易，唔係一般儲蓄。
✗ B：¶5(b)(iv) 排除孖展帳戶。
✓ C：Ch.6 ¶5(c)。

items.title: 一間律師行喺銀行開咗個 pooled 客戶帳戶，帳上只列律師行名，而律師行唔需要為 AML/KYC 向銀行披露背後客戶。帳戶唔符合託管帳戶條件。銀行要對邊個做盡職審查？
items.short: 只對律師行做
items.detail: 兩個條件：(a) 帳上只列中介；(b) 中介唔需要為 AML/KYC 等規定披露背後客戶資料。

quotes.text: the only person listed or identified on the financial account with the financial institution is the non-financial intermediary; and
then, providing both these conditions are met, the financial institution is only required to undertake the due diligence procedures in respect of the non-financial intermediary.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 只需要對律師行（非金融中介）做
option_explains: 唔係 excluded，只係盡職審查對象係中介。
Ch.6 ¶5 尾段：兩個條件都符合時，只需要對該中介做盡職審查。
兩個條件都符合時，Guidance 話只需要對中介做。
items.explain:
兩個條件：(a) 帳上只列中介；(b) 中介唔需要為 AML/KYC 等規定披露背後客戶資料。
✗ A：唔係 excluded，只係盡職審查對象係中介。
✓ B：Ch.6 ¶5 尾段：兩個條件都符合時，只需要對該中介做盡職審查。
✗ C：兩個條件都符合時，Guidance 話只需要對中介做。

items.title: 信用卡客戶多繳款項而形成存款帳戶。FI 要有咩政策，呢類帳戶先可以當 excluded？
items.short: 防止多繳逾 $390,000 或 60 日內退
items.detail: 帳戶要純粹因為多繳信用卡或其他循環信貸而存在，而多繳款冇即時退還（¶6(a)）。

quotes.text: implements policies and procedures either to prevent a customer from making an overpayment in excess of $390,000, or to ensure that any customer overpayment in excess of $390,000 is refunded to the customer within 60 days

the account exists solely because a customer makes a payment in excess of a balance due with respect to a credit card or other revolving credit facility and the overpayment is not immediately returned to the customer; and

options: 唔使政策，信用卡多繳一律 excluded
防止客戶多繳超過 $390,000，或者確保超過 $390,000 嘅多繳款喺 60 日內退還
items.explain:
帳戶要純粹因為多繳信用卡或其他循環信貸而存在，而多繳款冇即時退還（¶6(a)）。
✗ A：¶6(b) 冇要求即日退還。
✗ B：¶6(b) 要求有政策同程序。
✓ C：Ch.6 ¶6(b)。

items.title: 揾錯處：程序手冊寫「因爭議收費而產生嘅信用卡貸方結餘算 customer overpayment；因退貨產生嘅貸方結餘就唔算。」
items.short: 調轉咗：退貨算，爭議收費唔算

quotes.text: a customer overpayment does not refer to credit balances to the extent of disputed charges but includes credit balances resulting from merchandise returns.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：調轉咗；customer overpayment 唔包括爭議收費部分，但包括退貨產生嘅貸方結餘
option_explains: 退貨產生嘅貸方結餘算。
items.explain:
✗ A：退貨產生嘅貸方結餘算。
✓ B：Ch.6 ¶6 尾段。
✗ C：Guidance 講法相反。

items.title: 客戶個存款帳戶結餘 $5,000，佢 4 年冇喺呢間 RFI 任何帳戶做過交易，7 年冇就任何帳戶聯絡過 RFI。按 IRD Guidance，呢個帳戶係咪 excluded account？
items.short: 係，休眠帳戶
items.detail: 睇嘅係客戶喺該 RFI 嘅任何帳戶，唔只係呢個帳戶。

quotes.text: An account (other than an annuity contract) with a balance that does not exceed $7,800 is an excluded account if (a) the account holder has not initiated a transaction with regard to the account or any other account held by the account holder with a reporting financial institution in the previous 3 years

(b) the account holder has not communicated with the reporting financial institution regarding the account or any other account held by the account holder with the reporting financial institution in the previous 6 years

options: 唔係：休眠帳戶都要申報
係：符合休眠帳戶（dormant account）條件
option_explains: ¶7 將符合條件嘅休眠帳戶列為 excluded。
items.explain:
睇嘅係客戶喺該 RFI 嘅任何帳戶，唔只係呢個帳戶。
✗ A：¶7 將符合條件嘅休眠帳戶列為 excluded。
✗ B：門檻係 $7,800。
✓ C：Ch.6 ¶7(1)：結餘 ≤ $7,800、3 年冇交易、6 年冇聯絡。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶張年金合約價值得 $3,000，佢十年冇聯絡過我哋，所以屬休眠帳戶，可以 excluded。」
items.short: 年金合約唔適用休眠規則

quotes.text: An account (other than an annuity contract) with a balance that does not exceed $7,800 is an excluded account if (a) the account holder has not initiated a transaction with regard to the account or any other account held by the account holder with a reporting financial institution in the previous 3 years

options: 錯：休眠帳戶規則唔適用於年金合約（annuity contract）
items.explain:
✗ A：門檻係 $7,800。
✓ B：Ch.6 ¶7(1)「other than an annuity contract」。
✗ C：年金合約被明確排除。

items.title: 邊條適用？一張現金價值保單價值 $6,000，客戶 5 年冇交易、8 年冇聯絡保險公司，但保險公司 2 年前曾經就保單寫信聯絡客戶。邊個條件令佢唔可以當休眠 excluded account？
items.short: ¶7(1)(c) RFI 6 年內聯絡過
items.detail: (c) 只適用於現金價值保險合約。

quotes.text: (c) (for the account being a cash value insurance contract) the reporting financial institution has not communicated with the account holder regarding the account or any other account held by the account holder with the reporting financial institution in the previous 6 years

An account (other than an annuity contract) with a balance that does not exceed $7,800 is an excluded account if (a) the account holder has not initiated a transaction with regard to the account or any other account held by the account holder with a reporting financial institution in the previous 3 years

(b) the account holder has not communicated with the reporting financial institution regarding the account or any other account held by the account holder with the reporting financial institution in the previous 6 years

options: ¶7(1)(c)：現金價值保單要 RFI 過去 6 年都冇就帳戶聯絡過持有人
items.explain:
(c) 只適用於現金價值保險合約。
✓ A：Ch.6 ¶7(1)(c)。
✗ B：5 年冇交易，符合 (a)。
✗ C：8 年冇聯絡，符合 (b)。

items.title: 一個休眠 excluded 帳戶嘅客戶今日打嚟問佢另一個帳戶嘅結餘。呢個休眠帳戶會點？
items.short: 唔再係休眠帳戶
items.detail: 其他終止事件：客戶喺任何帳戶發起交易，或按 FI 正常運作程序唔再當休眠。

quotes.text: (b) the account holder communicates with the financial institution about the dormant account or any other account he or she holds with it;

An account ceases to be dormant on the earliest of any of the following events occurring: (a) the account holder initiates a transaction on the dormant account or any other account he or she holds with the financial institution;

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 要等滿 3 年先重新評估
即時唔再係休眠帳戶：客戶就佢喺該 FI 嘅任何帳戶同 FI 溝通
冇影響，因為佢問嘅係另一個帳戶
option_explains: 註 1 講最早發生嘅事件就終止休眠。
註 1 講明包括其他帳戶。
items.explain:
其他終止事件：客戶喺任何帳戶發起交易，或按 FI 正常運作程序唔再當休眠。
✗ A：註 1 講最早發生嘅事件就終止休眠。
✓ B：Ch.6 ¶7 註 1(b)。
✗ C：註 1 講明包括其他帳戶。

items.title: Ch.6 ¶7(2)：結餘 ≤ $7,800 嘅帳戶，如果按 FI 自己嘅正常運作程序當休眠帳戶，要符合咩先可以 excluded？
items.short: 一致適用＋同 ¶7(1) 實質相若

quotes.text: under the normal operating procedures of the financial institution that are consistently applied for all accounts maintained with such institution;

options: 要 IRD 預先批准程序
程序要一致適用於 FI 維持嘅所有帳戶，而相關法規或程序內容同 ¶7(1) 實質相若
option_explains: 要一致適用而且實質相若。
items.explain:
✗ A：要一致適用而且實質相若。
✗ B：Guidance 冇咁講。
✓ C：Ch.6 ¶7(2)。

items.title: 點解 Sch 17C Part 3 將某啲帳戶列為 excluded accounts？
items.short: 逃稅風險低

quotes.text: These accounts are excluded because they have been identified as carrying a low risk of use for tax evasion.
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.6 引言（p.6-1）

options: 因為佢哋唔受 AML/KYC 規管
因為佢哋被認定為用嚟逃稅嘅風險低
option_explains: 唔係所有類別都睇結餘。
items.explain:
✗ A：唔係所有類別都睇結餘。
✗ B：冇咁講。
✓ C：Ch.6 引言。

items.title: 幾時算 RFI「有理由知道」（reason to know）self-cert 唔可靠或唔正確？
items.short: 合理審慎嘅人會知道
items.detail: 包括客戶經理（relationship manager）對客戶嘅認識同 self-cert 有衝突（¶1）。

quotes.text: if, based on the relevant facts, a reasonably prudent person would know this to be the case.
including knowledge about the customer held by a relationship manager, conflicts with any statements or self-certification

options: 只有 IRD 通知先算
按相關事實，一個合理審慎嘅人會知道
只有客戶自己承認錯先算
items.explain:
包括客戶經理（relationship manager）對客戶嘅認識同 self-cert 有衝突（¶1）。
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ch.14 ¶2。
✗ C：標準係合理審慎嘅人。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶經理知道客戶其實住喺 A 國，但 self-cert 寫香港。合規部話：『self-cert 簽咗名就可以照用，客戶經理知道嘅嘢唔計。』」
items.short: 客戶經理知道嘅都計

quotes.text: including knowledge about the customer held by a relationship manager, conflicts with any statements or self-certification

options: 錯：FI 持有嘅資料（包括客戶經理嘅認識）同 self-cert 有衝突時，唔可以依賴該 self-cert
items.explain:
✗ A：Guidance 冇咁講。
✓ B：Ch.14 ¶1。
✗ C：有衝突就唔可以依賴。

items.title: RFI 想確認一個實體帳戶持有人達到某個收入或資產門檻。一定要用審計財務報表嗎？
items.short: 可以用，但唔係必須

quotes.text: Reporting financial institutions may rely upon an audited financial statement to establish that an account holder meets a certain income or asset threshold, but are not obliged to where the entity’s status can be established from other information or documentation that it holds.

options: 可以用，但如果用其他資料或文件已經可以確立實體身份，就唔一定要用
一定要用審計財務報表
items.explain:
✗ A：¶3 講明可以依賴。

✗ C：¶3 講明唔係必須。

items.title: RFI 用審計財務報表確立實體身份。佢幾時先算有理由知道該身份唔可靠？

quotes.text: it has reason to know that the status claimed is unreliable or incorrect only if the audited financial statement for the account holder or the notes or footnotes to the financial statement conflicts with the self-certification provided to it.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 只有當財務報表或其附註同 self-cert 有衝突時
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.14 ¶4。
✗ B：唔係。
✗ C：有衝突就有理由知道。

items.title: RFI 用組織章程文件確立帳戶持有人嘅某個身份。要睇幾多？
items.short: 睇到足夠確立身份就得

quotes.text: it will only be required to review the documents to the extent needed to establish that the requirements applicable to the particular status are met.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 唔使睇，有 self-cert 就得

要逐頁審閱所有章程文件

✗ C：¶6 講只需要睇到足夠。

items.title: 邊條適用？Pre-existing 實體帳戶：RFI 判斷有冇理由知道實體身份唔可靠時，以下邊份資料唔喺 Ch.14 ¶7 要求覆核嘅範圍？
items.short: 舊市場問卷唔喺範圍

the most recent documentation obtained for AML/KYC procedures or for other regulatory purposes.
