options: 最近期為 AML/KYC 取得嘅文件
現時客戶主檔（customer master file）
十年前市場部做嘅客戶問卷調查
option_explains: ¶7 只列：最近 self-cert 同文件證據、現時客戶主檔、最近開戶合約、最近 AML/KYC 或其他規管文件。
items.explain:
✗ A：¶7(d) 有列出。
✗ B：¶7(b) 有列出。
✓ C：¶7 只列：最近 self-cert 同文件證據、現時客戶主檔、最近開戶合約、最近 AML/KYC 或其他規管文件。

items.title: 同一客戶喺 RFI 有兩個帳戶。B 帳戶資料顯示佢喺 A 帳戶聲稱嘅身份唔啱。RFI 幾時先算有理由知道？
items.short: 要合併或有其他 reason to know

quotes.text: only to the extent that the accounts are either required to be aggregated or because of any other “reason to know”; for example, knowledge of a relationship manager.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 永遠唔算，因為係另一個帳戶
只有當兩個帳戶需要合併，或者有其他 reason to know（例如客戶經理知道）
option_explains: 要合併或有其他 reason to know 時就算。
items.explain:
✗ A：要合併或有其他 reason to know 時就算。
✓ B：Ch.14 ¶8。
✗ C：¶8 有限制。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶已用 A 國住址文件證據確立係 A 國居民。五年後佢授權住喺 B 國嘅妹妹操作帳戶，所以我哋有理由知道之前嘅文件證據唔可靠，要重新審查。」
items.short: 單憑授權書唔構成 reason to know

quotes.text: The fact that A has provided such power of attorney is not sufficient by itself to give Bank-HK reason to know that the documentary evidence relied upon to treat A as a resident of Jurisdiction X is unreliable or incorrect.
currently effective power of attorney or signatory authority granted to a person with an address in a reportable jurisdiction.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 錯：單憑授權書本身唔足以構成 reason to know
冇錯，授權書係 indicium 一定要重做
錯：要即刻申報 B 國
option_explains: ¶10 講單憑呢類 indicia 唔構成 reason to know。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.14 ¶10(c)、¶11(a) 例 1。
✗ B：¶10 講單憑呢類 indicia 唔構成 reason to know。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: 保險公司兩年前憑 self-cert 確認客戶係 A 國居民。今日客戶第一次俾咗個 B 國電話號碼。單憑呢點，算唔算 reason to know self-cert 唔正確？
items.short: 唔算
items.detail: ¶10 列明：申報稅區電話（冇香港電話）、長期轉帳指示（存款帳戶除外）、授權書，單憑呢啲同 self-cert 衝突唔構成 reason to know。

quotes.text: the sole receipt of a telephone number in Jurisdiction Y does not in itself constitute a reason to know that the original self-certification is unreliable or incorrect.

does not know or have reason to know that a self-certification or documentary evidence is unreliable or incorrect solely because it discovers any of the following indicia and such indicia conflicts with the selfcertification or documentary evidence:
one or more telephone numbers in a reportable jurisdiction and no telephone number in Hong Kong; or

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 算，要即時當 B 國居民
唔算：單憑收到 B 國電話號碼本身唔構成 reason to know
items.explain:
¶10 列明：申報稅區電話（冇香港電話）、長期轉帳指示（存款帳戶除外）、授權書，單憑呢啲同 self-cert 衝突唔構成 reason to know。
✗ A：單一電話號碼唔足夠。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：Ch.14 ¶11(b) 例 2。

items.title: 以下邊項，即使同 self-cert 有衝突，單憑佢本身都唔構成 reason to know（Ch.14 ¶10）？
items.short: 長期轉帳指示

quotes.text: does not know or have reason to know that a self-certification or documentary evidence is unreliable or incorrect solely because it discovers any of the following indicia and such indicia conflicts with the selfcertification or documentary evidence:
standing instructions (other than with respect to a depository account) to transfer funds to an account maintained in a reportable jurisdiction; or
including knowledge about the customer held by a relationship manager, conflicts with any statements or self-certification

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 審計財務報表附註同 self-cert 有衝突
定期指示將資金轉去申報稅區嘅帳戶（存款帳戶以外）
客戶經理知道客戶其實係 A 國居民
option_explains: 客戶經理嘅認識可以構成 reason to know（¶1）。
items.explain:
✗ A：¶4：呢種情況有 reason to know。
✓ B：Ch.14 ¶10(b)。
✗ C：客戶經理嘅認識可以構成 reason to know（¶1）。

items.title: 現金價值保單持有人過身，身故賠償付俾受益人（唔係保單持有人）。RFI 可唔可以當受益人係 non-reportable person？
items.short: 可以，除非知道或有理由知道
items.detail: 受益人資料有 Ch.9 ¶30 嘅 indicia 就有理由知道。

quotes.text: A reporting financial institution can treat an individual beneficiary (other than the owner) who receives a death benefit under a cash value insurance contract or an annuity contract as a non-reportable person unless the reporting financial institution has knowledge or reason to know that the beneficiary is in fact a reportable person.

options: 唔可以，一定要先攞受益人 self-cert
可以，除非 RFI 知道或有理由知道受益人其實係 reportable person
items.explain:
受益人資料有 Ch.9 ¶30 嘅 indicia 就有理由知道。
✗ A：¶12 容許另類程序。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：Ch.14 ¶12。

items.title: 邊條適用？僱主團體現金價值保單覆蓋 30 名僱員，僱員可以攞保單價值同指定受益人，每人應付總額唔超過 $7.8 million。RFI 可以點處理？
items.short: 應付前當 non-reportable
items.detail: 條件：發俾僱主、覆蓋 25 名或以上僱員；僱員有權收保單價值同指定受益人；每人應付總額 ≤ $7.8 million。

quotes.text: as a non-reportable account until the date on which an amount is payable to an employee/certificate holder or beneficiary.
the group cash value insurance contract or group annuity contract is issued to an employer and covers twenty-five or more employees/certificate holders;
the aggregate amount payable to any employee/certificate holder or beneficiary does not exceed $7.8 million.

options: 即時當每位僱員係 reportable person 申報
當 excluded account 永遠唔使理
喺應付款項俾僱員或受益人之前，當 non-reportable account（Ch.14 ¶13、¶15）
option_explains: 符合條件可以暫時當 non-reportable。
只係到應付款項嗰日為止。
items.explain:
條件：發俾僱主、覆蓋 25 名或以上僱員；僱員有權收保單價值同指定受益人；每人應付總額 ≤ $7.8 million。
✗ A：符合條件可以暫時當 non-reportable。
✗ B：只係到應付款項嗰日為止。
✓ C：團體合約另類程序。

items.title: 揾錯處：「呢份團體年金合約只覆蓋 12 名僱員，但都可以用團體合約另類程序，等到應付款項先處理。」
items.short: 要 25 名或以上僱員

quotes.text: the group cash value insurance contract or group annuity contract is issued to an employer and covers twenty-five or more employees/certificate holders;

options: 錯：團體合約要覆蓋 25 名或以上僱員／證書持有人
items.explain:
✗ A：條文講 25 名。
✓ B：Ch.14 ¶15(a)。
✗ C：要 25 名或以上。

items.title: 兩位合夥人用合夥（partnership）名義開帳戶。做盡職審查時當個人帳戶定實體帳戶？
items.short: 實體帳戶

quotes.text: An account held by one or more individuals as a partner(s) of a partnership is treated as an entity account and is not treated as an individual account.

options: 個人帳戶，因為持有人係個人
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.14 ¶17。
✗ B：¶17 講明唔當個人帳戶。
✗ C：當實體帳戶。

items.title: RFI 要合併同一客戶喺佢同 related entity 嘅帳戶計門檻，但係有咩限制？
items.short: 限系統有連繫並可合併結餘
items.detail: 客戶經理規則（¶20）係額外要求。

quotes.text: but only to the extent that the reporting financial institution’s computerized systems link the financial accounts by reference to a data element such as client number or TIN, and allow account balances or values to be aggregated.

options: 冇限制，要人手搵晒所有帳戶
只合併同一分行嘅帳戶
只限電腦系統用客戶編號或 TIN 等資料元素連繫帳戶，並容許合併結餘嘅情況
items.explain:
客戶經理規則（¶20）係額外要求。
✗ A：¶18 有限制。
✗ B：唔係按分行。
✓ C：Ch.14 ¶18。

items.title: Bank-HK：實體 E 有兩個 pre-existing 存款帳戶，結餘 $1.5 million 同 $1 million。系統用內部編號連繫兩個帳戶，可以電子合併結餘，但畫面冇顯示合計。兩個帳戶仲可唔可以用 $1.95 million 嘅豁免？
items.short: 唔可以，合計 $2.5m
items.detail: 如果系統冇連繫兩個帳戶（例 1），就唔使合併，兩個都可以用豁免。

quotes.text: The system shows the account balances for both accounts, and such balances may be electronically aggregated, though the system does not show a combined balance for the accounts.
Accordingly, neither account is eligible for the exemption, because the accounts, when aggregated, exceed the $1.95 million threshold.
As the accounts are not associated in Bank-HK’s system, Bank-HK is not required to aggregate the accounts to determine whether the accounts meet the de minimis threshold.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 可以：系統冇顯示合計就唔使合併
只有 $1.5 million 嗰個唔可以
唔可以：要合併計，合計 $2.5 million 超過 $1.95 million
option_explains: 只要可以電子合併就要合併。
合併後兩個都唔合資格。
items.explain:
如果系統冇連繫兩個帳戶（例 1），就唔使合併，兩個都可以用豁免。
✗ A：只要可以電子合併就要合併。
✗ B：合併後兩個都唔合資格。
✓ C：Ch.14 ¶21(a) 例 2。

items.title: H 喺 Bank-HK1 有 $5 million 託管帳戶，又同配偶 W 喺 Bank-HK2（related entity，共用系統並連繫帳戶）有 $5 million 聯名帳戶。邊個係 high value account？
items.short: H 兩個都係；W 係 low value
items.detail: 聯名帳戶每位持有人都要計晒全數結餘（¶19）。

quotes.text: Under those rules, H is treated as having financial accounts with Bank-HK1 and Bank-HK2, each with an aggregate balance of $10 million. Accordingly, both of H’s accounts are high value accounts. W is only treated as having a financial account with Bank-HK2 with a balance of $5 million. Thus, W’s account is a low value account.
Each joint holder of a financial account must be attributed the entire balance or value of the account for purposes of applying the aggregation requirements.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 只有聯名帳戶係 high value
H 兩個帳戶都係（各合計 $10 million）；W 嘅帳戶係 low value（$5 million）
items.explain:
聯名帳戶每位持有人都要計晒全數結餘（¶19）。
✗ A：H 兩個帳戶都係。
✓ B：Ch.14 ¶21(b) 例 3。
✗ C：H 合計 $10 million。

items.title: 揾錯處：「聯名帳戶結餘 $1.2 million 有兩位持有人，計合併門檻時每人只計一半 $600,000。」
items.short: 每人計全數

quotes.text: Each joint holder of a financial account must be attributed the entire balance or value of the account for purposes of applying the aggregation requirements.

options: 錯：計合併時每位聯名持有人都要歸屬帳戶全數結餘
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.14 ¶19。
✗ B：要計全數。
✗ C：每位都計全數。

items.title: 客戶 C 係 PNFE-1 同 PNFE-2 嘅 controlling person。C 嘅帳戶同 PNFE-1 嘅帳戶喺系統有連繫，PNFE-2 嘅帳戶冇；但三個帳戶都由同一客戶經理負責。判斷 C 嘅帳戶係咪 high value 時要合併邊啲？
items.short: 三個都要合併
items.detail: 客戶經理規則：合併客戶經理知道或有理由知道由該人直接或間接擁有、控制或設立（受信人身份除外）嘅帳戶（¶20）。

quotes.text: As the accounts are associated by a relationship manager, Bank-HK is required to aggregate the accounts held by PNFE-1, PNFE-2 and C to determine whether the account held by C is a high value account.

a reporting financial institution is also required to aggregate all accounts held by that person which a relationship manager knows, or has reason to know, are directly or indirectly owned, controlled, or established (other than in a fiduciary capacity) by that person.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 只合併 C 同 PNFE-1
option_explains: Ch.14 ¶22(b) 例 2：客戶經理連繫都要合併。
客戶經理知道嘅帳戶都要合併。
items.explain:
客戶經理規則：合併客戶經理知道或有理由知道由該人直接或間接擁有、控制或設立（受信人身份除外）嘅帳戶（¶20）。
✗ A：要合併。
✓ B：Ch.14 ¶22(b) 例 2：客戶經理連繫都要合併。
✗ C：客戶經理知道嘅帳戶都要合併。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶經理規則要求合併客戶以受信人（fiduciary）身份設立嘅帳戶。」
items.short: 受信人身份帳戶唔包括

quotes.text: a reporting financial institution is also required to aggregate all accounts held by that person which a relationship manager knows, or has reason to know, are directly or indirectly owned, controlled, or established (other than in a fiduciary capacity) by that person.

options: 錯：客戶經理規則只適用於實體帳戶
錯：客戶經理規則明確唔包括以受信人身份設立嘅帳戶
option_explains: 用於判斷 high value account。
Ch.14 ¶20「other than in a fiduciary capacity」。
items.explain:
✗ A：用於判斷 high value account。
✓ B：Ch.14 ¶20「other than in a fiduciary capacity」。
✗ C：受信人身份被排除。

items.title: 帳戶用美元計，門檻用港元。點樣比較？
items.short: 兩邊其中一邊換算

quotes.text: either the threshold limits must be converted into the currency in which the accounts are denominated before determining if they apply, or the balance shown in the accounts must be converted into Hong Kong dollars before applying the threshold limits.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 一定要用 IRD 指定嘅月均匯率
將門檻換算成帳戶貨幣，或者將帳戶結餘換算成港元，再比較
唔使換算，直接用數字比
option_explains: ¶24 講用 12 月 31 日公佈嘅即期匯率。
items.explain:
✗ A：¶24 講用 12 月 31 日公佈嘅即期匯率。
✓ B：Ch.14 ¶23。
✗ C：要換算。

items.title: 邊條適用？計外幣帳戶門檻時，用邊日嘅匯率？
items.short: 12 月 31 日即期匯率（保險用估值日）

quotes.text: This should be done using a published spot rate for 31 December of the year being reported or in the case of an insurance contract or annuity contract, the date of the most recent contract valuation.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 申報年度 12 月 31 日公佈嘅即期匯率；保險或年金合約用最近一次合約估值日

items.title: 揾錯處：「年中已經結束嘅外幣帳戶，都係用 12 月 31 日嘅即期匯率換算港元。」
items.short: 用結束當日匯率

quotes.text: In the case of closed accounts, the spot rate to be used is the rate on the date the account was closed.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：已結束帳戶用結束當日嘅即期匯率
option_explains: 已結束帳戶有特別規則。
items.explain:
✗ A：用結束當日。
✓ B：Ch.14 ¶25。
✗ C：已結束帳戶有特別規則。

items.title: 香港用「wider approach」。對 pre-existing 帳戶持有人嘅稅務居民地，IRD Guidance 期望 RFI 點做？
items.short: 識別所有持有人嘅居民地
items.detail: 稅區之後成為申報稅區時，RFI 要聯絡相關持有人補攞 TIN、出生日期等資料。

quotes.text: Under the wider approach, usually reporting financial institutions should have identified the territory of tax residence of all pre-existing account holders even if they were not subject to reporting at that moment.

Therefore, when a jurisdiction becomes a reportable jurisdiction subsequently, the reporting financial institutions have to contact relevant account holders to acquire other required information needed for reporting purposes, for example TIN or date of birth, if the information is not available.

options: 就算當時唔使申報，都應該已經識別所有持有人嘅稅務居民地
只識別當時申報稅區嘅居民
等稅區成為申報稅區先識別
items.explain:
稅區之後成為申報稅區時，RFI 要聯絡相關持有人補攞 TIN、出生日期等資料。
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶3。
✗ B：Wider approach 要識別所有。
✗ C：應該一早識別。

items.title: 一個稅區今年先成為香港嘅申報稅區。RFI 早已識別部分客戶係該稅區居民，但紀錄冇佢哋 TIN。點做？
items.short: 聯絡客戶補攞 TIN 等

quotes.text: Therefore, when a jurisdiction becomes a reportable jurisdiction subsequently, the reporting financial institutions have to contact relevant account holders to acquire other required information needed for reporting purposes, for example TIN or date of birth, if the information is not available.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 聯絡相關持有人取得 TIN、出生日期等申報所需資料
唔使理，pre-existing 帳戶唔使報
option_explains: 稅區成為申報稅區後就要報。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶3。
✗ B：稅區成為申報稅區後就要報。
✗ C：RFI 要主動聯絡。

items.title: 邊條適用？保險公司從未取得 A 國所需牌照，按 A 國法例唔可以向 A 國居民賣現金價值保單。佢嘅 pre-existing 個人現金價值保單點處理（就 A 國而言）？
items.short: 被法律有效禁止，唔使覆核

quotes.text: A pre-existing individual account that is a cash value insurance contract or an annuity contract is not required to be reviewed, identified or reported, if the reporting financial institution is effectively prevented by law from selling the contract to residents for tax purposes of a reportable jurisdiction.

a reporting financial institution that has not fulfilled the required conditions under the applicable law is considered to be “effectively prevented by law” from selling such contracts to residents of such reportable jurisdiction.

options: 屬「effectively prevented by law」，唔使覆核、識別或申報（Ch.9 ¶4、¶6）
option_explains: 未符合法定條件就當被法律有效禁止。
items.explain:
✗ A：¶4 容許唔使覆核。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：未符合法定條件就當被法律有效禁止。

items.title: Low value pre-existing 個人帳戶用住址測試，但測試判斷唔到居民地。下一步係？
items.short: 再做電子搜尋
items.detail: RFI 亦可以一開始就直接做電子搜尋（¶10）。

quotes.text: In the event that the reporting financial institution applies the residence address test but this does not determine the jurisdiction of residence of the individual account holder, then it must also apply the electronic record search.
Reporting financial institutions may also opt to go straight to an electronic record search for indicia of tax residence without first applying the residence address test.

items.explain:
RFI 亦可以一開始就直接做電子搜尋（¶10）。
✗ A：先做電子搜尋。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶8。
✗ C：要繼續做電子搜尋。

items.title: 揾錯處：「住址測試一係用喺全部 low value 帳戶，一係唔用，唔可以只揀某條業務線用。」
items.short: 可以按清楚識別嘅組別用

quotes.text: Reporting financial institutions can apply the residence address test to all low value accounts or, separately, to any clearly identified group of such accounts.

options: 錯：住址測試只適用 high value 帳戶
錯：可以用喺全部 low value 帳戶，或分開用喺任何清楚識別嘅一組帳戶（例如某業務線或某地點）
option_explains: 相反，high value 唔可以用住址測試。
items.explain:
✗ A：相反，high value 唔可以用住址測試。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶9。
✗ C：¶9 容許分組。

items.title: 住址測試：RFI 要符合咩先可以按紀錄入面嘅住址判斷居民地？
items.short: 有住址、現時、基於文件證據

quotes.text: the residence address held is current; and
the residence address is based on documentary evidence.

options: 紀錄有住址、住址係現時嘅，而且係基於文件證據
option_explains: 要住址，而且要現時同有文件證據。
items.explain:
✗ A：要住址，而且要現時同有文件證據。
✗ B：要文件證據。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶13。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶紀錄只有一個郵政信箱（PO Box），我哋可以當佢係住址做住址測試。」
items.short: PO Box 一般唔係住址

quotes.text: In general, an “in-care-of” address or a post office box is not a residence address. However, a post office box can be part of a residence address where the address also contains a street, an apartment or suite number, or a rural route and thus clearly identifies the actual residence of the account holder.

options: 錯：PO Box 一定要當 indicium 申報
錯：PO Box 一般唔係住址，除非地址同時有街道、單位號碼等，清楚識別實際居所
option_explains: PO Box 一般唔係住址。
items.explain:
✗ A：PO Box 一般唔係住址。
✗ B：問題係住址測試。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶15。

items.title: 「in-care-of」地址一般唔可以用作住址。Guidance 講咗邊種例外？
items.short: 軍人嘅標準軍事基地地址
items.detail: 另一例外：清楚識別住址屬護理或安老院舍，前提係唔會妨礙 CRS 目的。

quotes.text: Exceptionally, an “in-care-of” address may be relied on where it is clear that the account holder is military personnel and the “in-care-of” address is a standard address of the type used for individuals residing on military bases.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 客戶明顯係軍人，而地址係軍事基地人員常用嘅標準地址
items.explain:
另一例外：清楚識別住址屬護理或安老院舍，前提係唔會妨礙 CRS 目的。
✗ A：冇呢個例外。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶16。
✗ C：冇呢個例外。

items.title: 寄去客戶住址嘅信被退回「地址不符」（唔係寄錯）。呢個住址仲算唔算「現時」？
items.short: 唔算現時
items.detail: 例外：帳戶（年金合約除外）屬休眠帳戶時，退信都可以照當現時（¶18）。

quotes.text: Such an address is not regarded as current if it has been used for mailing purposes and mail has been returned undeliverable-as-addressed other than due to an error.
A residence address associated with an account (other than an annuity contract) may be considered current even though mail has been returned undeliverableas-addressed and the account is dormant.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 唔算：曾用作郵寄而被退回（非因錯誤）就唔當現時地址
算，只要客戶冇通知改地址
items.explain:
例外：帳戶（年金合約除外）屬休眠帳戶時，退信都可以照當現時（¶18）。
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶17。
✗ B：¶17 有例外。
✗ C：退回郵件就唔算。

items.title: 住址測試要求住址基於文件證據。以下邊份公用事業文件 Guidance 冇列為可接受？
items.short: 手提電話單唔接受
items.detail: 可接受嘅公用事業文件係同特定物業相連嘅供應：水、電、固網電話、煤氣、油。

quotes.text: Acceptable documentation issued by utility companies relates to supplies linked to a particular property and includes a bill for water, electricity, telephone (landline only), gas, or oil.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
option_explains: ¶20 列明電話只限固網（landline only）。
items.explain:
可接受嘅公用事業文件係同特定物業相連嘅供應：水、電、固網電話、煤氣、油。
✗ A：有列出。
✓ B：¶20 列明電話只限固網（landline only）。
✗ C：有列出。

items.title: 客戶喺 pre-existing 帳戶簽過一份「聲明（under penalty of perjury）」，寫有住址。要符合咩先可以用嚟支持住址測試？
items.short: 三個條件：法定收集、有住址、簽署日期

quotes.text: A declaration of the individual account holder under penalty of perjury is acceptable only if: (a) the reporting financial institution has been required to collect it under the laws of Hong Kong for a number of years; (b) it contains the account holder’s residence address; and (c) it is dated and signed by the individual account holder under penalty of perjury.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: RFI 按香港法例多年來都要收集呢類聲明；聲明有住址；並由客戶簽署及註明日期
items.explain:
✗ A：Guidance 冇咁講。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶20。
✗ C：有三個條件。

items.title: 邊條適用？RFI 嘅程序確保紀錄住址所在稅區同政府發出文件證據（例如護照）嘅簽發稅區一致。呢個安排滿足住址測試邊個要求？
items.short: ¶13(c) 基於文件證據

quotes.text: Alternatively, a reporting financial institution can meet the requirement in paragraph 13(c) if its policies and procedures ensure that the jurisdiction in the residence address corresponds to the jurisdiction of issuance of government-issued documentary evidence.
the residence address is based on documentary evidence.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
option_explains: 呢個係住址測試，唔係電子搜尋。
「現時」要睇最近紀錄同有冇退信。
items.explain:
✗ A：呢個係住址測試，唔係電子搜尋。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶20 尾段。
✗ C：「現時」要睇最近紀錄同有冇退信。

items.title: RFI 為 AML/KYC 收集嘅文件證明咗客戶住址（符合 ¶20 條件）。做住址測試時可唔可以依賴？
items.short: 可以

quotes.text: including those obtained through AML/KYC procedures, the reporting financial institution may rely on that address when applying the residence address test.

options: 唔可以，AML/KYC 文件唔可以用於 CRS
只可以用於 high value 帳戶
option_explains: High value 帳戶唔可以用住址測試。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶22。
✗ B：¶22 講明可以。
✗ C：High value 帳戶唔可以用住址測試。

items.title: Bank-HK 用住址測試當 A 係 X 國居民。A 通知已搬去 Y 國（亦係申報稅區），但 Bank-HK 攞唔到 self-cert。點做？
items.short: 做電子搜尋，最少當 Y 國居民
items.detail: 攞到 self-cert 同新文件證據確認係 Y 國居民，就當 Y 國居民（例 1）。

quotes.text: If the reporting financial institution cannot obtain the self-certification and new documentary evidence by such date, the reporting financial institution must apply the electronic record search procedure described in paragraphs 29 to 50 below.

Bank-HK must apply the electronic record search procedure described in paragraphs 29 to 50 below and, as a result, treat A as a resident of, at least, jurisdiction Y (based on the new address provided by A).

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 做電子紀錄搜尋，最少當 A 係 Y 國居民（根據新地址）
繼續當 X 國居民
items.explain:
攞到 self-cert 同新文件證據確認係 Y 國居民，就當 Y 國居民（例 1）。
✗ A：例子講做電子搜尋。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶27(b) 例 2。
✗ C：新地址係 indicium。

items.title: 電子搜尋：以下邊項係 indicium？
items.short: 申報稅區郵寄／住址（含 PO Box）

quotes.text: the current mailing or residence address (including a post office box) of the account holder is in a reportable jurisdiction;

options: 客戶有申報稅區駕駛執照但住址喺香港
現時郵寄或住址（包括 PO Box）喺申報稅區
items.explain:
✗ A：出生地唔係 CRS indicium。
✗ B：唔係 ¶29 嘅 indicium。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶29(b)。

items.title: Low value 帳戶電子搜尋冇發現任何 indicia。之後仲要做咩？
items.short: 暫時唔使，有變再做

quotes.text: If none of the above indicia are discovered through an electronic search, no further action is required in respect of low value accounts unless and until there is a subsequent change of circumstance that results in one or more of the above indicia being associated with the account or the account holder, or the account becomes a high value account.

options: 暫時唔使，直至有 change of circumstance 帶嚟 indicia，或帳戶變成 high value
option_explains: Low value 唔使每年重做。
items.explain:
✗ A：Low value 唔使每年重做。
✗ B：Low value 唔使。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶30。

items.title: 電子搜尋：客戶全部資料都指向香港居民，只有一個現時法國電話號碼。RFI 可以點？
items.short: 先攞 self-cert＋文件證據補正

quotes.text: For example, if the indicia, with the exception of a current telephone number in France, all point to the individual being resident in Hong Kong, the reporting financial institution can seek a self-certification with documentary evidence from the individual to confirm where he or she is resident for tax purposes before treating the account as belonging to a French reportable person.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 先向客戶攞 self-cert 連文件證據確認居民地，先至決定係咪當法國 reportable person
一定要當法國 reportable person
items.explain:
✗ A：要處理 indicium。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶31。
✗ C：可以先補正。

items.title: 揾錯處：「Low value 帳戶做完電子搜尋，但檔案室有份舊文件同結果有衝突，雖然電子搜尋程序唔需要睇嗰份文件，我哋都當有 reason to know。」
items.short: 唔需要覆核嘅資料唔構成 reason to know

quotes.text: A reporting financial institution is not treated as having reason to know that an account holder’s status is incorrect because it retains information or documentation that may conflict with its review of the account holder’s status if it was not necessary to review that information or those documents under the procedures for the electronic record search.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：要即時做客戶經理查詢
錯：電子搜尋程序唔需要覆核嘅資料，即使有衝突都唔構成 reason to know
items.explain:
✗ A：¶32 講相反。
✗ B：Low value 帳戶唔使。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶32。

items.title: 一個休眠帳戶嘅郵寄地址係舊地址，信件曾經退回。電子搜尋時呢個地址仲算唔算「現時」？
items.short: 休眠期間可以當現時

quotes.text: Where the account is a dormant account, the mailing or residence address attached to the account can be considered as “current” during the period of dormancy.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 算：休眠期間帳戶上嘅地址可以當現時
items.explain:
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶35。
✗ C：休眠帳戶有例外。

items.title: 電子搜尋發現客戶有兩個現時地址，分別喺 A 國同 B 國（都係申報稅區）。點處理？
items.short: 可能兩個稅區都要報
items.detail: 如果其中一個係客戶嘅服務提供者（資產管理人、投資顧問、律師）地址，唔使當居民 indicium。

quotes.text: Where the reporting financial institution has recorded two or more mailing or residence addresses in different reportable jurisdictions, the account holder and details of the account are potentially reportable to multiple jurisdictions.

However, where one or more of those addresses is for a service provider of the account holder, for example, an asset manager, investment advisor or lawyer, the reporting financial institution is not required to treat the service provider’s address as an indication of residence.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 可能要向兩個稅區申報
option_explains: CRS 唔用 tiebreaker 揀一個居民地。
items.explain:
如果其中一個係客戶嘅服務提供者（資產管理人、投資顧問、律師）地址，唔使當居民 indicium。
✗ A：CRS 唔用 tiebreaker 揀一個居民地。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶36。
✗ C：唔係揀一個。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶紀錄有佢律師喺 B 國嘅地址，所以 B 國地址係 indicium，一定要當 B 國 reportable。」
items.short: 服務提供者地址唔使當 indicium

quotes.text: However, where one or more of those addresses is for a service provider of the account holder, for example, an asset manager, investment advisor or lawyer, the reporting financial institution is not required to treat the service provider’s address as an indication of residence.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：服務提供者（例如律師、資產管理人、投資顧問）嘅地址唔使當居民 indicium
錯：律師地址要當 hold mail
option_explains: 服務提供者地址唔使當 indicium。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶36。
✗ B：服務提供者地址唔使當 indicium。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: 電子搜尋：客戶紀錄有一個舊嘅 A 國電話，但最新嘅電話係香港號碼。A 國電話要唔要當 indicium？
items.short: 只計現時電話

quotes.text: The telephone number(s) in a reportable jurisdiction is only required to be treated as an indicium of residence where that number is current, that is, it is the most recent telephone number(s) held by the reporting financial institution for that account holder.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 要，任何申報稅區電話都係
唔使：只有現時（最近期）嘅電話先要當 indicium
items.explain:
✗ A：要現時嘅電話。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶37。

items.title: 邊條適用？紀錄有一個 A 國號碼，標明係傳真；另一個 A 國號碼功能唔清楚。點處理？
items.short: 傳真唔當；有疑問要當

quotes.text: In the case of any number that is known not to relate to a telephone, for example a permanent fax number, the number should not be treated as indicium of residence.

However, if there is any doubt over the function, or the number has a combined function at least one of which is as a phone number, the number should be treated as indicium of residence if it is a reportable jurisdiction number.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 確知係傳真嘅唔當 indicium；功能有疑問嘅要當 indicium
items.explain:
✗ A：確知係傳真嘅唔當。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶39。
✗ C：有疑問嘅要當。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶三個月前預先指示我哋喺下年 1 月轉一筆錢去 A 國帳戶，呢個係 standing instruction indicium。」
items.short: 單次付款唔係 standing instruction
items.detail: Standing instruction 係客戶授權 RFI 無需再指示就重複付款去清楚識別為申報稅區嘅帳戶（¶41）。

quotes.text: Instructions to make an isolated payment are not standing instructions even when given significantly in advance of the payment being made.

There is a standing instruction if the account holder has mandated the reporting financial institution to make repeat payments without further instruction from the account holder, to another account that can be clearly identified as being an account maintained in a reportable jurisdiction.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：單次付款指示即使好早俾都唔係 standing instruction
items.explain:
Standing instruction 係客戶授權 RFI 無需再指示就重複付款去清楚識別為申報稅區嘅帳戶（¶41）。
✗ A：單次付款唔係。
✗ B：存款帳戶反而唔計。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶42。

items.title: 邊條適用？電子搜尋發現存款帳戶有長期指示，每月轉帳去 A 國帳戶。呢個算唔算 indicium？
items.short: 存款帳戶唔算

quotes.text: standing instructions (other than with respect to a depository account) to transfer funds to an account maintained in a reportable jurisdiction.

options: 唔算：standing instructions indicium 唔適用於存款帳戶
items.explain:
✗ A：存款帳戶除外。
✗ B：唔睇金額。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶29(d)。

items.title: 電子搜尋發現客戶授權書俾一個 A 國地址嘅人。要點樣先可以唔當 A 國 reportable？
items.short: Self-cert 或文件證據其一

quotes.text: Where the indicium found is a current effective power of attorney or signatory authority granted to a person with an address in a reportable jurisdiction, the account must be reported unless the reporting financial institution obtains or currently maintains a record of one of the following:

options: 取得或已有紀錄：客戶唔係 A 國居民嘅 self-cert，或者證明居民地唔喺申報稅區嘅文件證據
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶43。
✗ B：可以補正。
✗ C：Guidance 冇咁講。

items.title: RFI 報咗好多 undocumented accounts。IRD Guidance 點講？
items.short: IRD 可能查詢

quotes.text: The IRD may make enquiries if particular reporting financial institution appears to have a disproportionate number of undocumented accounts.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 如果某 RFI 嘅 undocumented accounts 數量不成比例，IRD 可能會作出查詢
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶45。
✗ B：IRD 會留意。
✗ C：Guidance 講可能查詢。

items.title: 揾錯處：「補正 indicia 時，我哋可以只靠客戶以前交過嘅 self-cert，唔使任何文件證據。」
items.short: 要有文件證據支持

quotes.text: The reporting financial institution can rely on self-certifications it has previously reviewed and maintained a record of, but in either case the self-certification must be supported by documentary evidence.

options: 錯：可以依賴以前覆核過嘅 self-cert，但都要有文件證據支持
items.explain:
✗ A：要有文件證據支持。
✗ B：可以用以前覆核過嘅。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶47。

items.title: 補正用嘅 self-cert 寫明客戶係香港居民，但冇明確寫「唔係 A 國居民」。可唔可以用？
items.short: 可以

quotes.text: The self-certification obtained as part of the curing procedure does not need to contain an express confirmation that an account holder is not resident in a particular jurisdiction.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 唔可以，要明確否認 A 國
可以：正面識別居民地就得，可以當唔係其他稅區居民
items.explain:
✗ A：唔需要明確否認。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶48。

items.title: RFI 為補正 indicia 聯絡客戶攞 self-cert，客戶冇回覆。幾時要當帳戶係 reportable？
items.short: 開始聯絡後 90 日

quotes.text: Where a reporting financial institution has contacted an account holder for a selfcertification but the account holder has not responded, the account should be treated as reportable 90 days after initiating contact.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
items.explain:
✗ A：有 90 日畀客戶回覆。
✗ B：係 90 日。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶49。

items.title: 揾錯處：「Pre-existing high value 個人帳戶都可以用住址測試判斷居民地。」
items.short: High value 唔可以用住址測試

quotes.text: When an account is identified as a high value account, the residence address test may not be used to establish the residence jurisdiction of the account holder.
The reporting financial institution must start with the electronic record search and then continue, where appropriate, with a paper record search and a relationship manager inquiry

options: 錯：High value 帳戶唔可以用住址測試，要做 enhanced due diligence
錯：只可以用客戶經理查詢
option_explains: 要電子搜尋，再按需要紙本搜尋同客戶經理查詢。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶53–54。
✗ B：High value 唔可以。
✗ C：要電子搜尋，再按需要紙本搜尋同客戶經理查詢。

items.title: Pre-existing high value 個人帳戶嘅 enhanced due diligence 包括邊三步？
items.short: 電子、紙本、客戶經理查詢
items.detail: 亦可以揀用新帳戶程序，直接攞 self-cert（¶55）。

quotes.text: The reporting financial institution must start with the electronic record search and then continue, where appropriate, with a paper record search and a relationship manager inquiry

The reporting financial institution may choose to apply the new account procedures and seek self-certifications from account holders rather than carry out the enhanced due diligence procedures for pre-existing high value accounts.

options: 電子紀錄搜尋、紙本紀錄搜尋、客戶經理查詢
option_explains: 住址測試唔適用 high value。
items.explain:
亦可以揀用新帳戶程序，直接攞 self-cert（¶55）。
✗ A：住址測試唔適用 high value。
✗ B：要三步。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶54。

items.title: 邊條適用？High value 帳戶：電子資料庫有晒所需欄位，但授權書欄位係空白。仲使唔使做紙本搜尋？
items.short: 要，除非有「空白即冇」政策

quotes.text: Where the electronically searchable databases include fields for the required information but are left blank, a paper record search is required unless the reporting financial institution has policies and procedures in place meaning that a field is only left blank when the information is not in the reporting financial institution’s records.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 要，除非 RFI 有政策程序確保欄位只會喺冇該資料時先留空
option_explains: 空白欄位一般要做紙本搜尋。
items.explain:
✗ A：有政策程序就唔使。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶58。
✗ C：空白欄位一般要做紙本搜尋。

items.title: High value 帳戶紙本搜尋：除咗現時客戶主檔，要睇過去幾多年內取得嘅相關文件？
items.short: 過去 5 年
items.detail: 如果電子資料只欠某類資料（例如轉帳指示），紙本搜尋只需要搵嗰類（¶59）。

quotes.text: The paper record search should include a review of the current master file and, to the extent that they are not contained in the current master file, the following documents associated with the account and obtained by the financial institution within the last 5 years:

For example, where the electronically searchable databases contain all the required information except for details of standing instructions to transfer funds, the paper record search is only required to look for that information.

items.explain:
如果電子資料只欠某類資料（例如轉帳指示），紙本搜尋只需要搵嗰類（¶59）。
✗ A：睇過去 5 年。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶60。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: RFI 可唔可以靠第三方服務提供者做 high value 帳戶覆核？
items.short: 可以，要有合約

quotes.text: A reporting financial institution can rely on the review of high value accounts by third party service providers where there is a contract obliging the service provider to perform the review.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 可以，前提係有合約要求服務提供者做覆核
items.explain:
✗ A：要有合約。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶62。
✗ C：有合約就可以。

items.title: 客戶經理知道一位 high value 客戶係 A 國居民。RFI 要點？
items.short: 該帳戶＋合併帳戶都報

quotes.text: The reporting financial institution must treat the account and any accounts aggregated with such an account, as reportable accounts if the relationship manager knows that the account holder is a reportable person.

options: 將該帳戶同所有同佢合併嘅帳戶當 reportable accounts
先做電子搜尋，冇 indicia 就唔報
option_explains: 客戶經理實際知道就要報。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶63。
✗ B：合併帳戶都要。
✗ C：客戶經理實際知道就要報。

items.title: 揾錯處：「後勤部同事有時會接客戶電話，所以佢都係 relationship manager。」
items.short: 後勤／行政人員唔算

quotes.text: Thus a person with some contact with account holders, but whose functions are of a back office, administrative or clerical nature, is not considered to be a relationship manager.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：只做後勤、行政或文書工作嘅人唔算客戶經理
items.explain:
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶65。
✗ C：要多過附帶性質。

items.title: 客戶有 $5.5 million 託管帳戶同 $6 million 存款帳戶，系統有連繫。一位同事持續管理佢嘅關係。呢位同事算唔算客戶經理？
items.short: 算
items.detail: 兩個條件：符合客戶經理定義，而且客戶帳戶合計超過 $7.8 million。

quotes.text: (a) the employee must satisfy the above definition of relationship manager and (b) the aggregate balance or value of the account holder’s accounts must exceed $7.8 million.

The reporting financial institution’s internal systems link the accounts to the same account holder, thus the accounts must be aggregated, the aggregate balances exceed $7.8 million so belong to a high value account holder.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 算：合併後超過 $7.8 million，而且符合客戶經理定義
唔算：每個帳戶都唔超過 $7.8 million
唔算：客戶經理只管單一帳戶
items.explain:
兩個條件：符合客戶經理定義，而且客戶帳戶合計超過 $7.8 million。
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶66、¶68(b) 例 2。
✗ B：要合併計。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: 客戶經理得知 high value 客戶已移居 A 國。IRD Guidance 期望 RFI 有咩安排？
items.short: 有程序捕捉客戶經理得知嘅改變

quotes.text: A reporting financial institution must ensure that it has procedures in place to capture changes that are made known to the relationship manager in respect of the account holder’s reportable status.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 有程序捕捉客戶經理得知嘅、影響申報身份嘅改變
唔使，等客戶自己改資料
客戶經理口頭知道唔算
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶67。
✗ B：要有程序。
✗ C：要捕捉。

items.title: High value 帳戶：電子搜尋見到意大利住址，但客戶經理知道客戶喺法國有地址。RFI 可以點？
items.short: 攞 self-cert＋文件證據補正
items.detail: 唔補正嘅話，每個發現 indicium 嘅申報稅區都要報（¶69）。

quotes.text: for example, the electronic search identifies a residential address in Italy but the relationship manager has knowledge of an address in France, the financial institution may attempt to cure the information by seeking a selfcertification with documentary evidence from the account holder.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 嘗試向客戶攞 self-cert 連文件證據補正
items.explain:
唔補正嘅話，每個發現 indicium 嘅申報稅區都要報（¶69）。
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶70。
✗ C：有衝突資料可以補正。

items.title: High value 帳戶已報作 undocumented account。之後要點？
items.short: 每年重做

quotes.text: Where the reporting financial institution has identified and reported an account as an undocumented account, the reporting financial institution must repeat the enhanced due diligence procedures for high value individual accounts annually until the account ceases to be undocumented.

options: 每年重做 enhanced due diligence，直至帳戶唔再係 undocumented
items.explain:
✗ A：要每年重做。
✗ B：每年。
✓ C：Ch.9 ¶74。

items.title: Low value pre-existing 帳戶今年底合併結餘超過 $7.8 million。RFI 要幾時完成 high value 程序？
items.short: 下一個曆年內
items.detail: Low value 帳戶要喺之後每個申報期末監察有冇變 high value（¶75）。

quotes.text: the reporting financial institution must complete the enhanced due diligence procedures for high value accounts within the calendar year following the year that the account becomes a high value account.

If a pre-existing individual account at the time of review is a low value account, it needs to be monitored at the end of each subsequent reporting period to see if it has become a high value account.

options: 帳戶成為 high value 嗰年嘅下一個曆年內
唔使，已經做過 low value 程序
option_explains: 要再做 high value 程序。
items.explain:
Low value 帳戶要喺之後每個申報期末監察有冇變 high value（¶75）。
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶76。
✗ B：有到下一個曆年。
✗ C：要再做 high value 程序。

items.title: High value 覆核後識別到帳戶係 reportable。之後幾年點？
items.short: 每年報，直至唔再 reportable

quotes.text: it is reportable with respect to the year in which it is so identified and remains reportable in all subsequent years unless and until the account holder ceases to be a reportable person.

options: 由識別嗰年起要報，之後每年都報，直至持有人唔再係 reportable person
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.9 ¶77。
✗ B：之後每年都要報。
✗ C：每年。

items.title: 客戶已被識別為 UK reportable，之後通知搬去 UK 另一個地址。要唔要跟進？
items.short: 唔使跟進
items.detail: 如果搬去法國，就係影響申報身份嘅 change of circumstance。

quotes.text: If, however, the new address had also been in the UK the reportable status established earlier would not be affected and no further action would be required on the part of the reporting financial institution.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 唔使：新地址都喺 UK，申報身份冇受影響
items.explain:
如果搬去法國，就係影響申報身份嘅 change of circumstance。
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶80。
✗ C：身份冇受影響就唔使。

items.title: 邊條適用？識別到 change of circumstance 後，RFI 要求 self-cert 同新文件證據，但客戶 90 日都冇回覆。要點處理？
items.short: 按每個 indicia 稅區當 reportable

quotes.text: If the account holder fails to respond to the request within 90 days following the notice or discovery of the change of circumstances, the reporting financial institution should treat the account holder as reportable to each jurisdiction for which it holds indicia.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 當客戶係 RFI 持有 indicia 嘅每個稅區嘅 reportable person
option_explains: 90 日後要按 indicia 處理。
items.explain:
✗ A：Guidance 冇咁講。
✓ B：Ch.9 ¶81。
✗ C：90 日後要按 indicia 處理。

items.title: 客戶交返嘅 self-cert 冇寫日期。RFI 可以點？
items.short: 收件時蓋日期印

quotes.text: The self-certification must be dated no earlier than the date the account holder received the form; undated selfcertifications may be date stamped by the receiving financial institution on receipt and that date will be taken as the date of signature.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 喺收到時蓋日期印，以該日期當簽署日期
option_explains: Self-cert 日期唔可以早過客戶收到表格嘅日期。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.10 ¶9。
✗ B：Guidance 容許蓋收件日期。
✗ C：Self-cert 日期唔可以早過客戶收到表格嘅日期。

items.title: 揾錯處：「未成年人名下嘅帳戶唔使 self-cert。」
items.short: 未成年人帳戶都要

quotes.text: A self-certification is required for all accounts, including those held in the names of minors.

options: 錯：所有帳戶都要 self-cert，包括未成年人名下嘅帳戶
option_explains: 可以由按本地法獲授權嘅人代簽。
items.explain:
✗ A：包括未成年人。
✗ B：可以由按本地法獲授權嘅人代簽。
✓ C：Ch.10 ¶9。

items.title: 客戶用網上表格交電子 self-cert。IRD Guidance 對 RFI 有咩要求？
items.short: 系統核實＋可向 IRD 提供印本

quotes.text: If the self-certification is provided electronically, the reporting financial institution must have systems in place to ensure that the information provided is that of the account holder and it must be able to provide a hard copy of all such self-certifications to the IRD on request.

options: 唔使保存，IRD 會自己存檔
有系統確保資料係帳戶持有人嘅，而且可以應要求向 IRD 提供所有 self-cert 嘅印本
items.explain:
✗ A：電子形式都得。
✗ B：RFI 要可以提供印本。
✓ C：Ch.10 ¶13。

items.title: 客戶交紙本 self-cert。RFI 可以點樣保存？
items.short: 正本、核證副本或影印本（含掃描）
items.detail: 電子儲存嘅文件要可以應要求向 IRD 提供印本。

quotes.text: Where an account holder provides a paper self-certification, a financial institution may retain an original, certified copy, or photocopy (including a microfiche, electronic scan, or similar means of electronic storage) of the self-certification.
Any documentation that is stored electronically must be made available by the financial institution in hard copy form to the IRD upon

options: 正本、核證副本或影印本都得，包括微縮膠片、電子掃描等電子儲存方式
items.explain:
電子儲存嘅文件要可以應要求向 IRD 提供印本。
✗ A：幾種方式都得。
✓ B：Ch.10 ¶14。
✗ C：副本都得。

items.title: 分行職員按客戶口述將 self-cert 資料輸入系統，客戶出示駕駛執照，之後喺申請表簽名。呢份 self-cert 有效嗎？
items.short: 有效

quotes.text: B produces his driving licence as proof of identification and provides all the information required for selfcertification to an employee of Bank-HK who enters the information into the Bank’s systems. The application is subsequently signed by B. B’s self-certification is valid.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 無效，一定要客戶親手填
無效，駕駛執照唔係身份證明
option_explains: 職員代輸入、客戶簽名都有效。
items.explain:
✗ A：職員代輸入、客戶簽名都有效。
✗ B：例子接受駕駛執照。
✓ C：Ch.10 ¶15(b) 例 2。

items.title: Self-cert 原本有效。以下邊個情況，Guidance 舉例話可能令 RFI 知道或有理由知道佢唔正確？
items.short: 開新帳戶或客戶報 change of circumstances

quotes.text: This might be the case either at the time a new account is opened by an existing customer, or as a result of a change of circumstances reported by the account holder, for example, a change of address.

options: 現有客戶開新帳戶時，或者客戶報 change of circumstances（例如改地址）

items.title: 揾錯處：「Self-cert 漏咗一個同客戶聲稱身份有關嘅項目，不過其他資料齊，所以可以照依賴。」
items.short: 有關項目唔完整就唔可靠

quotes.text: the self-certification is incomplete with respect to any item on the selfcertification that is relevant to the claims made by the person;

options: 錯：self-cert 喺同聲稱有關嘅項目上唔完整，RFI 就有理由知道佢唔可靠
option_explains: 唔完整就有 reason to know。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.10 ¶20(a)。
✗ B：唔完整就有 reason to know。
✗ C：問題係唔可以依賴。

items.title: RFI 委託服務提供者覆核同保存 self-cert。服務提供者知道客戶其實住喺 A 國，但 RFI 本身唔知。RFI 算唔算有 reason to know？
items.short: 算，SP 知道當 RFI 知道

quotes.text: A reporting financial institution that relies on a service provider to review and maintain a self-certification is considered to know or have reason to know the facts within the knowledge of the service provider.

options: 算：依賴服務提供者時，服務提供者知道嘅事實會當 RFI 知道
option_explains: 服務提供者知道嘅都計。
items.explain:
✗ A：服務提供者知道嘅都計。
✗ B：RFI 都被視為知道。
✓ C：Ch.10 ¶21。

items.title: 邊條適用？客戶出示嘅文件證據合理地確立唔到出示人嘅身份。RFI 可唔可以依賴？
items.short: 唔可以依賴
items.detail: 文件證據缺乏確立身份所需資料，亦唔可以依賴（¶23）。

quotes.text: A reporting financial institution may not rely on documentary evidence provided by a person if the documentary evidence does not reasonably establish the identity of the person presenting it.
or the documentary evidence lacks information necessary to establish the person's status.

options: 可以，交俾 IRD 判斷
option_explains: 文件證據要合理確立出示人身份。
items.explain:
文件證據缺乏確立身份所需資料，亦唔可以依賴（¶23）。
✗ A：問題係文件證據本身。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：文件證據要合理確立出示人身份。

items.title: 揾錯處：「為咗確保 self-cert 有效，我哋要定期主動查問每位客戶有冇 change of circumstances，否則唔可以依賴 self-cert。」
items.short: 唔使主動查問
items.detail: Change in circumstances 只令唔再可靠嘅資料部分失效，直至更新（¶28）。

quotes.text: A reporting financial institution may rely on a self-certification without having to inquire into possible changes of circumstances that may affect the validity of the statement, unless it knows or has reason to know that circumstances have changed.

A change in circumstances affecting the self-certification provided to the reporting financial institution invalidates the self-certification with respect to the information that is no longer reliable until the information is updated.

options: 錯：除非知道或有理由知道情況有變，RFI 可以依賴 self-cert 而唔使主動查問
items.explain:
Change in circumstances 只令唔再可靠嘅資料部分失效，直至更新（¶28）。
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ch.10 ¶30。
✗ C：Guidance 講唔使主動查問。

items.title: 一位美國公民喺香港住同工作，亦係香港稅務居民。按 IRD Guidance，佢嘅稅務居民地係？
items.short: 美國同香港都係
items.detail: 如果個人係多於一個申報稅區嘅稅務居民，帳戶就係每個居民地嘅 reportable account。

quotes.text: This means that a US citizen is always a US tax resident, even if they are living and working in Hong Kong and also Hong Kong tax resident.
Where an individual is tax resident in more than one reportable jurisdiction, then any accounts will be reportable accounts for each jurisdiction where they are tax resident.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 美國同香港都係：美國一律當其公民係稅務居民
只係香港，因為住喺香港
option_explains: CRS 申報唔用 tiebreaker 揀一個。
美國以公民身份判斷居民。
items.explain:
如果個人係多於一個申報稅區嘅稅務居民，帳戶就係每個居民地嘅 reportable account。
✗ A：CRS 申報唔用 tiebreaker 揀一個。
✓ B：Ch.15 ¶7。
✗ C：美國以公民身份判斷居民。

items.title: 邊條適用？一間公司喺 A 國註冊成立，但喺 B 國管理同控制。佢可能係？
items.short: 可能雙重居民
items.detail: 一般實體喺註冊同管理控制地係稅務居民，但最終要睇各地本地法（¶8）。

quotes.text: If an entity is not managed and controlled in the same place that it is incorporated, then the entity may be “dual resident”, a tax resident of more than one jurisdiction.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 一定只係 A 國居民
items.explain:
一般實體喺註冊同管理控制地係稅務居民，但最終要睇各地本地法（¶8）。
✗ A：視乎兩地本地法。
✓ B：Ch.15 ¶9。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: 一個合夥（partnership）喺 UK 管理同控制，本身唔係納稅人（合夥人先係）。申報時佢嘅「稅務居民地」點定？
items.short: 實際管理地 UK

quotes.text: a partnership managed and controlled in the UK will be “tax resident” in the UK even though the taxable persons are the partners rather than the partnership itself.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance（2016）舉嘅例子，用嚟解釋條文；唔係條例原文。
options: 用每位合夥人嘅居民地
當佢係 UK「稅務居民」（實際管理地）
option_explains: Guidance 以實際管理地當居民地。
申報上合夥用實際管理地。
items.explain:
✗ A：Guidance 以實際管理地當居民地。
✗ B：申報上合夥用實際管理地。
✓ C：Ch.15 ¶10。

items.title: 客戶唔肯定自己喺邊度係稅務居民。IRD Guidance 建議點？
items.short: 問稅務顧問

quotes.text: If an individual or entity is not certain where they are tax resident then they should ask their tax adviser.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 問稅務顧問；亦可以參考 OECD AEOI portal 上各地稅務居民規則
由 RFI 職員代決定
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.15 ¶11。
✗ B：RFI 唔應代決定。
✗ C：唔可以亂填。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶喺 A 國有份工交過僱員稅，但呢個資料同佢係唔係 A 國稅務居民完全無關。」
items.short: 報稅／交稅好可能係居民
items.detail: 最終仍然要按該地稅法判斷。

quotes.text: If an individual files a tax return or pays tax in a jurisdiction, including direct payment of employment taxes, then the individual is likely to be a tax resident there.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：喺某地報稅或交稅（包括直接交僱員稅），個人好可能係嗰度嘅稅務居民
items.explain:
最終仍然要按該地稅法判斷。
✗ A：Guidance 用「likely」，唔係一定。
✓ B：Ch.15 ¶6。
✗ C：Guidance 話好可能係居民。

items.title: 個人 reportable person 嘅地址要報邊個？
items.short: 現時住址（冇就郵寄地址）
items.detail: 實體就報 RFI 紀錄入面嗰個實體地址（¶14）。

quotes.text: the address to be reported is the individual’s current residence address. If the financial institution does not hold this address in its records then it should report the mailing address it has on file for that person.
Where the reportable person is an entity, the address to be reported is the address that the financial institution holds on file for that entity.

options: 現時住址；紀錄冇住址先報郵寄地址
items.explain:
實體就報 RFI 紀錄入面嗰個實體地址（¶14）。
✗ A：先報住址。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：Ch.15 ¶12。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶喺 B 國收入要預扣稅，B 國俾咗個源頭識別號碼，我哋喺 TIN 欄報呢個號碼。」
items.short: 源頭識別號碼唔報

quotes.text: Any identifier assigned by a jurisdiction of source, for example, for identifying a person whose income has been subject to withholding tax at source, should not be reported.

options: 錯：來源地為預扣稅等目的發出嘅識別號碼唔應該報
option_explains: TIN 係居民地稅務機關發出。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.15 ¶16。
✗ B：TIN 係居民地稅務機關發出。
✗ C：源頭號碼唔報。

items.title: 客戶居民地冇發 TIN，但有一個高完整性嘅國民識別號碼（例如社會保障號碼）。點睇？
items.short: 可用同等嘅高完整性號碼
items.detail: 實體方面，稅區可以用商業／公司登記號碼（¶18）。

quotes.text: Some jurisdictions do not issue a TIN, or do not issue a TIN to all residents, and where no TIN has been issued there will be nothing to report unless they use other high integrity numbers with an equivalent level of identification.
For entities, jurisdictions may use a business/company registration code or number where no TIN has been issued.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 客戶冇 TIN 就唔可以開戶
冇發 TIN 就冇嘢報，除非該稅區用其他具同等識別力嘅高完整性號碼（例如社會保障號碼）
items.explain:
實體方面，稅區可以用商業／公司登記號碼（¶18）。
✗ A：Guidance 冇咁講。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：Ch.15 ¶17。

items.title: 邊條適用？A 國有發 TIN，但 A 國本地法唔要求為本地申報收集 TIN。RFI 要唔要收集 A 國 TIN？
items.short: 唔使收集
items.detail: OECD AEOI portal 有列出呢類稅區。

quotes.text: Some jurisdictions that issue TINs have domestic law that do not require the collection of the TIN for domestic reporting purposes. In such cases the reporting financial institution is not required to collect the TIN for those jurisdictions.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
option_explains: Guidance 講明呢種情況唔使收集。
items.explain:
OECD AEOI portal 有列出呢類稅區。
✓ A：Guidance 講明呢種情況唔使收集。
✗ B：有例外。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: 一個原本唔發 TIN 嘅稅區開始發 TIN。之後點？
items.short: 豁免終止，取得 TIN 就要報

quotes.text: jurisdiction starts issuing TINs the exception no longer applies and the TIN would be required to be reported if the financial institution obtains a self-certification that contains such a TIN, or otherwise obtains such a TIN.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 豁免唔再適用；RFI 取得載有該 TIN 嘅 self-cert 或以其他方式取得 TIN，就要報
items.explain:
✗ A：開始發就唔再豁免。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：Ch.15 ¶21。

items.title: 客戶係 A 國同 B 國（都係申報稅區）嘅稅務居民，有兩個 TIN。RFI 要報幾多個稅區同 TIN？
items.short: 兩個稅區、兩個 TIN

quotes.text: As reportable persons may be resident in more than one jurisdiction, they may have two or more TINs that the financial institution must report.

Where a reportable person is identified as having more than one reportable jurisdiction of residence, the financial institution is required to report all of the identified reportable jurisdictions to the IRD.

options: 兩個稅區都報，兩個 TIN 都報

items.title: 揾錯處：「盡職審查識別咗客戶係 A 國居民，所以我哋做其他稅務用途（例如預扣）時都一定要當佢 A 國居民。」
items.short: 唔影響其他稅務目的

quotes.text: The jurisdictions of residence identified as a result of carrying out the due diligence procedures are without prejudice to any residence determination made by the

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：盡職審查識別嘅居民地唔影響 RFI 為其他稅務目的作出嘅居民判斷
items.explain:
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ch.15 ¶25。
✗ C：Guidance 講 without prejudice。

items.title: 一個 reportable account 冇獨有帳戶號碼。要報咩？
items.short: 功能等同，或描述
items.detail: 帳號包括銀行帳號、保單號碼同其他非傳統獨有識別碼（¶27）。

quotes.text: Where there is no unique identifying number or code, the financial institution should report any functional equivalent that they use to identify the account.

Exceptionally, if the reportable account does not have any form of identifying number or code, the financial institution should report a description of the account sufficient to identify the account held by the named account holder in future.
This will include identifiers such as bank account numbers and policy numbers for insurance contracts as well as other non-traditional unique identifiers.

options: 報 RFI 用嚟識別該帳戶嘅功能等同（functional equivalent）；真係乜都冇就報足以識別帳戶嘅描述
items.explain:
帳號包括銀行帳號、保單號碼同其他非傳統獨有識別碼（¶27）。
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ch.15 ¶28–29。
✗ C：要報等同或描述。

items.title: 申報時 RFI 要報自己嘅識別號碼。用咩？
items.short: AEOI ID

quotes.text: The financial institution will need to report an AEOI ID issued by the IRD upon its registration via the IRD AEOI Portal.

options: 經 IRD AEOI Portal 登記後 IRD 發出嘅 AEOI ID
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.15 ¶30。
✗ B：Guidance 講 AEOI ID。
✗ C：Guidance 講 AEOI ID。

items.title: 一個基金帳戶冇辦法喺 12 月 31 日估值。要報邊日嘅結餘？
items.short: 最接近 12 月 31 日嘅估值點

quotes.text: This will be 31 December in each year unless it is not possible or usual to value an account at that date. If that is the case then that value at the normal valuation point for the account that is nearest to 31 December should be used.

options: 最接近 12 月 31 日嘅正常估值點

items.title: 揾錯處：「結餘一定要用 12 月 31 日，而且一律換算做港元報。」
items.short: 可用其他申報期；用帳戶貨幣

quotes.text: The reporting financial institution may also report the balance or value as of the end of other appropriate reporting period of 12 months ending on 31 March, 30 June and 30 September. The value of the account should be reported in the currency in which the account is denominated.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：可以用其他 12 個月申報期（3 月 31 日、6 月 30 日、9 月 30 日結束）；結餘用帳戶計價貨幣報
option_explains: 有其他申報期，亦用帳戶貨幣。
items.explain:
✗ A：用帳戶貨幣。
✓ B：Ch.15 ¶31。
✗ C：有其他申報期，亦用帳戶貨幣。

items.title: 帳戶年底透支，結餘係 -$20,000。報表點填？
items.short: 報零

quotes.text: Where the balance or value of an account is nil or a negative amount, for example where an account is overdrawn, the financial institution must report the balance or value as nil.

items.explain:
✗ A：負數要報零。
✗ B：要照報，結餘報零。
✓ C：Ch.15 ¶32。

items.title: 邊條適用？以下帳戶類型要報咩結餘？現金價值保單、投資實體嘅債務權益。
items.short: 保單：現金／退保價值；債務：本金
items.detail: 投資實體嘅股權權益：報 FI 為最頻密估值目的計算嘅價值（¶34）。

quotes.text: For cash value insurance contracts or annuity contracts, the amount to be reported is the cash value or surrender value of the contract.
For a debt interest in an investment entity, the balance or value is the principal amount of the debt.
For an equity interest in an investment entity, the amount to be reported is the value calculated by the financial institution for the purpose that requires the most frequent determination of value.

options: 兩個都報已付保費／投資額
保單報現金價值或退保價值；債務權益報債務本金
items.explain:
投資實體嘅股權權益：報 FI 為最頻密估值目的計算嘅價值（¶34）。
✗ A：唔係。
✗ B：債務權益報本金。
✓ C：Ch.15 ¶33、¶35。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶用帳戶入面嘅證券做抵押借咗 $2 million，所以報表結餘要扣返 $2 million。」
items.short: 唔可以扣負債

quotes.text: The balance or value of an account must not be reduced by any liabilities or obligations incurred by an account holder with respect to the account or any of the assets held in the account.

options: 錯：結餘唔可以因帳戶持有人就帳戶或資產嘅負債而扣減
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.15 ¶36。
✗ B：唔可以扣。
✗ C：唔可以扣。

items.title: Passive NFE 嘅 controlling person 係 A 國同 B 國雙重居民。帳戶結餘 $900,000。每個稅區報幾多？
items.short: 每個稅區報全數

quotes.text: the entire balance or value of the reportable account, as well as the entire amount paid or credited to the reportable account must be reported to each jurisdiction of residence of the account holder or controlling person.

options: 每個稅區都報全數 $900,000，付款金額亦報全數
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.15 ¶40。
✗ B：要報全數。
✗ C：每個居民地都要報。

items.title: 投資實體嘅股權權益幾時算「結束」（closed）？
items.short: 轉讓、退回、贖回、取消或清盤
items.detail: 一般按 RFI 一致適用嘅正常運作程序判斷。

quotes.text: For example, an equity interest in an investment entity would be considered closed when that interest is terminated by the transfer, surrender, redemption or cancellation of the interest or the liquidation of the entity.

options: 權益因轉讓、退回、贖回、取消或實體清盤而終止時
items.explain:
一般按 RFI 一致適用嘅正常運作程序判斷。
✓ A：Ch.15 ¶41。
✗ B：零結餘唔等於結束。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: 客戶年中通知搬返香港，RFI 今年 9 月確認佢唔再係 A 國 reportable person，帳戶繼續開。今年要唔要向 A 國報？
items.short: 今年唔使報
items.detail: 同年中結束帳戶唔同：結束帳戶要報結束事實同結束前嘅付款。

quotes.text: If, as a result of a change of circumstances, an account holder ceases to be a reportable person then the account will cease to be a reportable account in the year in which the change of circumstance is identified by the reporting financial institution.
As reporting is based on the status of accounts in existence at the end of the reportable period such accounts will not be reportable for the period in which the change of circumstances occurs.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 唔使：識別 change 嗰年帳戶就唔再係 reportable account
option_explains: 呢個係結束帳戶嘅做法，唔適用。
items.explain:
同年中結束帳戶唔同：結束帳戶要報結束事實同結束前嘅付款。
✗ A：唔使。
✓ B：Ch.15 ¶44–45。
✗ C：呢個係結束帳戶嘅做法，唔適用。

items.title: 託管帳戶（custodial account）除一般資料外，要額外報咩？
items.short: 利息、股息、其他收入、總收益

quotes.text: the total gross amount of interest paid or credited to the account;
the total amount of dividends paid or credited to the account;
the total gross proceeds from the sale or redemption of financial assets paid or credited to the account.

options: 利息總額、股息總額、其他收入總額、出售或贖回金融資產嘅總收益
option_explains: 存款帳戶先係只報利息。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.15 ¶48。
✗ B：存款帳戶先係只報利息。
✗ C：要報四類付款。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶出售證券所得 $1 million，其中 $400,000 用嚟還買證券時借嘅貸款，所以 gross proceeds 報 $600,000。」
items.short: 唔可以扣貸款
items.detail: 佣金同費用可以計入總收益嘅計算（¶51）。

quotes.text: For example, a loan used to fund acquisition of the asset may be repaid from the proceeds of sale. This must not be deducted from the amount reportable.
Commissions and fees paid with respect to the sale or redemption of the asset may be taken account of in arriving at the gross proceeds of sale.

options: 錯：總收益唔可以扣除用嚟清還負債（例如貸款）嘅款項，要報 $1 million
items.explain:
佣金同費用可以計入總收益嘅計算（¶51）。
✓ A：Ch.15 ¶50。
✗ B：唔可以扣貸款。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: 邊條適用？客戶喺兩次派息日之間賣出一隻附息債券。報 gross proceeds 時，累計利息點處理？
items.short: 包括累計利息
items.detail: 總收益唔理客戶喺香港使唔使為出售交稅都要報（¶49）。

quotes.text: Where the financial asset that is sold or redeemed is an interest bearing debt obligation, the gross proceeds should include any interest that has accrued between interest payment dates.
This is without regard to whether or not the account holder would be subject to tax in Hong Kong on the sale or redemption of the financial asset.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 總收益要包括兩次派息日之間累計嘅利息（Ch.15 ¶52）
items.explain:
總收益唔理客戶喺香港使唔使為出售交稅都要報（¶49）。
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Guidance 講要包括。
✗ C：要包括。

items.title: 存款帳戶（depository account）除一般資料外，額外要報咩？
items.short: 利息總額

quotes.text: where the reportable account is a depository account, the information to be reported for each reportable period is the gross amount of interest paid or credited to the account during that period.

options: 期內支付或記入帳戶嘅利息總額
items.explain:
✗ A：存款帳戶只報利息。
✗ B：託管帳戶先報。
✓ C：Ch.15 ¶53。

items.title: 保單持有人年內部分退保兩次；另一位客戶嘅遞延年金到期冇轉做終身年金，而係攞咗退保價值。要報咩付款？
items.short: 部分退保＋退保價值都報

quotes.text: For cash value insurance contracts, this will include any part surrenders taken throughout the policy year.

Where a deferred annuity is not converted into a purchased life annuity at the end of the accumulation phase and the account holder takes the surrender value of the contract instead, the amount paid as the surrender value is the amount to be reported.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 部分退保要計入付款；遞延年金就報所付嘅退保價值

items.title: 揾錯處：「舊文件已經歸檔，業務冇再用，但都算 RFI『維持』嘅紀錄，做盡職審查時一定要搜。」
items.short: 歸檔唔用嘅唔算維持

quotes.text: Information is not regarded as maintained by the financial institution if it has been archived and is not used by the business
Only when such information is retrieved by the financial institution from the archive so that it can be used by it will the information be regarded as maintained.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：歸檔資料要即時銷毀
錯：已歸檔而業務唔再使用嘅資料唔算 RFI 維持嘅紀錄，除非取返出嚟使用
items.explain:
✗ A：Guidance 講唔算。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：Ch.15 ¶60。

items.title: 客戶檔案以 PDF 掃描本儲存。做電子紀錄搜尋時，呢啲算唔算「electronically searchable」？
items.short: 唔算
items.detail: RFI 亦唔使為 AEOI 特登起新系統做電子搜尋（¶62）。

quotes.text: Information, data or files are not electronically searchable merely because they are stored in an image retrieval system such as portable document format (pdf.) or as scanned documents.
they are not expected to build systems to carry out electronic searches solely for the purpose of reporting under their automatic exchange of information obligations.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 唔算：只係以 PDF 或掃描影像儲存唔等於可電子搜尋
option_explains: 要可以用標準查詢搜尋嘅資料庫。
items.explain:
RFI 亦唔使為 AEOI 特登起新系統做電子搜尋（¶62）。
✗ A：Guidance 冇咁講。
✓ B：Ch.15 ¶61。
✗ C：要可以用標準查詢搜尋嘅資料庫。

items.title: NRFI 點解唔使做盡職審查同申報？
items.short: 逃稅風險低

quotes.text: Non-reporting financial institutions are specifically not required to perform the due diligence procedures and report information on financial accounts due to posing a low risk of being used to evade tax.
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 引言（p.4-1）

options: 因為被認定為用嚟逃稅嘅風險低
因為佢哋唔受 IRD 監管
option_explains: IRD 會審查 NRFI 係咪符合條件。
items.explain:
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ch.4 引言。
✗ C：IRD 會審查 NRFI 係咪符合條件。

items.title: 邊條適用？一個由政府實體設立嘅基金，為一班從未受僱於政府、但曾為政府提供個人服務嘅人提供退休福利。佢可能屬邊類 NRFI？
items.short: 政府實體退休基金（¶5）

quotes.text: are not current or former employees, if the benefits provided to such beneficiaries or participants are in consideration of personal services rendered for the governmental entity, international organization, central bank or the Hong Kong Monetary Authority.

options: 政府實體等嘅退休基金（Ch.4 ¶5(b)）
option_explains: ¶6 講受僱於一個或多個僱主嘅僱員。
福利係作為為政府提供個人服務嘅代價都可以。
items.explain:
✗ A：¶6 講受僱於一個或多個僱主嘅僱員。
✗ B：CIV 係投資實體。
✓ C：福利係作為為政府提供個人服務嘅代價都可以。

items.title: Broad participation retirement fund 要做 NRFI，以下邊項係條件之一？
items.short: 冇單一受益人 > 5%
items.detail: 另外要受政府規管並向稅務機關申報資料，同埋符合 (iii) 其中一項條件（例如稅務優惠、≥ 50% 供款來自僱主等）。

quotes.text: does not have a single beneficiary with a right to more than 5% of the fund’s assets;
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶6（broad participation retirement fund）（p.4-2）

quotes.text: is subject to government regulation and provides information reporting to the tax authorities; and
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶6（broad participation retirement fund）（p.4-2）

options: 基金一定要喺香港上市
冇單一受益人有權享有超過 5% 基金資產
option_explains: 呢個係 narrow participation fund 嘅條件。
items.explain:
另外要受政府規管並向稅務機關申報資料，同埋符合 (iii) 其中一項條件（例如稅務優惠、≥ 50% 供款來自僱主等）。
✗ A：冇咁嘅條件。
✓ B：Ch.4 ¶6(b)(i)。
✗ C：呢個係 narrow participation fund 嘅條件。

items.title: 揾錯處：「Broad participation retirement fund 嘅 (iii) 條件要全部符合：稅務優惠、≥ 50% 供款來自僱主、提款限制、僱員供款上限。」
items.short: (iii) 符合其中一項就得
items.detail: 其中一項係僱員供款按收入設上限，或每年唔超過 $390,000。

quotes.text: the fund receives at least 50% of its total contributions
contributions (other than certain permitted make-up contributions) by employees to the fund are limited by reference to the earned income of the employee, or may not exceed $390,000 annually

options: 錯：(iii) 只要符合其中任何一項（meets any of the following conditions）
items.explain:
其中一項係僱員供款按收入設上限，或每年唔超過 $390,000。
✗ A：有四項選擇。
✓ B：Ch.4 ¶6(b)(iii)。
✗ C：係「any」。

items.title: Narrow participation retirement fund 嘅條件包括？
items.short: < 50 人、僱主非 IE／PNFE、非居民 ≤ 20%
items.detail: 仲要受政府規管並向稅務機關申報資料，供款按收入設上限。

quotes.text: has less than 50 participants;
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶7（narrow participation retirement fund）（p.4-3）

quotes.text: is sponsored by an employer that is not an investment entity or a passive NFE; and
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶7（narrow participation retirement fund）（p.4-4）

quotes.text: the participants who are not residents for tax purposes for the jurisdiction in which the fund is established are not entitled to more than 20% of the fund’s assets;
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶7（narrow participation retirement fund）（p.4-4）

options: 參與人少過 50 人；保薦僱主唔係投資實體或 passive NFE；非居民參與人享有唔超過 20% 資產
非居民參與人可以享有任何比例
items.explain:
仲要受政府規管並向稅務機關申報資料，供款按收入設上限。
✓ A：Ch.4 ¶7。
✗ B：要少過 50。
✗ C：上限 20%。

items.title: 一個僱員退休基金得 30 位參與人，保薦僱主係一間 passive NFE 控股公司。佢可唔可以係 narrow participation retirement fund？
items.short: 唔可以，僱主係 passive NFE

quotes.text: is sponsored by an employer that is not an investment entity or a passive NFE; and
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶7（narrow participation retirement fund）（p.4-4）

quotes.text: has less than 50 participants;
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶7（narrow participation retirement fund）（p.4-3）

options: 唔可以：保薦僱主唔可以係投資實體或 passive NFE
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.4 ¶7(b)(ii)。
✗ B：仲要符合其他條件。
✗ C：保薦僱主條件唔符合。

items.title: 邊條適用？一間實體純粹因為發信用卡、而只喺客戶多繳卡數時收存款，先成為 FI。佢可能屬邊類 NRFI？
items.short: Qualified credit card issuer
items.detail: 同 Ch.6 ¶6 嘅「信用卡多繳」excluded account 唔同：呢度係整個機構做 NRFI。

quotes.text: the entity is a financial institution and it is so solely because it is an issuer of credit cards that accepts deposits only when a customer makes a payment in excess of a balance due with respect to the credit card of the customer and the overpayment is not immediately returned to the customer; and
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶8（qualified credit card issuer）（p.4-4）

option_explains: 另外要有政策防止多繳逾 $390,000 或 60 日內退還。
items.explain:
同 Ch.6 ¶6 嘅「信用卡多繳」excluded account 唔同：呢度係整個機構做 NRFI。
✓ A：另外要有政策防止多繳逾 $390,000 或 60 日內退還。
✗ B：唔係投資實體。
✗ C：唔係信託。

items.title: 一個受規管嘅集體投資計劃，全部權益都由非 reportable persons 持有，但其中一個持有人係 passive NFE，而佢有一位 controlling person 係 reportable person。佢仲係唔係 exempt CIV？
items.short: 唔係 exempt CIV

quotes.text: the investment entity is regulated as a collective investment vehicle; and
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶9（exempt collective investment vehicle）（p.4-5）

quotes.text: any of the interests in the entity is held by, or through, an entity that is a passive NFE; and
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶9（exempt collective investment vehicle）（p.4-5）

quotes.text: any one of the controlling persons of the passive NFE is a reportable person.
quotes.pin: IRD Guidance for FIs（2016）Ch.4 ¶9（exempt collective investment vehicle）（p.4-5）

options: 係，持有人本身唔係 reportable person 就得
唔係：權益經 passive NFE 持有，而該 NFE 有 CP 係 reportable person，就唔適用
items.explain:
✗ A：要 look through passive NFE。
✗ B：持有人條件唔符合。
✓ C：Ch.4 ¶9。

items.title: 信託嘅受託人本身係 RFI，並就信託所有 reportable accounts 申報所有須報資料。呢個信託係？
items.short: Trustee-documented trust

quotes.text: A trust is a non-reporting financial institution if it is established to the extent that the trustee of the trust is a reporting financial institution and reports all information required to be reported pursuant to the IRO with respect to all reportable accounts of the trust.

options: 一定要自己登記做 RFI 申報
option_explains: 受託人代報晒就係 NRFI。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.4 ¶10；Ch.17 ¶15。
✗ B：受託人代報晒就係 NRFI。
✗ C：係機構類別，唔係帳戶。

items.title: 揾錯處：「香港強積金計劃同職業退休計劃一直都係 NRFI，唔使履行 Part 8A 責任。」
items.short: 2020 年起已剔出 NRFI 名單

quotes.text: With effect from 1 January 2020, mandatory provident fund schemes, occupational retirement schemes,

pooling agreements, approved pooled investment funds and credit unions that fall within the definition of a reporting financial institution are removed from the list of non-reporting financial institution and will not be exempt from performing the obligations under Part 8A of the IRO.

options: 錯：由 2020 年 1 月 1 日起，屬 RFI 定義嘅強積金計劃、職業退休計劃、匯集協議、核准匯集投資基金同信用合作社已經剔出 NRFI 名單

items.title: 以下邊個係 IRD Guidance 列明嘅香港指明 NRFI？
items.short: 補助學校公積金
items.detail: 津貼學校公積金（Subsidized Schools Provident Fund）亦係。

quotes.text: The Grant Schools Provident Fund maintained for teachers under the Grant Schools Provident Fund Rules (Cap. 279 sub. leg. C) is a non-reporting financial institution.

pooling agreements, approved pooled investment funds and credit unions that fall within the definition of a reporting financial institution are removed from the list of non-reporting financial institution and will not be exempt from performing the obligations under Part 8A of the IRO.

options: 補助學校公積金（Grant Schools Provident Fund）
items.explain:
津貼學校公積金（Subsidized Schools Provident Fund）亦係。
✗ A：2020 年起已剔出。
✗ B：2020 年起已剔出。
✓ C：Ch.4 ¶11。

items.title: AEOI 盡職審查同申報責任一般喺咩兩種情況適用於信託？
items.short: 信託係 RFI，或係持有帳戶嘅 NFE
items.detail: 一般嚟講信託係受信關係，唔係有獨立法人人格嘅實體（¶3），但 AEOI 下當實體處理。

quotes.text: (a) when a trust is a reporting financial institution; and (b) when a trust is an NFE that maintains a financial account with a reporting financial institution.
In general terms, a trust is a fiduciary relationship, rather than an entity with its own separate legal personality.

options: 信託本身係 RFI；或者信託係 NFE，喺 RFI 持有財務帳戶
只有信託係 RFI 時
items.explain:
一般嚟講信託係受信關係，唔係有獨立法人人格嘅實體（¶3），但 AEOI 下當實體處理。
✓ A：Ch.17 ¶1。
✗ B：仲有 NFE 情況。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: 信託一定要有邊啲當事人？
items.short: Settlor、受託人、最少一位受益人

quotes.text: The parties to a trust must include a settlor, a trustee and at least one beneficiary, and there may be more than one of each. These parties may be natural persons or entities.
A protector may also be appointed in connection with a trust. This is not a compulsory requirement of a trust, but may be included in some jurisdictions.

options: 最少一位 settlor、一位受託人同一位受益人；可以多過一位，亦可以係自然人或實體
受益人一定要係自然人
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.17 ¶5。
✗ B：Protector 唔係必須（¶10）。
✗ C：可以係實體。

items.title: 邊條適用？Settlor 保留咗撤銷信託同取回信託財產嘅權利。呢個信託屬？
items.short: 可撤銷信託

quotes.text: A trust is revocable where the settlor has retained some interest or rights over the trust, such as the right to revoke the trust or to have all or a portion of the trust property return to the settlor.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
option_explains: Settlor 保留權利就係可撤銷。
items.explain:
✓ A：Ch.17 ¶6。
✗ B：Settlor 保留權利就係可撤銷。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: 揾錯處：「信託受益人寫『A 嘅孫』而唔係逐個列名，所以信託無效，唔使理受益人。」
items.short: 類別受益人唔令信託無效

quotes.text: Describing the beneficiaries as a class does not make the trust invalid provided that at some point members of the class are able to be specifically identified.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：要當 settlor 係受益人
錯：以類別描述受益人唔會令信託無效，只要將來某時可以具體識別成員
items.explain:
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ch.17 ¶7。
✗ C：Guidance 講唔會無效。

items.title: Mandatory beneficiary 同 discretionary beneficiary 有咩分別？AEOI 點對待 contingent beneficiary？
items.short: Contingent 當 discretionary 處理

quotes.text: If the trustee refused to make the distribution, a mandatory beneficiary could enforce their right against the trustee and obtain the property.
For purposes of AEOI, a contingent beneficiary is treated like a discretionary beneficiary.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: Mandatory 有可強制執行嘅權利；discretionary 靠受託人酌情；contingent 當 discretionary 處理
option_explains: 只喺收分派嗰年先當 account holder。
items.explain:
✗ A：只喺收分派嗰年先當 account holder。
✓ B：Ch.17 ¶8–9。
✗ C：Contingent 當 discretionary。

items.title: 信託最常見點樣成為 FI？
items.short: 受 FI 管理嘅投資實體

quotes.text: This is the case when a trust has gross income primarily attributable to investing, reinvesting, or trading in financial assets and is managed by another entity that is a financial institution.

options: 總收入主要來自投資、再投資或買賣金融資產，並由另一間 FI 管理（投資實體 (e) 段）

items.title: 揾錯處：「信託唔係 FI 就一定係 passive NFE。」
items.short: 信託可以係 active NFE
items.detail: 如果係 active NFE，信託本身嘅帳戶都可能係 reportable account（¶30）。

quotes.text: It is possible that, despite perhaps less common in practice, a trust could qualify as an active NFE, such as a trust that is a charity or a trading trust carrying on an active business.

In instances where the trust is an active NFE, the trust itself may have a reportable account with the financial institution, which needs to be determined in light of the relevant due diligence procedures.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 錯：雖然少見，信託都可以係 active NFE，例如慈善信託或經營業務嘅 trading trust
items.explain:
如果係 active NFE，信託本身嘅帳戶都可能係 reportable account（¶30）。
✓ A：Ch.17 ¶12。
✗ B：可以係 active NFE。
✗ C：唔係。

items.title: 邊條適用？一個信託喺非參與稅區成立同居住，總收入主要嚟自金融資產，由一間專業 FI 管理。佢喺香港銀行開戶。銀行點當佢？
items.short: 當 passive NFE
items.detail: 要識別同申報佢嘅 controlling persons。

quotes.text: such reporting financial institution must treat the trust as a passive NFE if it is an investment entity described in paragraph (e) of the definition of investment entity and is not a financial institution resident or located in a participating jurisdiction

option_explains: 非參與稅區嘅 (e) 段投資實體要當 passive NFE。
非參與稅區嘅投資實體唔可以咁做。
items.explain:
要識別同申報佢嘅 controlling persons。
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：非參與稅區嘅 (e) 段投資實體要當 passive NFE。
✗ C：非參與稅區嘅投資實體唔可以咁做。

items.title: 一個喺海外成立嘅信託，平時喺香港管理同控制。按 IRD Guidance，佢係唔係香港居民？
items.short: 係香港居民
items.detail: 受託人係香港居民亦當信託係香港居民。

quotes.text: resident in Hong Kong if it is constituted under the laws of Hong Kong, or if constituted outside Hong Kong, it is normally managed or controlled in Hong Kong. A trust will also be considered to be resident where the trustee(s) is resident.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 係：喺香港以外成立但通常喺香港管理或控制，都係香港居民
items.explain:
受託人係香港居民亦當信託係香港居民。
✗ A：管理控制地都計。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：Ch.17 ¶16。

items.title: 一個信託有兩位受託人，一位喺香港，一位喺 A 國（參與稅區）。信託喺邊度係 RFI？
items.short: 兩地都係 RFI
items.detail: 如果信託喺另一個同香港自動交換資料嘅稅區係稅務居民並喺嗰度報晒，可以免喺香港申報，但每位受託人要能證明申報確實進行（¶17）。

quotes.text: In other words, if the trustees are each resident in different jurisdictions, the trust would be a reporting financial institution in each of those participating jurisdictions, and would each separately report in respect of their reportable accounts.
In order to obtain such relief, each trustee should be able to demonstrate that all necessary reporting by the trust is actually taking place.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 兩個稅區都係，各自就其 reportable accounts 申報
option_explains: 每個受託人居住嘅參與稅區都係。
items.explain:
如果信託喺另一個同香港自動交換資料嘅稅區係稅務居民並喺嗰度報晒，可以免喺香港申報，但每位受託人要能證明申報確實進行（¶17）。
✗ A：每個受託人居住嘅參與稅區都係。
✗ B：唔係揀一個。
✓ C：Ch.17 ¶16。

items.title: 有人借錢俾一間 FI（例如買佢發行嘅債券）。按 IRD Guidance，呢個係咩權益？
items.short: 債務權益
items.detail: 債務權益冇喺 AEOI 定義，按香港法例判斷。

quotes.text: For the purpose of paragraphs (c) and (d) of the definition of financial account, any loan by a lender to a financial institution creates a debt interest in the financial institution.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 喺該 FI 嘅債務權益（debt interest）
items.explain:
債務權益冇喺 AEOI 定義，按香港法例判斷。
✗ A：借貸產生債務權益。
✗ B：唔係。
✓ C：Ch.17 ¶19。

items.title: 信託（FI）嘅受益人係一間上市公司（唔係 reportable person 定義下嘅 person）。IRD 對 look-through 嘅理解係？
items.short: 唔使 look through 被排除嘅人

quotes.text: Currently, it is the understanding of the IRD that the term “entity” used here does not include a person excluded from the definition of reportable person.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。
options: 一定要 look through 到上市公司股東
當上市公司係 reportable person
「entity」唔包括被排除喺 reportable person 定義之外嘅人，所以唔使 look through
option_explains: IRD 理解唔包括呢類人。
items.explain:
✗ A：IRD 理解唔包括呢類人。
✗ B：佢被排除。
✓ C：Ch.17 ¶20、¶23。

items.title: 信託要 look through 實體 settlor／受益人搵 controlling person。IRD Guidance 話呢個責任應該點對應？
items.short: 對應 AML/KYC 實益擁有人識別

quotes.text: The look through obligation should correspond to the obligation to identify the beneficial owner of a trust under AML/KYC procedures.
In respect of pre-existing accounts, reporting financial institutions may rely on the information collected in connection with the account pursuant to their AML/KYC procedures.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。

items.title: 新實體帳戶：一間上市公司（publicly traded corporation）嘅 self-cert 顯示佢係某申報稅區居民。RFI 一定要當 reportable account 嗎？
items.short: 唔一定：可合理斷定唔係 reportable person
items.detail: IRD Guidance Ch.12 ¶6：例外——憑手上或公開資料可合理斷定持有人唔係 reportable person，例如上市公司或政府實體。

quotes.text: If the self-certification indicates that the account holder is resident in a reportable jurisdiction, the reporting financial institution must treat the account as a reportable account. An exception applies where the financial institution can reasonably determine, based on information in its possession, or that is publicly available that the account holder is not a reportable person in respect to that jurisdiction. For example, where the entity is a corporation that is publicly traded, or is a government entity.

items.caveat: IRD Guidance for Financial Institutions（2016）嘅行政指引，唔係條例原文；以 IRD 最新版指引為準。

一定唔使報，因為所有實體都唔使報

items.title: HKRCASP 一個海外分部，按當地法例唔使行符合 FATF Recommendations 嘅 AML/KYC 程序。佢要識別實體 user 嘅 controlling persons，應該點做？

quotes.text: an HKRCASP may rely on the information collected and maintained pursuant to AML/KYC procedures provided that such procedures are consistent with the FATF Recommendations. items.title: 平台處理一個 NFT：唔代表金融資產，唔係以投資產品推銷，唔屬 FATF virtual asset，成交價從未超過 USD 200，亦冇實質成交量。可唔可以判定佢唔可以用作付款或投資？
items.short: 可以：4 個條件都符合
items.detail: CARF FAQ Sec IV Q5：唔代表金融資產或 fungible crypto、唔以投資產品推銷或受金融監管、唔係 FATF virtual asset、低價值（例如未試過以超過 USD 200 成交）同冇實質成交量，就可以 adequately determine 唔可以用作付款或投資。FAQ 話各地可以自行界定「low value」；IRD 未見有講。

quotes.text: it does not represent Financial Assets or fungible Crypto-Assets; 2. it is not marketed as an investment product or subject to financial regulation; 3. it is not a virtual asset for AML/KYC purposes pursuant to the FATF Recommendations; and 4. based on the reasonable knowledge of the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider at the time of the reporting, it has a low value (e.g. it has not traded at a value exceeding USD 200) and no meaningful trading volume in terms of value and number of transactions.

option_explains: 啱：CARF FAQ Sec IV Q5 嘅 4 個條件。
錯：符合 FAQ 條件嘅 NFT 可以判定唔係。
錯：non-fungible 本身唔足夠；要睇 4 個條件。
options: 可以：4 個條件都符合
唔可以：所有 NFT 一律係 relevant crypto-asset
可以，但只因為佢係 non-fungible
items.explain: CARF FAQ Sec IV Q5：唔代表金融資產或 fungible crypto、唔以投資產品推銷或受金融監管、唔係 FATF virtual asset、低價值（例如未試過以超過 USD 200 成交）同冇實質成交量，就可以 adequately determine 唔可以用作付款或投資。FAQ 話各地可以自行界定「low value」；IRD 未見有講。

items.title: 穩定幣發行人收合理贖回費、只喺辦公時間處理贖回。佢仲可唔可以符合 SEMP「隨時按面值贖回」條件？
items.short: 可以，只要呢啲程序性限制唔損害按面值贖回
items.detail: CARF FAQ Sec IV Q7：發行人按適用法律受到嘅程序性同審慎性限制，只要唔損害 par redemption，就同 (e) 項兼容，例如合理贖回費、AML/CFT 檢查、限辦公時間。

quotes.text: Procedural and prudential restrictions or conditions that are applicable in accordance with the laws to which the issuer is subject, are compatible with the requirements set out in Section IV(A)(4)(e) of the CARF and Section VIII(A)(9)(e) of the amended CRS, provided they do not undermine par redemption.

This may include, for instance, the application of reasonable redemption fees, AML/CFT or other checks for illegal activity, or the limitation of redemption to business hours or designated customer service channels.

option_explains: 錯：FAQ 例子包括合理贖回費。
錯：FAQ 例子包括限於辦公時間。
options: 可以，只要呢啲程序性限制唔損害按面值贖回
唔可以，有任何收費就唔係 SEMP
唔可以，一定要 24 小時贖回

items.title: Crypto-asset user 由幾時起被當作 reportable user？
items.short: 按盡職審查識別出佢係 reportable user 嗰日起
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 2 s.1：crypto-asset user 由按 Part 2–6 盡職審查被識別為 reportable user 嗰日起，當作 reportable user。

quotes.text: A crypto-asset user is treated as a reportable user as from the date it is identified as such pursuant to the due diligence requirements under this Part and Parts 3, 4, 5 and 6 of this Schedule.

options: 按盡職審查識別出佢係 reportable user 嗰日起

items.title: Part 8B（CARF）嘅「controlling person」定義喺邊度搵？
items.short: s.50M(1) 直接借用 s.50A(1)（CRS）嘅定義
items.detail: s.50M(1)：controlling person has the meaning given by section 50A(1)，即同 CRS 一樣嘅定義。識別時可以依賴符合 FATF 嘅 AML/KYC 資料（Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.4）。

quotes.text: controlling person (控權人) has the meaning given by section 50A(1);

an HKRCASP may rely on the information collected and maintained pursuant to AML/KYC procedures provided that such procedures are consistent with the FATF Recommendations. (2) If the HKRCASP is not legally required to apply AML/KYC procedures that are consistent with the FATF Recommendations, the HKRCASP must apply substantially similar procedures for the purpose of determining the controlling persons.

option_explains: 啱：s.50M(1) 原文 has the meaning given by section 50A(1)。
錯：Pt 4 講點判斷 CP，冇另立定義。

quotes.text: The Commissioner may, either generally or in a particular case, accept a return for the purposes of section 50Q(1) despite a requirement under subsection (2) or (5) not being complied with in relation to the return.

items.title: 一個 reportable user 嘅居民地唔發 TIN。HKRCASP 報表 TIN 欄可以留空，係邊條容許？
items.detail: s.50R(14)(a)：有關 reportable jurisdiction 唔發 TIN，或者發但本地法例唔要求收集，就唔使報 TIN。收集層面對應 Sch 17EA Pt 5 s.4。

quotes.text: no TIN is required to be reported if— (i) a TIN is not issued by the relevant reportable jurisdiction; or (ii) where a TIN is issued by the relevant reportable jurisdiction—such TIN is not required to be collected under the domestic law of the jurisdiction;

option_explains: 啱：唔發 TIN，或本地法例唔要求收集，就唔使報 TIN。
錯：s.50R(13) 講金額要標明貨幣。

items.title: CARF 報表 relevant crypto-asset 嘅名稱，OECD FAQ 建議點填？

items.title: 實體 user 換咗 controlling person，新 CP 係外國稅務居民。HKRCASP 知道之後，原 self-cert 可唔可以繼續依賴？
items.short: 唔可以；要攞有效 self-cert，或者合理解釋同文件
