quotes.text: there is a change of circumstances with respect to the user or controlling person that causes the HKRCASP to know, or to have reason to know, that the original self-certification is incorrect or unreliable, the HKRCASP— (a) cannot rely on the original self-certification;

items.title: 平台嘅財務經理意圖詐騙，叫系統喺 CARF 報表將一批客戶交易報細。佢本人經公訴程序定罪，最高刑罰係？
items.short: 第 5 級罰款同監禁 3 年
items.detail: s.80S(1)–(2)：HKRCASP 嘅僱員、為 HKRCASP 工作（service provider 以外）或參與管理嘅人，如果意圖詐騙，導致或容許 HKRCASP 喺報表提供重要事項上誤導、虛假或不準確嘅資料，就係犯罪。s.80S(3)：簡易程序第 3 級罰款同監禁 6 個月；公訴程序第 5 級罰款同監禁 3 年。

on summary conviction— (i) to a fine at level 3; and (ii) to imprisonment for 6 months; or (b) on conviction on indictment— (i) to a fine at level 5; and (ii) to imprisonment for 3 years.

items.title: 一間公司 2027 年停止做 HKRCASP，冇合理辯解冇喺 1 個月內通知 Commissioner。後果？
items.short: 屬 s.80T 罪行：第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令佢限期補做
items.detail: s.50S(4)：停止做 HKRCASP 要喺 1 個月內通知。s.80T(1)–(2)：曾經係 HKRCASP 嘅人冇合理辯解唔遵守 s.50S(4) 或 (6)，屬犯罪，第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令佢限期做返；唔遵守法庭命令就係第 4 級（s.80T(3)）。

quotes.text: If an individual or entity ceases to be an HKRCASP, the individual or entity must give a notice of the cessation to the Commissioner within 1 month after the cessation.

An individual or entity that was an HKRCASP commits an offence if the individual or entity, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with section 50S(4) or (6) or a requirement under section 50S(12). (2) An individual or entity that commits an offence under subsection (1) for failing to do an act is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3, and the court may order the individual or entity to do the act within the time specified in the order.

option_explains: 錯：s.80T 針對「曾經係 HKRCASP」嘅人。
options: 屬 s.80T 罪行：第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令佢限期補做
items.explain: s.50S(4)：停止做 HKRCASP 要喺 1 個月內通知。s.80T(1)–(2)：曾經係 HKRCASP 嘅人冇合理辯解唔遵守 s.50S(4) 或 (6)，屬犯罪，第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令佢限期做返；唔遵守法庭命令就係第 4 級（s.80T(3)）。

items.title: HKRCASP 外判登記俾 service provider，SP 冇合理辯解冇幫佢喺限期前登記。邊個有刑事責任？
items.short: 兩者都可能：HKRCASP 仍然要負責；SP 本身亦犯 s.80V(1)
items.detail: s.50U(2)：聘咗 SP 都唔解除 HKRCASP 嘅 s.50O(1) 登記責任；s.82E(2)：聘 SP 本身唔構成合理辯解。s.80V(1)：受聘做登記嘅 SP 冇合理辯解冇令 HKRCASP 登記，SP 都犯罪，第 3 級罰款（s.80V(7)）。

quotes.text: To avoid doubt, even if a service provider has been engaged, the HKRCASP is not relieved from the HKRCASP’s obligation under section 50O(1), 50P(1) or (2) or 50Q(1), as the case requires.

A person who is a service provider engaged to carry out an HKRCASP’s obligations under section 50O(1) commits an offence if the person, without reasonable excuse, fails to cause the HKRCASP to be registered as required by that section.
A person who commits an offence under subsection (1), (2), (3), (4), (5) or (6) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3.

option_explains: 錯：s.50U(2) 講明 HKRCASP 責任唔轉移。
錯：s.80V(1) 令 SP 本身都犯罪。
options: 兩者都可能：HKRCASP 仍然要負責；SP 本身亦犯 s.80V(1)
items.explain: s.50U(2)：聘咗 SP 都唔解除 HKRCASP 嘅 s.50O(1) 登記責任；s.82E(2)：聘 SP 本身唔構成合理辯解。s.80V(1)：受聘做登記嘅 SP 冇合理辯解冇令 HKRCASP 登記，SP 都犯罪，第 3 級罰款（s.80V(7)）。

items.title: 公司 HKRCASP 犯 s.80R 罪行，係得到某董事同意（consent）先發生。董事本人點？
items.short: 董事都犯同一罪行，罰則一樣
items.detail: s.80W：公司 HKRCASP（或受聘 SP）犯指明罪行，如果係得到董事或其他參與管理嘅高級人員同意或縱容（consent or connivance），嗰個人都犯同一罪行，罰則一樣。

quotes.text: the offence was committed with the consent or connivance of a director, or other officer concerned in the management, of the corporation or any person purporting to act as such director or officer (that person), the director or officer or that person, as the case requires, also commits the offence and is liable on conviction to the penalty provided for that offence.

option_explains: 錯：s.80W 令董事本身犯罪。
錯：s.80W 講董事或其他參與管理嘅高級人員。
options: 董事都犯同一罪行，罰則一樣
items.explain: s.80W：公司 HKRCASP（或受聘 SP）犯指明罪行，如果係得到董事或其他參與管理嘅高級人員同意或縱容（consent or connivance），嗰個人都犯同一罪行，罰則一樣。

items.title: IRD 可唔可以對 s.80R–80W 罪行和解（compound），唔上庭？
items.short: 可以：Commissioner 可以和解罪行，並可以喺判決前擱置或和解已提出嘅…
items.detail: s.80X(2)：Commissioner 可以就 s.80R、80S、80T、80U、80V 或 80W 嘅罪行作出和解（compound），亦可以喺判決前擱置或和解已提出嘅法律程序。另外 s.82E 係「代替檢控」嘅金錢罰則，兩樣唔同。

quotes.text: The Commissioner may compound an offence under section 80R, 80S, 80T, 80U, 80V or 80W, and may before judgment stay or compound any proceedings instituted for the offence.

options: 可以：Commissioner 可以和解罪行，並可以喺判決前擱置或和解已提出嘅法律程序
items.explain: s.80X(2)：Commissioner 可以就 s.80R、80S、80T、80U、80V 或 80W 嘅罪行作出和解（compound），亦可以喺判決前擱置或和解已提出嘅法律程序。另外 s.82E 係「代替檢控」嘅金錢罰則，兩樣唔同。

items.title: Assessor 想入 HKRCASP 辦公室檢查合規系統。HKRCASP 唔同意時間，最少要幾耐前通知？
items.short: 最少 7 日前
items.detail: s.51BB(2)：收到 assessor 通知，HKRCASP 或 SP 要讓 assessor 進入業務處所檢查 compliance system and process。s.51BB(4)：檢查只可以喺雙方同意嘅時間，或者最少 7 日前通知嘅時間進行；s.51BB(3)：只可以喺合理需要時發通知。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP or service provider must allow an assessor to enter their business premises, and inspect their compliance system and process for the purpose of checking whether they are carrying out or have carried out, or are likely to be able to carry out, the obligations under section 50P(1) or (2) or 50Q(1) if they receive a notice from an assessor requiring them to do so.

The inspection may only be carried out— (a) at a time agreed to by the HKRCASP or service provider to whom the notice is given; or (b) on a notice given to the HKRCASP or service provider at least 7 days before the time of the inspection.
The notice under subsection (2) may be given only if the inspection is reasonably required for the purposes specified in that subsection.

option_explains: 錯：要雙方同意時間或最少 7 日前通知。
items.explain: s.51BB(2)：收到 assessor 通知，HKRCASP 或 SP 要讓 assessor 進入業務處所檢查 compliance system and process。s.51BB(4)：檢查只可以喺雙方同意嘅時間，或者最少 7 日前通知嘅時間進行；s.51BB(3)：只可以喺合理需要時發通知。

items.title: IRD 檢查期間，assessor 認為 HKRCASP 嘅 self-cert 流程好可能做唔到 s.50P 要求。Assessor 可以點？
items.short: 發通知要求 HKRCASP 喺合理時間內、按指明方式做指明行動，糾正合規系統
items.detail: s.51BB(6)：檢查時 assessor 認為 HKRCASP 或 SP 好可能未能履行 s.50P(1)/(2) 或 s.50Q(1)，可以發通知要求佢喺合理時間內、按指明方式採取必要行動糾正 compliance system and process。SP 唔遵守呢個通知亦屬 s.80V(6) 罪行。

quotes.text: If, during the inspection, an assessor is of the opinion that the HKRCASP or service provider is likely to fail to carry out the obligations under section 50P(1) or (2) or 50Q(1), the assessor may give notice to the HKRCASP or service provider, as the case may be, requiring the HKRCASP or service provider, to take, within a reasonable time and in a manner specified in the notice, any action as specified in the notice that is necessary for rectifying their compliance system and process.

A person who is a service provider commits an offence if the person, without reasonable excuse— (a) fails to comply with a requirement of a notice given to the person under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6); or (b) obstructs or hinders an assessor in the exercise of the powers under section 51BB(2).

option_explains: 錯：s.82E 只可以由 Commissioner 或副局長親自評定。
options: 即時評定 s.82E 罰款
發通知要求 HKRCASP 喺合理時間內、按指明方式做指明行動，糾正合規系統
冇權做任何嘢，只可以寫報告
items.explain: s.51BB(6)：檢查時 assessor 認為 HKRCASP 或 SP 好可能未能履行 s.50P(1)/(2) 或 s.50Q(1)，可以發通知要求佢喺合理時間內、按指明方式採取必要行動糾正 compliance system and process。SP 唔遵守呢個通知亦屬 s.80V(6) 罪行。

items.title: 公司 2028 年停咗做 HKRCASP 並已通知 IRD；2030 年 3 月 1 日再開始做。要幾時通知？

items.title: Reportable user 係 A 國同 B 國雙重稅務居民（兩地都係 reportable jurisdiction）。報表報邊個 TIN？
items.short: 每個 reportable jurisdiction 各自嘅 TIN
items.detail: OECD Commentary on Section II ¶3：要報嘅 TIN 係居民地（唔係來源地）發出嘅；有多於一個居民地，就要報每個 reportable jurisdiction 嘅 TIN。香港 Sch 17EA Pt 5 s.5：self-cert 要包括每個 reportable jurisdiction 嘅 TIN（Pt 5 s.4 例外除外）。

quotes.text: The TIN to be reported is the TIN assigned to the Reportable Person by its jurisdiction of residence (i.e. not by a jurisdiction of source). In the case of a Reportable Person that is identified as having more than one jurisdiction of residence, the TIN to be reported is the Reportable Person’s TIN with respect to each Reportable Jurisdiction.

the self-certification must, subject to section 4 of this Part, include the user’s or controlling person’s TIN with respect to the reportable jurisdiction and, if any, each other reportable jurisdiction.

items.title: OECD CARF XML 入面，雙重居民實體 user 嘅 ResCountryCode 點填？
items.short: ResCountryCode 可以重複，識別到嘅所有稅務居民地都要報
items.detail: OECD CARF XML Schema User Guide（2025 年 7 月）：ResCountryCode 係可重複元素；實體 crypto-asset user 一定要有，並要對應盡職審查識別到嘅稅務居民地；識別到多於一個就全部都要報。香港 IRD 未公佈自己嘅 schema（U4），以上係 OECD 版本。

quotes.text: This repeatable data element describes the residence country code(s) of the Entity. In case of an Entity Crypto-Asset User this should always be present and should correspond to the jurisdiction(s) of tax residence identified on the basis of the due diligence requirements of the CARF. When more than one jurisdiction of tax residence is identified, all such jurisdictions should be reported.

items.title: 經紀 A 收客戶落單，交俾交易平台 B 執行。A 同 B 都係 RCASP。兩間都要各自做全套盡職審查？
items.short: 可以指定其中一間 RCASP 負責全部盡職審查，但責任仍然喺各 RCASP
items.detail: OECD Commentary on Section III ¶54–55：同一宗 relevant transaction 可能有多於一個 RCASP（例如經紀同平台）；Section III(D)(2) 容許指定單一 RCASP 履行全部盡職審查，避免重複。不過依賴第三方時，責任仍然喺各 RCASP。香港 s.50Y：Part 8B 要按 CARF publications 一致咁解讀。

quotes.text: Subparagraph D(2) allows Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers to designate a single Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider to comply with all due diligence requirements, in case multiple Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers provide services effectuating the same Relevant Transaction.

A Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider may rely on a third party to fulfil the due diligence obligations set out in this Section III, but such obligations remain the responsibility of the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider.

option_explains: 錯：OECD 容許指定一間做。
啱：OECD Commentary on Section III ¶55；Section III(D)(2)。
錯：盡職審查一定要有人做。

the HKRCASP must treat the entity crypto-asset user or controlling person as a resident for tax purposes in— (a) the jurisdiction or jurisdictions in which the user or controlling person claimed to be a resident for tax purposes in the original self- certification; and (b) the jurisdiction or jurisdictions in which the user or controlling person may be a resident for tax purposes as a result of the change of circumstances.

items.title: Assessor 發 s.50S(11) 通知，要求 HKRCASP 提供資料。呢類通知可以為咗查咩？
items.short: 確定 HKRCASP 嘅 s.50N nexus，或者佢 s.50Q(1) 報…
items.detail: s.50S(11)：assessor 可以向 HKRCASP、曾經係 HKRCASP 嘅人、specified officer 或 designated officer 發通知，要求提供資料，以確定 HKRCASP 嘅 s.50N nexus，或者 s.50Q(1) 報表資料是否準確完整。s.50S(12)：要喺通知指明期間內、按指明方式同形式遵守。

quotes.text: An assessor may give a notice to an HKRCASP, an individual or entity that was an HKRCASP, a specified officer or a designated officer (if any) requiring the HKRCASP, the individual or entity or the officer concerned (as the case may be) to provide information for the purposes of ascertaining— (a) the nexus of the HKRCASP under any provision of section 50N; or (b) whether any information in a return furnished under section 50Q(1) by the HKRCASP is accurate and complete.
must comply with a notice under subsection (11)— (a) within the period specified in the notice; and (b) by the means and in the form (if any) specified in the notice.

option_explains: 錯：s.50S(11) 針對 CARF nexus 同報表準確性。
錯：對象包括現時同以前嘅 HKRCASP、specified officer 同 designated officer。
options: 只可以查 HKRCASP 嘅利得稅
確定 HKRCASP 嘅 s.50N nexus，或者佢 s.50Q(1) 報表資料是否準確完整

items.title: 一間交易平台為客戶進行 crypto 兌換。佢會唔會單憑呢項服務，就屬 investment entity 定義 (d)(iii) 嘅「otherwise investing in, administering, or managing…」？
items.short: 唔會：s.50M(10)(c) 講明呢句唔包括為客戶進行兌換交易嘅服務
items.detail: s.50M(10)(c)：investment entity 定義 (d)(iii)「otherwise investing in, administering, or managing financial assets, money or relevant crypto-assets on behalf of other entities or individuals」唔包括為客戶或代客戶進行兌換交易嘅服務。即係純粹做兌換嘅 RCASP，唔會單憑呢點變成 investment entity。

quotes.text: the words “otherwise investing in, administering, or managing financial assets, money or relevant crypto-assets on behalf of other entities or individuals” do not include the provision of service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers;

option_explains: 錯：牌照係 (a)、(b) 嘅問題，唔係 (d)(iii)。
options: 會，兌換服務就係代客管理 crypto
唔會：s.50M(10)(c) 講明呢句唔包括為客戶進行兌換交易嘅服務
要睇佢有冇證監會牌照
items.explain: s.50M(10)(c)：investment entity 定義 (d)(iii)「otherwise investing in, administering, or managing financial assets, money or relevant crypto-assets on behalf of other entities or individuals」唔包括為客戶或代客戶進行兌換交易嘅服務。即係純粹做兌換嘅 RCASP，唔會單憑呢點變成 investment entity。

items.title: 實體 user 係一個由持牌資產管理公司管理、收入主要嚟自買賣 crypto 嘅基金（investment entity 定義 (e)）。佢係咪 excluded person？
items.short: 唔係：(e) 類 investment entity 唔屬 excluded …
items.detail: s.50M(1) excluded person (f)：financial institution 係 excluded person，但 investment entity 定義 (e)（由 FI 管理、總收入主要來自投資或買賣金融資產或 relevant crypto-assets 嘅實體）除外。呢類實體唔係 active entity，就要按 Sch 17EA Pt 4 判斷佢本身同 CP。

quotes.text: an entity the stock of which is regularly traded on one or more established securities markets; (b) an entity that is a related entity of an entity described in paragraph (a); (c) a governmental entity; (d) an international organization; (e) a central bank; or (f) a financial institution other than an entity described in paragraph (e) of the definition of investment entity in this subsection;

an entity— (i) that is managed by a custodial institution, a depository institution, a specified insurance company, or an entity mentioned in paragraph (a), (b), (c) or (d); and (ii) whose gross income is primarily attributable to investing, reinvesting, or trading in financial assets or relevant crypto-assets,

option_explains: 錯：s.50M(1) excluded person (f) 排除 (e) 類 investment entity。
錯：受管理正正係 (e) 類，唔屬 excluded person。
options: 係，所有 financial institution 都係 excluded person
唔係：(e) 類 investment entity 唔屬 excluded person，所以可能係 reportable user，亦可能要睇 CP
係，因為佢有持牌公司管理
items.explain: s.50M(1) excluded person (f)：financial institution 係 excluded person，但 investment entity 定義 (e)（由 FI 管理、總收入主要來自投資或買賣金融資產或 relevant crypto-assets 嘅實體）除外。呢類實體唔係 active entity，就要按 Sch 17EA Pt 4 判斷佢本身同 CP。

items.title: 揾錯處：「公司網站寫明佢係貿易公司，所以我哋唔使攞 self-cert 都可以判定佢係 active entity，唔使識別 CP。」
items.short: 錯：要根據 user 提供嘅 self-cert 判定佢係 active en…
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.3：對 excluded person 以外嘅實體 user，HKRCASP 要判斷佢有冇屬 reportable person 嘅 CP，除非「on the basis of a self-certification provided by the user」判定佢係 active entity。網站資料可以用嚟確認合理，但唔可以代替 self-cert。

quotes.text: an HKRCASP must determine whether the user has one or more controlling persons who are reportable persons unless the HKRCASP determines that the user is an active entity on the basis of a self- certification provided by the user.

option_explains: 錯：Pt 4 s.3 要根據 user 提供嘅 self-cert 判定 active entity。
錯：excluded person 同（按 self-cert）active entity 唔使。
options: 錯：要根據 user 提供嘅 self-cert 判定佢係 active entity，先可以唔使判斷 CP
錯：所有實體都一定要識別 CP
items.explain: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.3：對 excluded person 以外嘅實體 user，HKRCASP 要判斷佢有冇屬 reportable person 嘅 CP，除非「on the basis of a self-certification provided by the user」判定佢係 active entity。網站資料可以用嚟確認合理，但唔可以代替 self-cert。

items.title: 一間物流公司用區塊鏈記錄貨品由工廠到倉庫嘅每個步驟，記錄唔代表貨品擁有權。呢啲鏈上記錄係咪 CARF crypto-asset？
items.short: 唔係，因為記錄唔代表價值，亦唔轉移擁有權
items.detail: Ord 8 s.50M(1) 嘅 crypto-asset 首先要係「digital representation of value」。Commentary on Section IV ¶5：唔係價值表示嘅密碼學用途唔係 crypto-asset，例子係記錄產品製造、儲存、運送嘅不可改記錄，而記錄唔賦予產品擁有權。s.50Y 要求 Part 8B 同 CARF publications 一致解釋。

quotes.text: Other uses of cryptographic technology that are not digital representations of value, are not Crypto-Assets.
create a decentralized immutable record of activities or materials involved in making, storing, shipping or delivering a product, where the record does not convey any ownership rights in such product

means a digital representation of value— (i) that relies on a cryptographically secured distributed ledger or a similar technology to validate and secure transactions; and (ii) the ownership of which, or the right to which, can be traded or transferred to another individual or entity in a digital manner;

option_explains: 錯：用咗密碼學唔等於係 crypto-asset，關鍵係有冇「digital representation of value」。
錯：節點數目同定義無關。
啱：Commentary on Section IV ¶5 明確將呢類供應鏈記錄排除。
options: 係，因為用咗密碼學同分散式帳本
要睇記錄有幾多個節點驗證
唔係，因為記錄唔代表價值，亦唔轉移擁有權
items.explain: Ord 8 s.50M(1) 嘅 crypto-asset 首先要係「digital representation of value」。Commentary on Section IV ¶5：唔係價值表示嘅密碼學用途唔係 crypto-asset，例子係記錄產品製造、儲存、運送嘅不可改記錄，而記錄唔賦予產品擁有權。s.50Y 要求 Part 8B 同 CARF publications 一致解釋。

items.title: 揾錯處：「土地登記處用分散式帳本做聲明式業權紀錄，所以每筆紀錄都係 CARF crypto-asset。」
items.short: 錯：紀錄只係聲明擁有權、唔賦予擁有權，唔係 crypto-asset
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶5：用密碼學做「declarative record of ownership of assets（例如 real estate ledger）」，而紀錄本身唔賦予資產擁有權，就唔係 crypto-asset。重點係有冇可以數碼方式買賣或轉讓嘅價值（s.50M(1)）。

quotes.text: a declarative record of ownership of assets (such as a real estate ledger or similar agreement) where the record does not convey any ownership rights in the assets represented by such record.

means a digital representation of value— (i) that relies on a cryptographically secured distributed ledger or a similar technology to validate and secure transactions; and (ii) the ownership of which, or the right to which, can be traded or transferred to another individual or entity in a digital manner;

option_explains: 啱：Commentary on Section IV ¶5 嘅第二個例子。
錯：呢個係 financial asset 定義嘅排除，唔係 crypto-asset 測試嘅理由。
options: 錯：紀錄只係聲明擁有權、唔賦予擁有權，唔係 crypto-asset
冇錯，用 DLT 就一定係 crypto-asset
錯：因為土地屬 non-debt direct interest in real property，所以先唔係
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶5：用密碼學做「declarative record of ownership of assets（例如 real estate ledger）」，而紀錄本身唔賦予資產擁有權，就唔係 crypto-asset。重點係有冇可以數碼方式買賣或轉讓嘅價值（s.50M(1)）。

items.title: 交易平台客戶之間嘅 BTC 買賣只記喺平台內部帳簿（off-chain），冇上鏈。呢啲 BTC 仲係咪 crypto-asset？
items.short: 係：只要資產依賴密碼學分散式帳本或類似技術，唔理交易有冇真係上鏈
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶6：crypto-asset 要依賴密碼學保護嘅分散式帳本或類似技術嚟驗證同保障交易，「whether or not the transaction is actually recorded on such distributed ledger」。所以平台內部記帳嘅 BTC 交易仍然涉及 crypto-asset，可以係 relevant transaction。

quotes.text: a Crypto-Asset must rely on a cryptographically secured distributed ledger or similar technology to validate and secure transactions whether or not the transaction is actually recorded on such distributed ledger or similar technology.

means a digital representation of value— (i) that relies on a cryptographically secured distributed ledger or a similar technology to validate and secure transactions; and (ii) the ownership of which, or the right to which, can be traded or transferred to another individual or entity in a digital manner;

option_explains: 錯：Commentary ¶6 講明唔需要真係記喺分散式帳本。
錯：資產本身性質唔會因記帳方式改變。
options: 唔係，冇記錄喺區塊鏈就唔算
係：只要資產依賴密碼學分散式帳本或類似技術，唔理交易有冇真係上鏈
只有提幣上鏈嗰筆先算
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶6：crypto-asset 要依賴密碼學保護嘅分散式帳本或類似技術嚟驗證同保障交易，「whether or not the transaction is actually recorded on such distributed ledger」。所以平台內部記帳嘅 BTC 交易仍然涉及 crypto-asset，可以係 relevant transaction。

items.title: 一種 token 唔係用區塊鏈，而係用另一種軟件技術，但同樣可以去中心化咁驗證同保障交易。佢可唔可以係 crypto-asset？
items.short: 可以：呢類技術屬「similar technology」
items.detail: s.50M(1) crypto-asset 定義包括依賴「a cryptographically secured distributed ledger or a similar technology」嘅價值表示。Commentary on Section IV ¶8：唔理用咩軟件，只要底層技術容許以去中心化或去中介方式驗證同保障數碼交易，就算係 similar technology。

quotes.text: means a digital representation of value— (i) that relies on a cryptographically secured distributed ledger or a similar technology to validate and secure transactions; and (ii) the ownership of which, or the right to which, can be traded or transferred to another individual or entity in a digital manner;

Regardless of the type of software used, if the technology underpinning the Crypto-Asset allows for validating and securing digital transactions in a decentralised or disintermediated manner, it is considered a similar technology to a cryptographically secured distributed ledger.

option_explains: 錯：s.50M(1) 寫明「or a similar technology」。
錯：法例冇呢種認可制度。
啱：Commentary on Section IV ¶8，軟件種類唔重要。
options: 唔可以，s.50M(1) 只講 distributed ledger
只有 IRD 公告認可嘅技術先可以
items.explain: s.50M(1) crypto-asset 定義包括依賴「a cryptographically secured distributed ledger or a similar technology」嘅價值表示。Commentary on Section IV ¶8：唔理用咩軟件，只要底層技術容許以去中心化或去中介方式驗證同保障數碼交易，就算係 similar technology。

items.title: 一隻純支付用途嘅 token（唔代表對任何人嘅申索、會籍或財產權利），只係用嚟儲值同付款。佢係咪 crypto-asset？
items.short: 係：可以儲值同付款嘅密碼學 token 就係 crypto-asset
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶2：一隻以密碼學為基礎、可以儲值同付款、但唔代表任何申索或權利嘅 token，係 crypto-asset。s.50M(1)(a) 嘅核心係價值表示加上可以數碼方式買賣或轉讓。

quotes.text: a token based on cryptography that allows individuals to store value, engage in payments and that does not represent any claims or rights of memberships against a person, rights to property or other absolute or relative rights is a Crypto-Asset.

means a digital representation of value— (i) that relies on a cryptographically secured distributed ledger or a similar technology to validate and secure transactions; and (ii) the ownership of which, or the right to which, can be traded or transferred to another individual or entity in a digital manner;

option_explains: 啱：Commentary on Section IV ¶2 嘅例子。
錯：Commentary ¶2 講明冇代表權利都可以係 crypto-asset。
錯：定義冇要求有發行人。
options: 係：可以儲值同付款嘅密碼學 token 就係 crypto-asset
唔係，因為冇代表任何權利
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶2：一隻以密碼學為基礎、可以儲值同付款、但唔代表任何申索或權利嘅 token，係 crypto-asset。s.50M(1)(a) 嘅核心係價值表示加上可以數碼方式買賣或轉讓。

items.title: 一隻 security token 代表公司股份，可以喺平台用 USDT 或港元數碼兌換。按 Ord 8，佢係咪 crypto-asset？
items.short: 係：代表權利、又可以數碼兌換法定貨幣或其他 crypto-asset 嘅 to…
items.detail: s.50M(1) crypto-asset (b)(i)：包括代表對個人或實體嘅申索或會籍權利、財產權利或其他權利，而可以數碼兌換法定貨幣或其他 crypto-asset 嘅 cryptographic token。Commentary on Section IV ¶3 舉 security token 同衍生工具做例子。不過如果 token 只能經託管帳戶持有同轉讓（見 FAQ Section IV Q6），結論可能唔同。

quotes.text: a cryptographic token that represents claims or rights of membership against an individual or entity, rights to property or other absolute or relative rights, and that can be digitally exchanged for fiat currencies or other crypto-assets; and (ii) fungible and non-fungible tokens that can be traded or transferred to another individual or entity in a digital manner;

a cryptographic token that represents claims or rights of membership against an individual or Entity, rights to property or other absolute or relative rights (e.g. a security token or a derivative contract or right to purchase or sell an asset, including a Financial Asset and a Crypto-Asset, at a set date, price or other pre-determined factor), and that can be digitally exchanged for Fiat Currencies or other Crypto-Assets, is a Crypto-Asset.

option_explains: 錯：同一資產可以同時係 financial asset 同 crypto-asset。
錯：(b)(i) 正正包括代表權利嘅 token。
options: 唔係，股份係 financial asset，所以一定唔係 crypto-asset
係：代表權利、又可以數碼兌換法定貨幣或其他 crypto-asset 嘅 token 包括喺定義內
只有冇代表任何權利嘅 token 先係
items.explain: s.50M(1) crypto-asset (b)(i)：包括代表對個人或實體嘅申索或會籍權利、財產權利或其他權利，而可以數碼兌換法定貨幣或其他 crypto-asset 嘅 cryptographic token。Commentary on Section IV ¶3 舉 security token 同衍生工具做例子。不過如果 token 只能經託管帳戶持有同轉讓（見 FAQ Section IV Q6），結論可能唔同。

items.title: 一隻代幣化債券，因監管要求只可以經一間或多間託管機構嘅 custodial account 持有同轉讓，冇辦法去中介。按 OECD CARF FAQ，佢係咪 crypto-asset？
items.short: 唔係：去中介唔可能嘅代幣化金融資產唔屬 crypto-asset
items.detail: CARF FAQ Section IV Q6（2025 年 12 月）：如果代幣化 financial asset 因監管或法律原因只可以經存款或託管機構嘅 custodial account 持有同轉讓，冇去中介可能，就唔屬 CARF crypto-asset。s.50Y 要求按 CARF publications（包括 FAQ）一致解釋。佢仍然可能喺 CRS 下以 financial asset 申報。

quotes.text: a digitally issued or tokenised Financial Asset does not fall within the definition of Crypto- Asset under Section IV(A)(1) of the CARF and Section VIII(A)(12) of the amended CRS where such disintermediation is not possible since the asset can, for regulatory or other legal reasons, only be held by and transferred through Custodial Accounts maintained with one or more Depository or Custodial Institutions
This Part and Schedule 17EA are to be applied and interpreted in the way that best secures their consistency with the requirements and guidance in the CARF publications.

options: 係，所有代幣化資產都係
唔係：去中介唔可能嘅代幣化金融資產唔屬 crypto-asset
items.explain: CARF FAQ Section IV Q6（2025 年 12 月）：如果代幣化 financial asset 因監管或法律原因只可以經存款或託管機構嘅 custodial account 持有同轉讓，冇去中介可能，就唔屬 CARF crypto-asset。s.50Y 要求按 CARF publications（包括 FAQ）一致解釋。佢仍然可能喺 CRS 下以 financial asset 申報。

items.title: 同一隻代幣化債券，如果投資者可以自行喺公鏈錢包之間轉讓，唔使經託管機構。CARF 點睇？
items.short: 係 crypto-asset：唔符合 FAQ 嗰啲去中介限制條件，就屬 cry…
items.detail: CARF FAQ Section IV Q6：「Conversely, where the above conditions are not met, a digitally issued or tokenised Financial Asset qualifies as a Crypto-Asset」。可以自由喺錢包之間轉讓，即係可以去中介持有同轉讓，所以係 crypto-asset；佢亦可以係 financial asset。

quotes.text: Conversely, where the above conditions are not met, a digitally issued or tokenised Financial Asset qualifies as a Crypto-Asset under Section IV(A)(1) of the CARF

a cryptographic token that represents claims or rights of membership against an individual or entity, rights to property or other absolute or relative rights, and that can be digitally exchanged for fiat currencies or other crypto-assets; and (ii) fungible and non-fungible tokens that can be traded or transferred to another individual or entity in a digital manner;

items.title: User 1 用唔屬 SEMP 嘅穩定幣，經 RCASP 買入一單位 3 倍槓桿嘅 crypto-derivative token。報表要點反映？
items.short: 穩定幣處置同 derivative token 取得，兩邊都以公平市值（法定貨…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶3 Example 1：crypto-derivative token 係 relevant crypto-asset。用唔屬 SEMP 嘅穩定幣買入，會產生兩項 relevant transaction：User 1 處置穩定幣，同取得 Crypto-Derivative A，都以法定貨幣公平市值同單位數報（即 s.50R(3)(d)(iv)、(v) 嘅 crypto-to-crypto 類別）。

quotes.text: Disposal of the stablecoin by User 1, reported in Fiat Currency at the fair market value, along with the number of units; and 2. Acquisition of Crypto-Derivative A by User 1, reported in Fiat Currency at the fair market value, along with the number of units.

a cryptographic token that represents claims or rights of membership against an individual or Entity, rights to property or other absolute or relative rights (e.g. a security token or a derivative contract or right to purchase or sell an asset, including a Financial Asset and a Crypto-Asset, at a set date, price or other pre-determined factor), and that can be digitally exchanged for Fiat Currencies or other Crypto-Assets, is a Crypto-Asset.

option_explains: 錯：穩定幣係 relevant crypto-asset，佢嘅處置都要報。
錯：token 化衍生工具係 crypto-asset，呢個係 crypto-to-crypto 兌換。
options: 只報買入 derivative token，穩定幣唔使理
穩定幣處置同 derivative token 取得，兩邊都以公平市值（法定貨幣）連單位數報
當作 transfer，因為衍生工具唔係 crypto-asset
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶3 Example 1：crypto-derivative token 係 relevant crypto-asset。用唔屬 SEMP 嘅穩定幣買入，會產生兩項 relevant transaction：User 1 處置穩定幣，同取得 Crypto-Derivative A，都以法定貨幣公平市值同單位數報（即 s.50R(3)(d)(iv)、(v) 嘅 crypto-to-crypto 類別）。

items.title: 同一位 User 1 之後向發行人贖回 crypto-derivative token，收返穩定幣（價值高咗 30%）。要報咩？
items.short: derivative token 處置同穩定幣取得，都以法定貨幣公平市值同單位…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶3 Example 2：贖回並以穩定幣結算，涉及兩項 relevant transaction：處置 Crypto-Derivative A 同取得穩定幣，都以法定貨幣公平市值連單位數報。CARF 申報係總額同單位，唔計資本增值。

quotes.text: Disposal of Crypto-Derivative A, valued in Fiat Currency at its fair market value, along with the number of units; and 2. Acquisition of stablecoin, valued in Fiat Currency at their fair market value, along with the number of units.

option_explains: 錯：CARF 報總額，唔係計盈虧。
錯：用 token 換穩定幣係 crypto-to-crypto 兌換。
options: 贖回唔係兌換，所以唔使報
derivative token 處置同穩定幣取得，都以法定貨幣公平市值同單位數報

items.title: 傳統期貨合約到期要實物交收：買方付法定貨幣，賣方將 relevant crypto-asset B 轉入買方錢包，經 RCASP 執行。點報？
items.short: 賣方處置 B（按收到嘅法定貨幣）同買方取得 B（按支付嘅法定貨幣），都連單位數報
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶3 Example 3：傳統衍生合約以 relevant crypto-asset 實物交收，RCASP 協助嘅交收產生兩項交易：Seller 處置 B，按收到嘅法定貨幣報；Buyer 取得 B，按支付嘅法定貨幣報；都要連單位數。即 s.50R(3)(d)(ii)、(iii) 嘅 crypto-to-fiat 類別。

quotes.text: Disposal of Relevant Crypto-Asset B by Seller, reported at the Fiat Currency received, along with the number of units; and 2. Acquisition of Relevant Crypto-Asset B by Buyer, reported at the Fiat Currency paid, along with the number of units.

option_explains: 錯：交收時有 crypto-asset B 兌法定貨幣。
錯：買方取得 B 都要報。
options: 賣方處置 B（按收到嘅法定貨幣）同買方取得 B（按支付嘅法定貨幣），都連單位數報
期貨唔係 crypto-asset，所以全部唔使報
只報賣方，因為買方冇處置 crypto
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶3 Example 3：傳統衍生合約以 relevant crypto-asset 實物交收，RCASP 協助嘅交收產生兩項交易：Seller 處置 B，按收到嘅法定貨幣報；Buyer 取得 B，按支付嘅法定貨幣報；都要連單位數。即 s.50R(3)(d)(ii)、(iii) 嘅 crypto-to-fiat 類別。

items.title: 一份非代幣化嘅 BTC 期權合約（純粹傳統合約）。Ord 8 邊個定義將佢歸入 financial asset？
items.short: s.50M(1) financial asset (g)：relevant c…
items.detail: s.50M(1) financial asset (g)：包括「any interest (including a futures or forward contract or option) in relevant crypto-assets」。呢個定義對 active entity／investment entity 測試同 CRS 銜接有用。如果合約本身係可數碼兌換嘅 token，就另外可以係 crypto-asset（Commentary ¶3）。

quotes.text: any interest (including a futures or forward contract or option) in relevant crypto-assets, but does not include a non-debt direct interest in real property;

option_explains: 錯：呢個定義講 crypto-asset 嘅排除項。
啱：Ord 8 將 crypto 權益明文列入 financial asset。
錯：呢個係交易定義，唔係資產分類。
options: s.50M(1) financial asset (g)：relevant crypto-assets 嘅權益（包括期貨、遠期或期權）
items.explain: s.50M(1) financial asset (g)：包括「any interest (including a futures or forward contract or option) in relevant crypto-assets」。呢個定義對 active entity／investment entity 測試同 CRS 銜接有用。如果合約本身係可數碼兌換嘅 token，就另外可以係 crypto-asset（Commentary ¶3）。

items.title: 代表藝術品權利、可以喺網上轉讓俾其他人嘅 NFT，係咪 crypto-asset？
items.short: 係：crypto-asset 包括可數碼方式買賣或轉讓嘅 fungible 同…
items.detail: s.50M(1) crypto-asset (b)(ii) 包括可以數碼方式買賣或轉讓嘅 fungible 同 non-fungible token。Commentary on Section IV ¶4：包括代表收藏品、遊戲、藝術品、實物資產或金融文件權利嘅 NFT。至於係咪 relevant crypto-asset，就要另外睇能否用作付款或投資。

quotes.text: a cryptographic token that represents claims or rights of membership against an individual or entity, rights to property or other absolute or relative rights, and that can be digitally exchanged for fiat currencies or other crypto-assets; and (ii) fungible and non-fungible tokens that can be traded or transferred to another individual or entity in a digital manner;

the term “Crypto-Asset” encompasses both fungible and non-fungible tokens and therefore includes non-fungible tokens (NFTs) representing rights to collectibles, games, works of art, physical property or financial documents that can be traded or transferred to other individuals or Entities in a digital manner.

option_explains: 錯：藝術品、收藏品、遊戲 NFT 都包括。
options: 只有代表金融文件嘅 NFT 先係
係：crypto-asset 包括可數碼方式買賣或轉讓嘅 fungible 同 non-fungible token
items.explain: s.50M(1) crypto-asset (b)(ii) 包括可以數碼方式買賣或轉讓嘅 fungible 同 non-fungible token。Commentary on Section IV ¶4：包括代表收藏品、遊戲、藝術品、實物資產或金融文件權利嘅 NFT。至於係咪 relevant crypto-asset，就要另外睇能否用作付款或投資。

items.title: RCASP 除咗做 BTC 兌換，亦處理一啲經佢充分判斷「唔可以用作付款或投資」嘅 crypto-asset 嘅兌換。後者要唔要報？
items.short: 唔使：非 relevant crypto-asset 嘅兌換唔使申報
items.detail: s.50M(1) relevant crypto-asset 排除經 RCASP 充分判斷唔能夠用作付款或投資嘅 crypto-asset。Commentary on Section IV ¶9：即使某人因為做 relevant crypto-asset 兌換而係 RCASP，佢都唔使就非 relevant crypto-asset 嘅兌換申報。

quotes.text: relevant crypto-asset (相關加密資產) means a crypto-asset that is not— (a) a central bank digital currency; (b) a specified electronic money product; or (c) a crypto-asset that, as adequately determined by a reporting crypto-asset service provider, cannot be used for payment or investment purposes;
it would nevertheless not be required to report information with respect to exchanges carried out in Crypto-Assets that are not Relevant Crypto-Assets.

option_explains: 錯：只係 relevant crypto-asset 先要報。
options: 唔使：非 relevant crypto-asset 嘅兌換唔使申報
要，RCASP 嘅所有兌換都要報
items.explain: s.50M(1) relevant crypto-asset 排除經 RCASP 充分判斷唔能夠用作付款或投資嘅 crypto-asset。Commentary on Section IV ¶9：即使某人因為做 relevant crypto-asset 兌換而係 RCASP，佢都唔使就非 relevant crypto-asset 嘅兌換申報。

items.title: RCASP 要判斷一隻 token 能唔能夠用作付款或投資。OECD 建議第一步可以參考咩？
items.short: 為 AML/KYC 按 FATF Recommendations 判斷佢係唔係…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶10：RCASP 第一步可以依賴為 AML/KYC 目的、按 FATF Recommendations 判斷係咪 virtual asset 嘅分類。如果因為可以用作付款或投資而屬 virtual asset，就要當係 relevant crypto-asset。

quotes.text: Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers may, in a first step, rely on the classification of the Crypto-Asset that was made for the purpose of determining whether the Crypto-Asset is a virtual asset for AML/KYC purposes pursuant to the FATF Recommendations.

relevant crypto-asset (相關加密資產) means a crypto-asset that is not— (a) a central bank digital currency; (b) a specified electronic money product; or (c) a crypto-asset that, as adequately determined by a reporting crypto-asset service provider, cannot be used for payment or investment purposes;

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 話要睇實際功能，唔係用語。
options: Token 白皮書嘅市場推廣字眼
為 AML/KYC 按 FATF Recommendations 判斷佢係唔係 virtual asset 嘅分類
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶10：RCASP 第一步可以依賴為 AML/KYC 目的、按 FATF Recommendations 判斷係咪 virtual asset 嘅分類。如果因為可以用作付款或投資而屬 virtual asset，就要當係 relevant crypto-asset。

items.title: 揾錯處：「我哋唔肯定呢隻 token 可唔可以用嚟投資，所以先當佢唔係 relevant crypto-asset，等有證據先改。」
items.short: 錯：有疑問就要當 relevant crypto-asset；只有能夠正面確認…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶11：只有「唔能夠用作付款或投資」呢個測試可以正面確認，crypto-asset 先唔算 relevant crypto-asset；有疑問就要當係 relevant crypto-asset。s.50M(1) 用「as adequately determined」，即要有充分判斷。

quotes.text: Only when this test can be positively affirmed, the Crypto-Asset is not to be considered a Relevant Crypto-Asset. In case of doubts as to whether the Crypto-Asset can be used for payment or investment purposes, the Crypto-Asset is to be considered a Relevant Crypto-Asset.

relevant crypto-asset (相關加密資產) means a crypto-asset that is not— (a) a central bank digital currency; (b) a specified electronic money product; or (c) a crypto-asset that, as adequately determined by a reporting crypto-asset service provider, cannot be used for payment or investment purposes;

options: 錯：所有 token 都一定係 relevant crypto-asset
錯：有疑問就要當 relevant crypto-asset；只有能夠正面確認唔能夠用作付款或投資先排除
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶11：只有「唔能夠用作付款或投資」呢個測試可以正面確認，crypto-asset 先唔算 relevant crypto-asset；有疑問就要當係 relevant crypto-asset。s.50M(1) 用「as adequately determined」，即要有充分判斷。

items.title: 一隻 token 受金融監管、代表基金份額。OECD 點睇佢能否用作付款或投資？
items.short: 可以，所以係 relevant crypto-asset
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶12：代表 financial asset 或受金融監管嘅 crypto-asset 可以用作付款或投資，所以係 relevant crypto-asset。（如果佢只能經託管帳戶持有同轉讓，就要再睇 FAQ Section IV Q6 會唔會根本唔係 crypto-asset。）

quotes.text: Crypto-Assets that represent Financial Assets or are subject to financial regulation can be used for payment or investment purposes and are therefore to be considered Relevant Crypto- Assets.

option_explains: 啱：Commentary on Section IV ¶12 第一點。
錯：受監管正正係「可以用作投資」嘅指標。
options: 唔可以，受監管產品唔屬 CARF
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶12：代表 financial asset 或受金融監管嘅 crypto-asset 可以用作付款或投資，所以係 relevant crypto-asset。（如果佢只能經託管帳戶持有同轉讓，就要再睇 FAQ Section IV Q6 會唔會根本唔係 crypto-asset。）

items.title: 揾錯處：「呢個 NFT 系列官方定位係『數碼收藏品』，所以一定唔係 relevant crypto-asset。」
items.short: 錯：要睇 NFT 嘅性質同實際功能，唔係睇推廣用語；喺 marketplace…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶12：NFT 好多時以收藏品推銷，但呢個功能本身唔阻止佢用作付款或投資；要考慮 NFT 嘅性質同實際功能，唔係用咩術語或推廣字眼。喺 marketplace 交易嘅 NFT 可以用作付款或投資，所以係 relevant crypto-asset。

quotes.text: It is important to consider the nature of the NFT and its function in practice and not what terminology or marketing terms are used.
NFTs that are traded on a marketplace can be used for payment or investment purposes and are therefore to be considered Relevant Crypto-Assets.

option_explains: 錯：OECD 話收藏品定位本身唔排除。
錯：NFT 包括喺 crypto-asset 定義。
options: 錯：要睇 NFT 嘅性質同實際功能，唔係睇推廣用語；喺 marketplace 交易嘅 NFT 屬 relevant crypto-asset
錯：NFT 只要係 non-fungible 就一律唔使報
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶12：NFT 好多時以收藏品推銷，但呢個功能本身唔阻止佢用作付款或投資；要考慮 NFT 嘅性質同實際功能，唔係用咩術語或推廣字眼。喺 marketplace 交易嘅 NFT 可以用作付款或投資，所以係 relevant crypto-asset。

items.title: 航空公司將飛行里數 token 化，只可以喺佢嘅封閉網絡換機票，唔可以轉出、亦冇市場價買賣。一般嚟講係咪 relevant crypto-asset？
items.short: 一般唔係：封閉網絡、不能轉出或按市價買賣，通常唔能夠用作付款或投資
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶12：只可以喺有限固定網絡內兌換指定商品服務（例如飛行里數、會員獎賞），唔可以喺封閉系統外二手市場轉讓或兌換，亦唔可以喺系統內外按市價出售或兌換，一般唔能夠用作付款或投資。仍然要由 RCASP「adequately determine」（s.50M(1)）。

quotes.text: Provided these Crypto-Assets are characterised by operating in a limited fixed network or environment beyond which the Crypto-Assets cannot be transferred or exchanged in a secondary market outside of the closed-loop system, and cannot be sold or exchanged at a market rate inside or outside of the closed-loop, such Crypto-Assets would generally not be able to be used for payment or investment purposes.

relevant crypto-asset (相關加密資產) means a crypto-asset that is not— (a) a central bank digital currency; (b) a specified electronic money product; or (c) a crypto-asset that, as adequately determined by a reporting crypto-asset service provider, cannot be used for payment or investment purposes;

option_explains: 錯：封閉網絡、冇二手市場嘅情況 OECD 有特別講。
錯：有價值唔等於可以用作付款或投資。
啱：Commentary on Section IV ¶12 第三點。
options: 一般唔係：封閉網絡、不能轉出或按市價買賣，通常唔能夠用作付款或投資
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶12：只可以喺有限固定網絡內兌換指定商品服務（例如飛行里數、會員獎賞），唔可以喺封閉系統外二手市場轉讓或兌換，亦唔可以喺系統內外按市價出售或兌換，一般唔能夠用作付款或投資。仍然要由 RCASP「adequately determine」（s.50M(1)）。

items.title: 一個遊戲嘅道具 token 本來只喺遊戲內用，但遊戲開放咗外部交易所，玩家可以按市價賣出換 USDT。仲可唔可以用「封閉網絡」排除？
items.short: 唔可以：已經可以喺封閉系統外按市價兌換，唔符合封閉網絡條件
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶12：封閉網絡排除要求 crypto-asset 唔可以喺封閉系統外嘅二手市場轉讓或兌換，亦唔可以按市價出售或兌換。「goods and services」雖然包括遊戲等數碼商品，但一旦可以喺外部按市價換 USDT，就唔再符合，應當 relevant crypto-asset。

quotes.text: Provided these Crypto-Assets are characterised by operating in a limited fixed network or environment beyond which the Crypto-Assets cannot be transferred or exchanged in a secondary market outside of the closed-loop system, and cannot be sold or exchanged at a market rate inside or outside of the closed-loop, such Crypto-Assets would generally not be able to be used for payment or investment purposes.

In this context, the term “goods and services” may also include digital goods and services, such as digital music, games, books or other media, as well as tickets, software applications and online subscriptions.

option_explains: 錯：要睇而家嘅實際功能。
錯：Commentary 話數碼商品服務只係封閉網絡分析嘅一部分。
options: 唔可以：已經可以喺封閉系統外按市價兌換，唔符合封閉網絡條件
可以，因為發行時係遊戲道具
可以，數碼商品一律排除
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶12：封閉網絡排除要求 crypto-asset 唔可以喺封閉系統外嘅二手市場轉讓或兌換，亦唔可以按市價出售或兌換。「goods and services」雖然包括遊戲等數碼商品，但一旦可以喺外部按市價換 USDT，就唔再符合，應當 relevant crypto-asset。

items.title: Reportable user 經 RCASP 用 BTC 換某中央銀行發行嘅數碼貨幣（CBDC）。CARF 下呢筆交易屬咩類別？
items.short: BTC 兌法定貨幣嘅兌換（處置 BTC 換 fiat）
items.detail: s.50M(1)：CBDC 係中央銀行發行嘅數碼法定貨幣；fiat currency 定義明文包括 CBDC；relevant crypto-asset 排除 CBDC。Commentary on Section IV ¶13：CBDC 係法定貨幣嘅數碼形式。所以 BTC 換 CBDC 係 exchange transaction (a)，喺 s.50R(3)(d)(iii) 以收到嘅金額報。

quotes.text: central bank digital currency (中央銀行數碼貨幣) means a digital fiat currency issued by a central bank;

means the official currency of a jurisdiction which is issued by that jurisdiction or by that jurisdiction’s designated central bank or monetary authority, as represented by physical banknotes or coins or by money in different digital forms, including bank reserves and central bank digital currencies; and (b) includes commercial bank money and electronic money products (including specified electronic money products);
Central Bank Digital Currencies are not considered Relevant Crypto-Assets, given that they are a digital form of Fiat Currency.

option_explains: 啱：CBDC 屬 fiat currency，唔係 relevant crypto-asset。
錯：處置 BTC 換 fiat 係 exchange transaction。
options: BTC 兌法定貨幣嘅兌換（處置 BTC 換 fiat）
items.explain: s.50M(1)：CBDC 係中央銀行發行嘅數碼法定貨幣；fiat currency 定義明文包括 CBDC；relevant crypto-asset 排除 CBDC。Commentary on Section IV ¶13：CBDC 係法定貨幣嘅數碼形式。所以 BTC 換 CBDC 係 exchange transaction (a)，喺 s.50R(3)(d)(iii) 以收到嘅金額報。

items.title: 一隻穩定幣已經符合 SEMP 定義。客戶用 ETH 換呢隻穩定幣，CARF 下點分類？
items.short: 當作 ETH 兌 fiat currency 嘅兌換
items.detail: s.50M(1) fiat currency (b) 包括 specified electronic money products。Commentary on Section IV ¶34：符合 SEMP 嘅穩定幣當作 fiat currency。CARF FAQ Section IV Q8：涉及 SEMP 嘅兌換當作與法定貨幣兌換。所以係處置 ETH 換 fiat。

quotes.text: means the official currency of a jurisdiction which is issued by that jurisdiction or by that jurisdiction’s designated central bank or monetary authority, as represented by physical banknotes or coins or by money in different digital forms, including bank reserves and central bank digital currencies; and (b) includes commercial bank money and electronic money products (including specified electronic money products);
Accordingly, a stablecoin that qualifies as a Specified Electronic Money Product is treated as Fiat Currency.

From the date on which the definitional requirements for a Specified Electronic Money Product pursuant to Section IV(A)(4) of the CARF and Section VIII(A)(9) of the amended CRS are met, the product is excluded from the CARF. As a result, Exchange Transactions involving the product are to be treated as Exchanges with Fiat Currency for CARF purposes.

option_explains: 錯：ETH 嗰邊係 relevant crypto-asset，處置要報。
啱：SEMP 穩定幣當法定貨幣處理。
options: 當作 ETH 兌 fiat currency 嘅兌換
items.explain: s.50M(1) fiat currency (b) 包括 specified electronic money products。Commentary on Section IV ¶34：符合 SEMP 嘅穩定幣當作 fiat currency。CARF FAQ Section IV Q8：涉及 SEMP 嘅兌換當作與法定貨幣兌換。所以係處置 ETH 換 fiat。

items.title: 一隻 token 嘅價值掛鈎一籃子貨幣（例如 USD、EUR、JPY 加權）。佢可唔可以係 SEMP？

items.detail: s.50M(1) transfer：RCASP 按交易時所知未能確定係 exchange transaction，就屬 transfer。Commentary on Section IV ¶32：冇法定貨幣一方嘅可見度，交易仍然係 relevant transaction，但要以 transfer 報；Section II ¶16：分別喺 A(3)(g)、(h)（即 s.50R(3)(d)(vii)、(viii)）報。

quotes.text: transfer (轉讓) means a transaction that moves a relevant crypto-asset from or to the crypto-asset address or account of a crypto-asset user (other than one maintained by the reporting crypto-asset service provider on behalf of the same crypto-asset user) where, based on the knowledge available to the provider at the time of the transaction, the provider cannot determine that the transaction is an exchange transaction.
Such transactions would still be considered Relevant Transactions, but the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider would need to report such Relevant Transactions as Transfers.
Such transactions should be reported upon as Transfers sent to or by a Reportable User under subparagraphs A(3)(g) and A(3)(h), respectively.

items.title: 客戶喺平台用 relevant crypto-asset A 換 B。報表點樣反映？

items.title: 某 reportable jurisdiction 冇「稅號」制度，但會俾居民一個社會保障號碼作同等識別。HKRCASP 應該點處理 TIN？

items.detail: Commentary on Section II ¶3：「TIN」包括冇稅號時嘅 functional equivalent。Section IV ¶79：個人例子有 social security／insurance number、身份證號碼等；實體例子有商業登記號碼。

quotes.text: In this respect, the term “TIN” includes a functional equivalent in the absence of a Taxpayer Identification Number.

Examples of that type of number include, for individuals, a social security/insurance number, citizen/personal identification/service code/number, and resident registration number; and for Entities, a business/company registration code/number.

option_explains: 錯：有 functional equivalent 就應該用。
啱：Commentary on Section II ¶3 同 Section IV ¶79。
錯：護照號碼唔係 Commentary 舉嘅 functional equivalent。

quotes.text: a unique reference number, code or other confirmation received by a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider in respect of a Crypto-Asset User or a Controlling Person via a government verification service is also a functional equivalent to a TIN.

items.title: HKRCASP 係一間未有稅號、但有商業登記號碼嘅公司。報表入面佢自己嘅「identifying number」可以點填？
items.short: 可以用商業／公司登記號碼，或者 LEI；乜都冇就只報名稱同地址
items.detail: s.50R(1)：報表要包括 HKRCASP 嘅名稱、地址同識別號碼（如有）。Commentary on Section II ¶4：識別號碼係 TIN；冇 TIN 就可以用商業／公司登記號碼或 LEI；完全冇識別號碼就只需報名稱同地址。

quotes.text: A return furnished by an HKRCASP under section 50Q(4) must include the name, address and identifying number (if any) of the HKRCASP.

The “identifying number” of a Reporting Crypto- Asset Service Provider is one of the following types of numbers assigned to a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider for identification purposes: a TIN, or in the absence thereof, a business/company registration code/number, or a Global Legal Entity Identifier (LEI). If no identifying number is assigned to the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider, then only the name and address of the Reporting Crypto- Asset Service Provider are required to be reported.

option_explains: 錯：OECD 列明有其他號碼可用。

items.title: 點解 CARF 報表要包括 RCASP 本身嘅名稱、地址同識別號碼？
items.short: 等稅務機關識別資料來源，例如跟進可能導致報錯嘅錯誤
items.detail: Commentary on Section II ¶4：RCASP 嘅識別資料係為咗識別所申報同之後交換嘅資料來源，令提供資料嘅稅區可以跟進可能導致資料唔正確或唔完整嘅錯誤。s.50R(1) 有相應要求。

quotes.text: Identifying information on the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider is intended to allow the identification of the source of the information reported and subsequently exchanged in order to allow the providing jurisdiction to, e.g. follow-up on an error that may have led to incorrect or incomplete information reporting.

items.title: X 國以前冇俾某位居民 TIN，HKRCASP 一直冇報 TIN。2028 年 X 國向佢發出 TIN，佢喺更新 self-cert 時提供咗。之後點做？
items.short: 例外唔再適用，取得 TIN 之後要報
items.detail: s.50R(14)(a)(i)：TIN 唔係由 reportable jurisdiction 發出就唔使報。Commentary on Section II ¶29：「唔發 TIN」包括未向某個人發出 TIN；但一旦該稅區開始發出並向該人發出 TIN，而 RCASP 喺 self-cert 或其他途徑取得，就要報。

quotes.text: A TIN is considered not to be issued by a Reportable Jurisdiction (i) where the jurisdiction does not issue a TIN nor a functional equivalent in the absence of a TIN, or (ii) where the jurisdiction has not issued a TIN to a particular individual or Entity.
However, if and when a Reportable Jurisdiction starts issuing TINs and issues a TIN to a particular Reportable Person, the exception contained in paragraph B no longer applies

items.title: 某 reportable jurisdiction 嘅本地法律規定提供 TIN 屬自願，但客戶主動喺 self-cert 填咗 TIN。HKRCASP 要唔要報？
items.short: 要：客戶自願提供咗，就要報
items.detail: s.50R(14)(a)(ii)：如果該稅區本地法律唔要求收集 TIN，就唔使報。Commentary on Section II ¶30：RCASP 唔使主動取得，但如果 reportable person 選擇提供，RCASP 就一定要報（例子係 Australia）。

quotes.text: no TIN is required to be reported if— (i) a TIN is not issued by the relevant reportable jurisdiction; or (ii) where a TIN is issued by the relevant reportable jurisdiction—such TIN is not required to be collected under the domestic law of the jurisdiction; and (b) the place of birth is not required to be reported unless the HKRCASP is otherwise required to obtain and report it under the laws of Hong Kong and it is available in the electronically searchable data maintained by the HKRCASP.

However, the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider is not prevented from asking for, and collecting the Reportable Person’s TIN for reporting purposes if the Reportable Person chooses to provide it. In this case, the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider must report the TIN.

items.title: HKRCASP 開戶時用紙本表格收集咗客戶出生地點，但呢項資料冇入電子系統、唔可以電子檢索；香港法例亦冇另外要求佢取得同申報出生地點。要唔要報出生地點？

items.title: HKRCASP 經營交易平台，亦幫客戶轉出 ETH。ETH 喺佢平台經常有 ETH/HKD 成交。轉出嘅公平市值可以點定？

items.title: HKRCASP 冇某隻 token 嘅 trading pair 參考值，但會計系統有佢嘅帳面值。按 s.50R(10)，第一個要用嘅替代估值方法係？
items.short: HKRCASP 內部會計帳面值（book value）
items.detail: s.50R(10)：冇 trading pair 參考值時，依次用：(a) 內部會計帳面值；(b) 冇帳面值，就用可靠嘅第三方價格匯總網站；(c) 都冇，就用 HKRCASP 最近一次估值；(d) 仍然冇，先可以用合理估算。s.50R(11)：用咗替代方法就要申報所用方法；OECD XML 對應 AltValuation CARF1001 – Book value。

quotes.text: the internal accounting book values which the HKRCASP maintains with respect to the relevant crypto-asset must be used; (b) if a book value is not available—a value provided by third-party companies or websites that aggregate current prices of relevant crypto- assets must be used, provided that the valuation method used by that third party is reasonably expected to provide a reliable indicator of value; (c) if neither the valuation method mentioned in paragraph (a) nor that mentioned in paragraph (b) is available, the most recent valuation of the relevant crypto-asset by the HKRCASP must be used; and (d) if a value cannot be attributed by applying paragraphs (a), (b) and (c), a reasonable estimate may be applied as a measure of the last resort.
With respect to each relevant crypto-asset for which the HKRCASP has relied on an alternative valuation method mentioned in subsection (10), the method relied on must be reported.

items.title: 個人 reportable user 嘅居民地唔發 TIN。OECD CARF XML 嘅 TIN element 點填？
items.short: 填「NOTIN」，並將 unknown attribute 設為 true
items.detail: s.50R(14)(a)：TIN 唔由 reportable jurisdiction 發出，或者本地法律唔要求收集，就唔使報 TIN。OECD CARF XML：呢個情況 TIN 填「NOTIN」，並將 Unknown attribute 設為「true」。香港 IRD 未公佈自己嘅 CARF data schema（U4），以上係 OECD CARF XML Schema（2025 年 7 月）版本。

quotes.text: no TIN is required to be reported if— (i) a TIN is not issued by the relevant reportable jurisdiction; or (ii) where a TIN is issued by the relevant reportable jurisdiction—such TIN is not required to be collected under the domestic law of the jurisdiction; and (b) the place of birth is not required to be reported unless the HKRCASP is otherwise required to obtain and report it under the laws of Hong Kong and it is available in the electronically searchable data maintained by the HKRCASP.

In case an Individual Crypto-Asset User or Controlling Person does not have a TIN because one was not issued by the reportable jurisdiction or the domestic law of the reportable jurisdiction does not require the collection of the TIN, the value “NOTIN” should be entered and the Unknown attribute (see below) must be set to “true”.

option_explains: 錯：除非係該稅區嘅 functional equivalent。

items.title: OECD CARF XML：一位 user 有兩個 TIN（兩個居民地）。其中一個可唔可以標 unknown？
items.short: 唔可以：提供多於一個 TIN 時，任何一個都唔可以標 unknown
items.detail: OECD CARF XML Schema User Guide：「in case more than one TIN is provided, any provided element cannot be flagged as “unknown”」。TIN 嘅 issuedBy attribute 亦應該一直提供，除非 TIN 標 unknown。香港 IRD 未公佈自己嘅 CARF data schema（U4），以上係 OECD CARF XML Schema（2025 年 7 月）版本。

quotes.text: Furthermore, in case more than one TIN is provided, any provided element cannot be flagged as “unknown”.

items.title: 實體 reportable user（本身係申報對象）同個人 reportable user 比較，報表少咗邊項個人資料？
items.short: 出生日期同出生地點
items.detail: s.50R(3)(a)：個人 reportable user 要報姓名、地址、居民地、TIN、出生日期同地點。s.50R(3)(b)：實體 reportable user 只係名稱、地址、居民地同 TIN。但實體嘅 reportable CP 就要報佢哋嘅出生日期同地點（s.50R(3)(c)(ii)）。

quotes.text: if the crypto-asset user is an entity that is a reportable user—the name, address, jurisdiction of residence and TIN of the entity;

items.title: OECD XML：實體 user 係 A 國 reportable person，佢嘅 reportable CP 係 B 國居民（唔同國家）。實體資料點報？
items.short: 實體一定要另外以 reportable person 身份報
items.detail: OECD CARF XML Schema User Guide：實體同 CP 都係同一 reportable jurisdiction 居民，可以一齊報或分開報；如果冇 CP 同實體係同一稅區居民，實體資料一定要另外以 reportable person 身份報。香港 IRD 未公佈自己嘅 CARF data schema（U4），以上係 OECD CARF XML Schema（2025 年 7 月）版本。

quotes.text: Where none of such Controlling Persons is resident in the same Reportable Jurisdiction as the Entity, the information with respect to the Entity Crypto-Asset User must nevertheless be reported separately as an Entity that is a Reportable Person.

quotes.text: the information may be reported (i) together, as an Entity Crypto-Asset User with a Controlling Person that is a Reportable Person, or (ii) separately, as an Entity Crypto-Asset User that is a Reportable Person and a Controlling Person that is a Reportable Person.

items.title: OECD CARF XML：個人 user 嘅 ResCountryCode 包唔包括按某稅區稅法「被視為」居民嘅情況（例如外交人員）？
items.short: 包括；識別到多於一個居民地就全部都要報
items.detail: OECD CARF XML Schema User Guide：個人 ResCountryCode 要對應盡職審查識別到嘅稅務居民地，包括按稅法被視為居民嘅情況（例如外交人員或政府服務人員）；識別到多於一個，全部都要報。Commentary on Section II ¶2 亦要求報全部居民地。香港 IRD 未公佈自己嘅 CARF data schema（U4），以上係 OECD CARF XML Schema（2025 年 7 月）版本。

In the case of a Reportable Person that is identified as having more than one jurisdiction of residence, the jurisdictions of residence to be reported are all the jurisdictions of residence identified by the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider for the Reportable Person.

items.detail: s.50R(3)(d)(i)：要報每類 relevant crypto-asset 嘅全名。OECD CARF XML Schema User Guide：有 DTI 就盡量用；冇其他常用命名慣例時，可以用自由文字報名稱。香港 IRD 未公佈自己嘅 CARF data schema（U4），以上係 OECD CARF XML Schema（2025 年 7 月）版本。

items.title: 平台將同一隻 fungible token 嘅所有單位歸為同一類申報；但某個 NFT 系列入面每件價值唔同。NFT 應點分類型？
items.short: 每個單位當獨立一類 relevant crypto-asset
items.detail: Commentary on Section II ¶10：可以互相替代嘅單位應當同一類 relevant crypto-asset 匯總；但如果 relevant crypto-asset 係 non-fungible，而不同版本嘅固定單位價值唔同，每個單位都要當獨立一類。

quotes.text: if units of a Relevant Crypto-Asset can be mutually substituted for corresponding units of the same Relevant Crypto-Asset, then they should all be treated as the same type of Relevant Crypto-Asset for aggregation purposes.

If, however, a Relevant Crypto-Asset is non-fungible, and different variations of the Relevant Crypto-Asset do not have the same value among fixed units, each unit should be treated as a separate type of Relevant Crypto-Asset.

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 話非同質而價值唔同要逐件分。
options: 每個單位當獨立一類 relevant crypto-asset
items.explain: Commentary on Section II ¶10：可以互相替代嘅單位應當同一類 relevant crypto-asset 匯總；但如果 relevant crypto-asset 係 non-fungible，而不同版本嘅固定單位價值唔同，每個單位都要當獨立一類。

items.title: Reportable user 用港元買 crypto，平台收咗手續費。報表入面嘅「amount paid」點計？
items.short: 扣除交易費後嘅金額（net of transaction fees）
items.detail: s.50R(3)(d)(ii)：以法定貨幣取得，要報「the aggregate gross amount paid net of transaction fees」。Commentary on Section II ¶8：crypto 對法定貨幣交易要報 reportable user 支付或收到嘅金額，扣除交易費。

quotes.text: the aggregate gross amount paid net of transaction fees, the aggregate number of units and the number of relevant transactions in respect of acquisitions against fiat currency;

items.explain: s.50R(3)(d)(ix) 原文只講「the aggregate fair market value net of transaction fees, as well as the aggregate number of units」，冇「number of relevant transactions」，同 (vii)、(viii) 唔同。Commentary on Section II ¶25 亦只講單位數同公平市值。

items.title: 按 OECD Commentary，轉去未知錢包嘅外部錢包地址本身要唔要報？要唔要保存？
items.short: 唔使報，但要收集並喺紀錄保存（OECD：最少 5 年）
items.detail: Commentary on Section II ¶26：A(3)(i) 唔要求報錢包地址；但為咗稅務機關跟進查詢，RCASP 要收集並保存相關外部錢包地址最少 5 年。香港 Part 8B 嘅紀錄期係 6 年（s.50P(1)(a)(iii)、s.50S(2)），比 OECD 最低要求長。

quotes.text: This rule does not require the reporting of wallet addresses associated with Transfers of Relevant Crypto-Assets.

a Reporting Crypto- Asset Service Provider is required to collect and retain within its records, for a period not less than five years, any external wallet addresses (including other equivalent identifiers) associated with Transfers of Relevant Crypto-Assets that are subject to reporting under subparagraph A(3)(i).

option_explains: 錯：要保存以應付跟進查詢。

items.title: 客戶喺平台參與 staking，平台以 crypto 換 crypto 方式處理（例如換成 staked token）。OECD XML 嘅 crypto-to-crypto ExchangeType 可以點標？

items.detail: OECD CARF XML Schema User Guide：Crypto to Crypto In／Out 嘅 ExchangeType 係選填（Optional），可以提供 CARF401 Staking、CARF402 Crypto Loan、CARF403 Wrapping、CARF404 Collateral 等額外資料。香港 IRD 未公佈自己嘅 CARF data schema（U4），以上係 OECD CARF XML Schema（2025 年 7 月）版本。

items.title: 陳生係散戶，一年幫朋友換一兩次 USDT 做人情，冇收費、冇宣傳。佢係咪 RCASP？
items.short: 唔係：非常偶爾、非商業理由提供服務，唔屬「as a business」
items.detail: s.50M(1)：RCASP 係「as a business」為客戶提供執行 exchange transaction 服務嘅個人或實體。Commentary on Section IV ¶22：「as a business」排除非常偶爾、基於非商業理由提供服務嘅人；亦可參考各稅區相關規則。

quotes.text: means an individual or entity that provides, as a business, a service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers, including by way of acting as a counterparty to, or as an intermediary of, the exchange transactions, or by making available a trading platform;
The phrase “as a business” excludes individuals or Entities who carry out a service on a very infrequent basis for non-commercial reasons.

option_explains: 錯：$390,000 係 RRPT 門檻，同 RCASP 定義無關。
options: 係，只要有幫人兌換就係

items.title: 一個 crypto 投資基金替投資者投資 BTC 同 ETH。單憑基金嘅投資活動，佢係咪 RCASP？
items.short: 唔係：基金投資唔令投資者可以執行 exchange transaction
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶23：投資 relevant crypto-asset 嘅投資基金，其活動唔構成執行 exchange transaction 嘅服務，因為投資者唔可以藉此進行兌換。基金本身仍可能係 financial institution（investment entity），並喺佢交易嘅 RCASP 度做 crypto-asset user。

quotes.text: The activities of an investment fund investing in Relevant Crypto-Assets do not constitute a service effectuating Exchange Transactions since such activities do not permit the investors in the fund to effectuate Exchange Transactions.

means an individual or entity that provides, as a business, a service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers, including by way of acting as a counterparty to, or as an intermediary of, the exchange transactions, or by making available a trading platform;

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 講明基金投資活動唔係為客戶執行兌換。
options: 只有喺香港註冊嘅基金先係

items.title: 一間公司只係做 proof-of-stake 驗證節點，收取區塊獎勵，冇為任何客戶做兌換。佢係咪 RCASP？
items.short: 唔係：只做驗證，即使有收報酬，都唔係 RCASP
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶24：只有為或代客戶進行兌換先係 RCASP；純粹從事驗證分散式帳本交易嘅個人或實體唔係 RCASP，即使驗證有報酬。

quotes.text: an individual or Entity that is solely engaged in validating distributed ledger transactions in Relevant Crypto-Assets is not a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider, even where such validation is remunerated.

option_explains: 錯：驗證唔等於為客戶執行兌換。
options: 唔係：只做驗證，即使有收報酬，都唔係 RCASP
係，因為有收 crypto 報酬

items.title: 喺商場擺放 crypto ATM，俾人用港元買 BTC 嘅營運商，按 OECD／IRD 例子係咪 RCASP？
items.short: 係：crypto ATM 營運商係 RCASP 例子之一
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶25：透過 crypto ATM 容許以 relevant crypto-asset 兌換法定貨幣或其他 relevant crypto-asset 嘅營運商，係以對手方或中介身份提供兌換服務嘅例子。IRD CARF 網頁引用 OECD 例子時亦列出。

quotes.text: operators of Crypto-Asset ATMs, permitting the exchange of Relevant Crypto-Assets for Fiat Currencies or other Relevant Crypto-Assets through such ATMs;

means an individual or entity that provides, as a business, a service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers, including by way of acting as a counterparty to, or as an intermediary of, the exchange transactions, or by making available a trading platform;

option_explains: 錯：營運商透過 ATM 提供兌換服務。
啱：Commentary on Section IV ¶25；IRD CARF 網頁都有引用。
錯：法幣兌換已經係 exchange transaction。
options: 係：crypto ATM 營運商係 RCASP 例子之一

items.title: 一間交易所做 market maker，收取買賣差價作為佣金。佢係咪 RCASP？
items.short: 係：做莊兼收差價嘅交易所係 RCASP 例子
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶25：作為 market maker、以買賣差價作交易佣金嘅 crypto 交易所，係以對手方或中介身份執行 exchange transaction 嘅例子。s.50M(1) RCASP 定義包括「acting as a counterparty」。

quotes.text: Crypto-Asset exchanges that act as a market makers and take a bid-ask spread as a transaction commission for their services;

means an individual or entity that provides, as a business, a service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers, including by way of acting as a counterparty to, or as an intermediary of, the exchange transactions, or by making available a trading platform;

options: 唔係，因為冇明碼收手續費
只有冇做莊嘅撮合平台先係

items.title: 公司 A 只係創造同發行自己嘅 token；公司 B 向 A 直接買入 token，再轉售同分銷俾客戶。邊間係 RCASP？
items.short: 只有 B：向發行人買入再轉售分銷俾客戶屬執行兌換；單純創造發行唔算
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶25：單純創造同發行 relevant crypto-asset 唔算以對手方或中介身份執行 exchange transaction；但直接向發行人購入 relevant crypto-asset 再轉售及分銷俾客戶，就算執行 exchange transaction。IRD CARF 網頁亦列出「subscribing… for reselling and distributing」例子。

quotes.text: While the sole creation and issuance of a Relevant Crypto-Asset would not be considered a service effectuating Exchange Transactions as a counterparty or intermediary, the direct purchase of Relevant Crypto-Assets from an issuer, to resell and distribute such Relevant Crypto-Assets to customers would be considered effectuating an Exchange Transaction.
individuals or entities subscribing relevant crypto-assets from an issuer for reselling and distributing them to customers (if applicable).
quotes.pin: IRD CARF 網頁：Individuals and entities subject to due diligence and reporting requirements

option_explains: 錯：單純創造同發行唔係。
options: 只有 B：向發行人買入再轉售分銷俾客戶屬執行兌換；單純創造發行唔算
只有 A，因為佢係發行人
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶25：單純創造同發行 relevant crypto-asset 唔算以對手方或中介身份執行 exchange transaction；但直接向發行人購入 relevant crypto-asset 再轉售及分銷俾客戶，就算執行 exchange transaction。IRD CARF 網頁亦列出「subscribing… for reselling and distributing」例子。

items.title: 一間 OTC dealer 用自己帳戶向客戶買賣 BTC。佢係咪 RCASP？
items.short: 係：以自己帳戶向客戶買賣 relevant crypto-asset 嘅 de…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶25 第一個例子：「dealers acting for their own account to buy and sell Relevant Crypto-Assets to customers」。s.50M(1) RCASP 包括作為 exchange transaction 對手方。

quotes.text: dealers acting for their own account to buy and sell Relevant Crypto-Assets to customers;

means an individual or entity that provides, as a business, a service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers, including by way of acting as a counterparty to, or as an intermediary of, the exchange transactions, or by making available a trading platform;

options: 唔係，因為冇撮合其他客戶

items.title: 一個網站只俾人張貼 crypto 買賣報價，買賣雙方要自己私下聯絡同交收，網站唔參與交易。網站營運者係咪 RCASP？
items.short: 唔係：純佈告板功能唔提供令用戶執行兌換嘅服務
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶26：只提供佈告板功能、張貼 relevant crypto-asset 買賣或兌換價嘅平台營運者唔係 RCASP，因為佢冇提供令用戶執行 exchange transaction 嘅服務。trading platform 係指容許用戶（部分或全部）執行兌換嘅軟件或應用程式。

quotes.text: An individual or Entity that is making available a platform that solely includes a bulletin board functionality for posting buy, sell or conversion prices of Relevant Crypto-Assets would not be a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider as it would not provide a service allowing users to effectuate Exchange Transactions.
A “trading platform” includes any software program or application that allows users to effectuate (either partially or in their entirety) Exchange Transactions.

option_explains: 錯：純佈告板唔算 trading platform。
options: 係，因為佢提供交易平台
唔係：純佈告板功能唔提供令用戶執行兌換嘅服務
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶26：只提供佈告板功能、張貼 relevant crypto-asset 買賣或兌換價嘅平台營運者唔係 RCASP，因為佢冇提供令用戶執行 exchange transaction 嘅服務。trading platform 係指容許用戶（部分或全部）執行兌換嘅軟件或應用程式。

items.title: 按 OECD Commentary，一個人或實體幾時算係「making available a trading platform」？
items.short: 佢對平台行使控制或足夠影響力，令佢可以就平台上嘅兌換遵守盡職審查同申報責任
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶27：一個人或實體對平台行使控制或足夠影響力（control or sufficient influence），令佢可以就平台上完成嘅 exchange transaction 遵守盡職審查同申報責任，先算 making available a trading platform；判斷要同 FATF Recommendations 及相關指引一致。

quotes.text: An individual or Entity will be considered to make available a trading platform to the extent it exercises control or sufficient influence over the platform, allowing it to comply with the due diligence and reporting obligations with respect to Exchange Transactions concluded on the platform.

option_explains: 錯：要睇有冇控制或足夠影響力。
options: 佢對平台行使控制或足夠影響力，令佢可以就平台上嘅兌換遵守盡職審查同申報責任
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶27：一個人或實體對平台行使控制或足夠影響力（control or sufficient influence），令佢可以就平台上完成嘅 exchange transaction 遵守盡職審查同申報責任，先算 making available a trading platform；判斷要同 FATF Recommendations 及相關指引一致。

items.title: 揾錯處：「我哋用智能合約自動撮合兌換，唔係傳統交易所，所以技術上唔可能係 RCASP。」
items.short: 錯：判斷係咪 RCASP 同所用技術無關，關鍵係有冇以業務形式為客戶提供兌換服務
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶28：只要功能上以業務形式為或代客戶提供執行 exchange transaction 服務，就可以係 RCASP；「The technology involved in providing such service is irrelevant」。DeFi 情況下控制／足夠影響力測試，稅區可以按 FAQ 延後應用（見 FAQ Section IV Q1）。

quotes.text: The technology involved in providing such service is irrelevant to determine whether an individual or Entity is a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider.

means an individual or entity that provides, as a business, a service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers, including by way of acting as a counterparty to, or as an intermediary of, the exchange transactions, or by making available a trading platform;

options: 冇錯，智能合約唔受 CARF 規管

錯：所有用智能合約嘅人都一定係 RCASP

items.title: 一個非託管（non-custodial）交易平台唔幫客戶保管資產，但營運者控制平台運作。佢會唔會因為「冇託管」而唔係 RCASP？
items.short: 唔會：trading platform 可以有或冇託管服務；有控制或足夠影響力…
items.detail: CARF FAQ Section IV Q1：RCASP 定義冇排除非託管服務；trading platform 可以喺有或冇託管服務下提供。營運者對平台行使控制或足夠影響力，就算 making available a trading platform（Commentary ¶27）。

quotes.text: For that purpose, a trading platform may be made available by an individual or Entity with or without offering custodial services.

An individual or Entity will be considered to make available a trading platform to the extent it exercises control or sufficient influence over the platform, allowing it to comply with the due diligence and reporting obligations with respect to Exchange Transactions concluded on the platform.

option_explains: 錯：同客戶錢包種類無關。
options: 要睇客戶有冇用硬件錢包
唔會：trading platform 可以有或冇託管服務；有控制或足夠影響力就可以係 RCASP
items.explain: CARF FAQ Section IV Q1：RCASP 定義冇排除非託管服務；trading platform 可以喺有或冇託管服務下提供。營運者對平台行使控制或足夠影響力，就算 making available a trading platform（Commentary ¶27）。

items.title: 關於 DeFi 安排，OECD CARF FAQ 容許實施稅區點樣處理「控制或足夠影響力」測試？
items.short: 可以延後應用該測試，直至有進一步解釋指引
items.detail: CARF FAQ Section IV Q1：特別喺 DeFi 安排，實施稅區可以延後應用 control and sufficient influence 測試，直至有進一步解釋指引（會考慮包括 FATF 層面嘅監管發展）。香港 IRD 有冇選擇延後未見公佈（未核實）；s.50Y 要求按 CARF publications 一致解釋。

quotes.text: Specifically in the context of DeFi arrangements, an implementing jurisdiction may defer its application of the control and sufficient influence test, until further interpretative guidance is issued to clarify the application of the Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework in this respect
This Part and Schedule 17EA are to be applied and interpreted in the way that best secures their consistency with the requirements and guidance in the CARF publications.

options: 可以延後應用該測試，直至有進一步解釋指引

items.title: s.50N(1)(b) 講嘅「tax information return」係指咩？
items.short: 任何用嚟通知稅務機關實體部分或全部收入嘅申報，唔一定列明稅務責任
items.detail: s.50N(1)(b)：喺香港成立或組成，而且有香港法律人格，或者有責任就實體收入向 IRD 交 tax returns 或 tax information returns。Commentary on Section I ¶2：tax information return 係任何用嚟通知稅務機關實體部分或全部收入嘅申報，但唔一定列明稅務責任；條件目的係確保稅務機關可以執行申報要求。

quotes.text: an entity that— (i) is incorporated or organized under the laws of Hong Kong; and (ii) has a legal personality in Hong Kong or has an obligation to file tax returns or tax information returns to the Inland Revenue Department with respect to the income of the entity; (c) an entity managed from Hong Kong; or (d) an individual or entity that has a regular place of business in Hong Kong.

For the purposes of subparagraph A(2), a tax information return is any filing used to notify the tax administration regarding part or all of the income of the Entity, but which does not necessarily state a pursuant tax liability of the Entity;

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 講明唔需要列明稅務責任。
錯：係關於實體收入嘅申報。
options: 一定要列明應繳稅款嘅報稅表
任何用嚟通知稅務機關實體部分或全部收入嘅申報，唔一定列明稅務責任
items.explain: s.50N(1)(b)：喺香港成立或組成，而且有香港法律人格，或者有責任就實體收入向 IRD 交 tax returns 或 tax information returns。Commentary on Section I ¶2：tax information return 係任何用嚟通知稅務機關實體部分或全部收入嘅申報，但唔一定列明稅務責任；條件目的係確保稅務機關可以執行申報要求。

items.title: 一個以信託形式運作嘅 RCASP，受託人係香港稅務居民。按 OECD Commentary，呢個信託同香港有咩 nexus？
items.short: 「managed from」香港嘅 nexus（s.50N(1)(c)）
items.detail: Commentary on Section I ¶2：「managed from」準則包括信託（或功能相似實體）RCASP 由該稅區稅務居民受託人管理嘅情況，並涵蓋實際管理地同任何其他管理地。對應 s.50N(1)(c)「an entity managed from Hong Kong」。

quotes.text: This criterion includes situations where a trust (or a functionally similar Entity) that is a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider is managed by a trustee (or functionally similar representative) that is tax resident in [Jurisdiction].

an entity that— (i) is incorporated or organized under the laws of Hong Kong; and (ii) has a legal personality in Hong Kong or has an obligation to file tax returns or tax information returns to the Inland Revenue Department with respect to the income of the entity; (c) an entity managed from Hong Kong; or (d) an individual or entity that has a regular place of business in Hong Kong.

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 將呢情況歸入 managed from。
options: 冇任何 nexus，因為信託唔係公司
只係 regular place of business
items.explain: Commentary on Section I ¶2：「managed from」準則包括信託（或功能相似實體）RCASP 由該稅區稅務居民受託人管理嘅情況，並涵蓋實際管理地同任何其他管理地。對應 s.50N(1)(c)「an entity managed from Hong Kong」。

items.title: s.50N(1)(c)「managed from Hong Kong」只係指實際管理地（place of effective management）？
items.short: 唔係：包括實際管理地，亦包括任何其他管理地
items.detail: Commentary on Section I ¶2：managed from 準則「captures the place of effective management, as well as any other place of management of the Entity」。s.50Y 要求 Part 8B 按 CARF publications 一致解釋。

quotes.text: This criterion captures the place of effective management, as well as any other place of management of the Entity; or

an entity that— (i) is incorporated or organized under the laws of Hong Kong; and (ii) has a legal personality in Hong Kong or has an obligation to file tax returns or tax information returns to the Inland Revenue Department with respect to the income of the entity; (c) an entity managed from Hong Kong; or (d) an individual or entity that has a regular place of business in Hong Kong.

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 話仲包括其他管理地。
options: 唔係：包括實際管理地，亦包括任何其他管理地
items.explain: Commentary on Section I ¶2：managed from 準則「captures the place of effective management, as well as any other place of management of the Entity」。s.50Y 要求 Part 8B 按 CARF publications 一致解釋。

items.title: 按 OECD Commentary，「regular place of business」包唔包括分行同非主要營業地點？
items.short: 包括：任何分行都視為 regular place of business，亦涵…
items.detail: Commentary on Section I ¶2：regular place of business 準則下，任何 Branch 都視為 regular place of business，並涵蓋主要同其他經常營業地點。對應 s.50N(1)(d)。另外 CARF FAQ Section I Q2 講明單單有客戶群唔構成營業地點。

quotes.text: In this respect, any Branch is to be considered a regular place of business. This criterion captures the principal, as well as other regular places of business.

an entity that— (i) is incorporated or organized under the laws of Hong Kong; and (ii) has a legal personality in Hong Kong or has an obligation to file tax returns or tax information returns to the Inland Revenue Department with respect to the income of the entity; (c) an entity managed from Hong Kong; or (d) an individual or entity that has a regular place of business in Hong Kong.

option_explains: 錯：亦包括其他營業地點。
options: 包括：任何分行都視為 regular place of business，亦涵蓋主要同其他營業地點
items.explain: Commentary on Section I ¶2：regular place of business 準則下，任何 Branch 都視為 regular place of business，並涵蓋主要同其他經常營業地點。對應 s.50N(1)(d)。另外 CARF FAQ Section I Q2 講明單單有客戶群唔構成營業地點。

items.title: CARF nexus 規則入面嘅「層級」（hierarchy）目的係咩？
items.short: 喺另一稅區有更強聯繫時，避免本稅區嘅盡職審查同申報要求重複適用
items.detail: Commentary on Section I ¶4：RCASP 要向每個符合 A、B 段準則嘅稅區申報，但受 C 至 H 段防止重複申報規則限制；層級確保另一稅區有更強聯繫時，本稅區嘅要求唔適用。香港對應 s.50N(4)–(9)。

quotes.text: This hierarchy ensures that the due diligence and reporting requirements in [Jurisdiction] do not apply in instances where there is a stronger link with another jurisdiction.

A Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider must report the information to each jurisdiction for which it fulfils the criteria of paragraphs A and B, subject to the rules in paragraphs C through H to prevent duplicative reporting.

options: 令 RCASP 可以自由揀最低稅率嘅地方申報
令所有 RCASP 只喺註冊地申報
喺另一稅區有更強聯繫時，避免本稅區嘅盡職審查同申報要求重複適用
items.explain: Commentary on Section I ¶4：RCASP 要向每個符合 A、B 段準則嘅稅區申報，但受 C 至 H 段防止重複申報規則限制；層級確保另一稅區有更強聯繫時，本稅區嘅要求唔適用。香港對應 s.50N(4)–(9)。

items.title: s.50N(9)（對應 OECD Rules Section I Paragraph H）主要處理咩情況？
items.short: RCASP 喺香港同 partner jurisdiction 有實質相似嘅 …
items.detail: s.50N(9)：HKRCASP 憑同香港 nexus 實質相似嘅 nexus 喺 partner jurisdiction 遵守 specified requirements，並要交 s.50Q(1) 報表，就唔使遵守 s.50P。Commentary on Section I ¶11：例子係喺兩個或以上稅區都係稅務居民嘅 RCASP，可以揀其中一個居民地遵守。登記責任（s.50O(1)）照適用。

quotes.text: the specified requirements are complied with by the HKRCASP under the rules of a partner jurisdiction by virtue of a nexus that is substantially similar to the HKRCASP’s nexus to Hong Kong; and (b) the HKRCASP has to furnish a return under section 50Q(1).

For example, a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider that is tax resident in two or more jurisdictions, may rely on paragraph H to select one of the two jurisdictions of tax residence where it complies with the due diligence and reporting requirements.

option_explains: 啱：s.50N(9) 同 Commentary on Section I ¶11。
錯：冇 nexus 就根本唔係 HKRCASP。
options: RCASP 喺香港同 partner jurisdiction 有實質相似嘅 nexus（例如雙重稅務居民），可以揀喺其中一處遵守
RCASP 冇任何 nexus 時揀一個地方申報
RCASP 可以揀稅率最低嘅地方
items.explain: s.50N(9)：HKRCASP 憑同香港 nexus 實質相似嘅 nexus 喺 partner jurisdiction 遵守 specified requirements，並要交 s.50Q(1) 報表，就唔使遵守 s.50P。Commentary on Section I ¶11：例子係喺兩個或以上稅區都係稅務居民嘅 RCASP，可以揀其中一個居民地遵守。登記責任（s.50O(1)）照適用。

items.title: 香港成立嘅 RCASP（s.50N(1)(b) nexus），喺 partner jurisdiction Y 同香港都有 regular place of business。佢可唔可以引用 s.50N(9)（同類 nexus），揀只喺 Y 遵守，唔做香港 s.50P？
items.short: 唔可以：如果 RCASP 喺某稅區有稅務居民、成立或管理 nexus，就唔可以…
items.detail: Commentary on Section I ¶11：Paragraph H（香港 s.50N(9)）只適用於喺兩個或以上稅區有相同 nexus；雖然有多個營業地點可以揀其一，但如果 RCASP 憑 A(1)、(2) 或 (3)（稅務居民、成立、管理）喺某稅區有 nexus，就唔容許咁做。佢喺香港有 s.50N(1)(b) nexus，所以要喺香港遵守。

quotes.text: however, such reliance is not permitted if the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider has nexus in a jurisdiction pursuant to subparagraphs A(1), (2), or (3).

the specified requirements are complied with by the HKRCASP under the rules of a partner jurisdiction by virtue of a nexus that is substantially similar to the HKRCASP’s nexus to Hong Kong; and (b) the HKRCASP has to furnish a return under section 50Q(1).

option_explains: 錯：佢喺香港有更高層級嘅 nexus。
options: 可以，兩邊都有營業地點
唔可以：如果 RCASP 喺某稅區有稅務居民、成立或管理 nexus，就唔可以用營業地點嘅同類 nexus 規則揀地方
可以，只要 Y 嘅稅率較低
items.explain: Commentary on Section I ¶11：Paragraph H（香港 s.50N(9)）只適用於喺兩個或以上稅區有相同 nexus；雖然有多個營業地點可以揀其一，但如果 RCASP 憑 A(1)、(2) 或 (3)（稅務居民、成立、管理）喺某稅區有 nexus，就唔容許咁做。佢喺香港有 s.50N(1)(b) nexus，所以要喺香港遵守。

items.title: RCASP 有多間分行（香港同 partner jurisdiction）。就同一位 crypto-asset user，OECD 點睇盡職審查同申報責任點樣算履行？
items.short: 其中任何一間位於本稅區或 partner jurisdiction 嘅分行履行…
items.detail: Commentary on Section I ¶9：維持一間或以上分行嘅 RCASP，如果其中任何一間位於本稅區或 partner jurisdiction 嘅分行就某 crypto-asset user 履行咗盡職審查同申報要求，就算已履行。香港 s.50N(8) 處理經 partner jurisdiction 分行執行嘅交易。

quotes.text: A Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider that maintains one or more Branches fulfils the due diligence and reporting requirements with respect to a Crypto-Asset User, if any one of its Branches in [Jurisdiction] or a Partner Jurisdiction fulfils such requirements.

An HKRCASP is not required to comply with the due diligence requirements under section 50P with respect to the relevant transactions the HKRCASP effectuates through a branch in a partner jurisdiction if— (a) the specified requirements are complied with by the branch in the partner jurisdiction; and (b) the HKRCASP has to furnish a return under section 50Q(1).

options: 每間分行都要各自做一次
其中任何一間位於本稅區或 partner jurisdiction 嘅分行履行咗，就算履行
items.explain: Commentary on Section I ¶9：維持一間或以上分行嘅 RCASP，如果其中任何一間位於本稅區或 partner jurisdiction 嘅分行就某 crypto-asset user 履行咗盡職審查同申報要求，就算已履行。香港 s.50N(8) 處理經 partner jurisdiction 分行執行嘅交易。

items.title: HKRCASP（香港成立）喺 partner jurisdiction Z 有分行，Z 分行處理嘅交易已由 Z 分行喺 Z 遵守 specified requirements。HKRCASP 就呢啲交易要唔要做 s.50P？
items.short: 唔使就 Z 分行嘅交易做 s.50P，但仍要交 s.50Q(1) 報表
items.detail: s.50N(8)：HKRCASP 經 partner jurisdiction 分行執行嘅 relevant transactions，如果該分行喺嗰度遵守 specified requirements，而 HKRCASP 要交 s.50Q(1) 報表，就唔使就呢啲交易遵守 s.50P。其他交易照做。s.50Q(4)(b)(ii)／(6)：報表就該等交易報簡化資料。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP is not required to comply with the due diligence requirements under section 50P with respect to the relevant transactions the HKRCASP effectuates through a branch in a partner jurisdiction if— (a) the specified requirements are complied with by the branch in the partner jurisdiction; and (b) the HKRCASP has to furnish a return under section 50Q(1).

the name, address and identifying number (if any) of the HKRCASP; (b) in which partner jurisdictions the specified requirements (as defined by section 50N(11)) are complied with by the HKRCASP or the branch (as the case may be); and (c) which of the criteria specified in section 50N(4), (5), (6), (7), (8) and (9) is met by the HKRCASP.

option_explains: 錯：s.50N(8) 專門處理呢個情況。
錯：豁免只限經 Z 分行嘅交易。
options: 唔使就 Z 分行嘅交易做 s.50P，但仍要交 s.50Q(1) 報表
一定要做，因為係香港公司
全部交易都唔使做 s.50P
items.explain: s.50N(8)：HKRCASP 經 partner jurisdiction 分行執行嘅 relevant transactions，如果該分行喺嗰度遵守 specified requirements，而 HKRCASP 要交 s.50Q(1) 報表，就唔使就呢啲交易遵守 s.50P。其他交易照做。s.50Q(4)(b)(ii)／(6)：報表就該等交易報簡化資料。

items.title: s.50N(5)（實體喺 partner jurisdiction 成立而喺嗰度遵守）可以免除 HKRCASP 基於邊類香港 nexus 嘅 s.50P 責任？
items.short: 只限 s.50N(1)(c)（喺香港管理）或 (d)（香港營業地點）
items.detail: s.50N(5)：實體 HKRCASP「otherwise subject to by virtue of subsection (1)(c) or (d)」，如果憑喺 partner jurisdiction 成立或組成（並有法律人格或報稅責任）而喺嗰度遵守 specified requirements，並要交 s.50Q(1) 報表，就唔使遵守 s.50P。呢個層級反映成立地比管理地或營業地點聯繫更強（Commentary on Section I ¶4）。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP that is an entity is not required to comply with the due diligence requirements under section 50P it is otherwise subject to by virtue of subsection (1)(c) or (d) if— (a) the specified requirements are complied with by the HKRCASP in a partner jurisdiction by virtue of it being an entity that— (i) is incorporated or organized under the laws of the partner jurisdiction;
This hierarchy ensures that the due diligence and reporting requirements in [Jurisdiction] do not apply in instances where there is a stronger link with another jurisdiction.

option_explains: 錯：(b) 由 s.50N(4) 處理稅務居民情況。
options: 任何 nexus，包括香港稅務居民
只限 s.50N(1)(c)（喺香港管理）或 (d)（香港營業地點）
items.explain: s.50N(5)：實體 HKRCASP「otherwise subject to by virtue of subsection (1)(c) or (d)」，如果憑喺 partner jurisdiction 成立或組成（並有法律人格或報稅責任）而喺嗰度遵守 specified requirements，並要交 s.50Q(1) 報表，就唔使遵守 s.50P。呢個層級反映成立地比管理地或營業地點聯繫更強（Commentary on Section I ¶4）。

items.title: Ms Lee 係香港稅務居民（個人 RCASP），喺 partner jurisdiction Q 有營業地點並喺 Q 遵守 specified requirements。佢可唔可以引用 s.50N(7)，唔做香港 s.50P？
items.short: 唔可以：s.50N(7) 只免除基於 s.50N(1)(d) 香港營業地點嘅責…
items.detail: s.50N(7)：個人 HKRCASP 只係「by virtue of subsection (1)(d)」要做盡職審查，而且憑係 partner jurisdiction 稅務居民喺嗰度遵守，先可以免 s.50P。Ms Lee 係香港稅務居民（s.50N(1)(a)），稅務居民 nexus 喺層級最高，佢要喺香港遵守。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP that is an individual is not required to comply with the due diligence requirements under section 50P the HKRCASP is otherwise subject to by virtue of subsection (1)(d) if— (a) the specified requirements are complied with by the HKRCASP in a partner jurisdiction by virtue of the HKRCASP being an individual who is a resident for tax purposes in the partner jurisdiction;
This hierarchy ensures that the due diligence and reporting requirements in [Jurisdiction] do not apply in instances where there is a stronger link with another jurisdiction.

option_explains: 錯：個人 RCASP 一樣有責任。
options: 可以，只要喺 Q 遵守咗
可以，個人 RCASP 一律唔使做
唔可以：s.50N(7) 只免除基於 s.50N(1)(d) 香港營業地點嘅責任，而且要佢係 partner jurisdiction 稅務居民
items.explain: s.50N(7)：個人 HKRCASP 只係「by virtue of subsection (1)(d)」要做盡職審查，而且憑係 partner jurisdiction 稅務居民喺嗰度遵守，先可以免 s.50P。Ms Lee 係香港稅務居民（s.50N(1)(a)），稅務居民 nexus 喺層級最高，佢要喺香港遵守。

items.title: HKRCASP 憑 s.50N(4)–(9) 豁免 s.50P。佢交 s.50Q(1) 報表時要報咩？
items.short: 名稱、地址、識別號碼；喺邊個 partner jurisdiction 遵守 …
items.detail: s.50Q(4)(b)(i)、(ii)：豁免 s.50P 而 specified requirements 喺 partner jurisdiction 遵守，required information 係 s.50Q(6) 嘅資料：(a) 名稱、地址、識別號碼（如有）；(b) 喺邊啲 partner jurisdiction 遵守；(c) 符合 s.50N(4)–(9) 邊項準則。

quotes.text: the name, address and identifying number (if any) of the HKRCASP; (b) in which partner jurisdictions the specified requirements (as defined by section 50N(11)) are complied with by the HKRCASP or the branch (as the case may be); and (c) which of the criteria specified in section 50N(4), (5), (6), (7), (8) and (9) is met by the HKRCASP.

option_explains: 錯：s.50Q(4)(b) 只要求簡化資料。
錯：豁免條件本身就要求交報表。

quotes.text: For example, a private trust company that acts as a registered office or registered agent of a trust or performs administrative services unrelated to the Financial Assets, Relevant Crypto-Assets or money of the trust, does not conduct the activities and operations described in subparagraph E(5)(a) on behalf of the trust
