items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶66：私人信託公司只做註冊辦事處、註冊代理或同信託金融資產、relevant crypto-asset 或資金無關嘅行政服務，冇就信託進行 E(5)(a) 活動，信託唔算由佢「managed by」；仍要再判斷信託係咪由其他實體管理。

items.title: Entity M 為 Entity N 執行投資活動，但冇任何酌情權管理 N 嘅資產。按 OECD，M 係咪「管理」N？
items.short: 唔係：冇酌情權管理該實體資產（全部或部分），就唔算管理
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶66：一個實體如果冇酌情權（discretionary authority）管理另一實體嘅資產（全部或部分），就唔算管理該實體。呢點影響 s.50M(1) investment entity (e)（受 FI 管理）嘅判斷。

quotes.text: However, an Entity does not manage another Entity if it does not have discretionary authority to manage the Entity’s assets (in whole or part).

options: 唔係：冇酌情權管理該實體資產（全部或部分），就唔算管理
係，只要有執行活動就算
視乎 M 有冇牌照
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶66：一個實體如果冇酌情權（discretionary authority）管理另一實體嘅資產（全部或部分），就唔算管理該實體。呢點影響 s.50M(1) investment entity (e)（受 FI 管理）嘅判斷。

items.title: 一間公司將部分資產投資喺一隻 ETF。佢會唔會因此被當作「managed by」該 ETF？
items.short: 唔會：投資喺 mutual fund、ETF 或類似工具，唔令實體由該工具管理
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶66：將全部或部分資產投資喺 mutual fund、exchange traded fund 或類似工具嘅實體，唔會被視為由該工具「managed by」；仍要另外判斷佢係咪由其他實體管理。

quotes.text: Also, an Entity that invests all or a portion of its assets in a mutual fund, exchange traded fund, or similar vehicle will not be considered “managed by” the mutual fund, exchange traded fund, or similar vehicle.

options: 唔會：投資喺 mutual fund、ETF 或類似工具，唔令實體由該工具管理
只有投資超過 50% 先會
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶66：將全部或部分資產投資喺 mutual fund、exchange traded fund 或類似工具嘅實體，唔會被視為由該工具「managed by」；仍要另外判斷佢係咪由其他實體管理。

items.title: 一個投資實體由兩方共同管理：一位唔係 FI 嘅個人，同一間持牌資產管理公司（FI）。按 OECD，佢係咪由 FI 管理？
items.short: 係：由 FI 同非 FI 混合管理，只要其中一個管理實體係相關 FI，就算由 …
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶66：實體由 financial institutions 同非 FI 混合管理，只要任何一個管理實體係 depository／custodial institution、specified insurance company 或 E(5)(a) investment entity，就視為由該類 FI 管理。再配合 s.50M(1) investment entity (e) 嘅收入測試。

quotes.text: Where an Entity is managed by a mix of Financial Institutions and individuals or Entities other than Financial Institutions, the Entity is considered to be managed by another Entity that is a Depository Institution, a Custodial Institution, a Specified Insurance Company, or an Investment Entity described in subparagraph E(5)(a), if any of the managing Entities is such another Entity.

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 話任何一方係 FI 就算。
options: 唔係，因為有非 FI 參與
要睇邊方管理資產較多
係：由 FI 同非 FI 混合管理，只要其中一個管理實體係相關 FI，就算由 FI 管理
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶66：實體由 financial institutions 同非 FI 混合管理，只要任何一個管理實體係 depository／custodial institution、specified insurance company 或 E(5)(a) investment entity，就視為由該類 FI 管理。再配合 s.50M(1) investment entity (e) 嘅收入測試。

items.title: 一個主要為他人投資同管理「非債務直接房地產權益」嘅實體（例如某類 REIT）。按 OECD，佢係咪 investment entity？
items.short: 唔係：主要投資管理非債務直接房地產權益嘅實體唔係 investment ent…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶70：以業務形式為他人主要投資、管理非債務直接房地產權益嘅實體（例如某類房地產投資信託）唔係 investment entity。呼應 s.50M(1) financial asset「does not include a non-debt direct interest in real property」。

quotes.text: An Entity that primarily conducts as a business investing, administering, or managing non-debt, direct interests in real property on behalf of other persons, such as a type of real estate investment trust, will not be an Investment Entity.

option_explains: 錯：上市影響 excluded person，唔係呢個問題。
options: 唔係：主要投資管理非債務直接房地產權益嘅實體唔係 investment entity
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶70：以業務形式為他人主要投資、管理非債務直接房地產權益嘅實體（例如某類房地產投資信託）唔係 investment entity。呼應 s.50M(1) financial asset「does not include a non-debt direct interest in real property」。

items.title: 一間控股公司因符合 active entity (b)（集團控股）而係 active entity，但收入主要嚟自投資。邊條話佢唔屬 investment entity？
items.short: s.50M(1) investment entity 嘅但書：唔包括純粹因 a…
items.detail: s.50M(1) investment entity 最後一句：「but does not include an entity that is an active entity solely because it falls within any of the descriptions in paragraphs (b), (c), (d) and (e) of the definition of active entity」。Commentary on Section IV ¶69 亦有相同說明。

quotes.text: but does not include an entity that is an active entity solely because it falls within any of the descriptions in paragraphs (b), (c), (d) and (e) of the definition of active entity in this subsection;

option_explains: 錯：(11) 係 50% 收入測試。
錯：(7) 係 custodial institution 測試。
options: s.50M(1) investment entity 嘅但書：唔包括純粹因 active entity (b)–(e) 而屬 active entity 嘅實體
items.explain: s.50M(1) investment entity 最後一句：「but does not include an entity that is an active entity solely because it falls within any of the descriptions in paragraphs (b), (c), (d) and (e) of the definition of active entity」。Commentary on Section IV ¶69 亦有相同說明。

items.title: 客戶喺 RCASP 開戶做交易，但 RCASP 冇幫佢託管資產，而且合約寫明雙方係「軟件授權」關係。客戶仲係咪 crypto-asset user？
items.short: 係：被識別為進行 relevant transaction 嘅人就係 user…
items.detail: s.50M(1)：crypto-asset user 係為進行 relevant transaction 而成為 RCASP 客戶嘅個人或實體。Commentary on Section IV ¶36：任何被 RCASP 識別為進行 relevant transaction 嘅人都當 user，不論 RCASP 有冇代為保管，亦不論雙方關係嘅法律定性。

quotes.text: Any individual or Entity identified by the Reporting Crypto Asset Service Provider for purposes of carrying out Relevant Transactions is treated as a Crypto Asset User, irrespective of whether the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider is safekeeping the Relevant Crypto-Assets on behalf of the Crypto-Asset User or the legal characterisation of the relationship between the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider and such individual or Entity.

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 講明唔理有冇託管。
options: 唔係，冇託管就唔係 user
係：被識別為進行 relevant transaction 嘅人就係 user，唔理有冇託管或關係嘅法律定性
items.explain: s.50M(1)：crypto-asset user 係為進行 relevant transaction 而成為 RCASP 客戶嘅個人或實體。Commentary on Section IV ¶36：任何被 RCASP 識別為進行 relevant transaction 嘅人都當 user，不論 RCASP 有冇代為保管，亦不論雙方關係嘅法律定性。

items.title: F 持有 U 嘅授權書，以自己名義喺 RCASP X 開戶代 U 交易。F 唔係 FI 或 RCASP，X 嘅 AML/KYC 檔案顯示 F 係 U 嘅代理。邊個係 crypto-asset user？
items.short: U
items.detail: s.50M(6)(a)：以代理人、託管人、代名人、簽署人、投資顧問或中介身份為他人利益行事嘅個人或實體（FI 或 RCASP 除外）唔當 crypto-asset user，該他人先係。Commentary on Section IV ¶38：F 持 U 授權書而 AML/KYC 檔案顯示 F 係 U 嘅代理，RCASP 要當 U 係 user。

quotes.text: an individual or entity (other than a financial institution or a reporting crypto-asset service provider), acting as a crypto-asset user for the benefit or account of another individual or entity as an agent, custodian, nominee, signatory, investment advisor or intermediary, is not regarded as a crypto-asset user, and such other individual or entity is regarded as a crypto-asset user;

because F is not a Financial Institution or Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider and the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider has information in its AML/KYC files indicating that F acts as an agent for the benefit of U, the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider must treat U as the Crypto-Asset User;

option_explains: 啱：s.50M(6)(a) 同 Commentary on Section IV ¶38 例子。
items.explain: s.50M(6)(a)：以代理人、託管人、代名人、簽署人、投資顧問或中介身份為他人利益行事嘅個人或實體（FI 或 RCASP 除外）唔當 crypto-asset user，該他人先係。Commentary on Section IV ¶38：F 持 U 授權書而 AML/KYC 檔案顯示 F 係 U 嘅代理，RCASP 要當 U 係 user。

items.title: RCASP A 用 RCASP B 嘅交易平台為自己客戶執行交易。對 B 嚟講，邊個係 crypto-asset user？
items.short: A 本身：A 係 RCASP，佢以自己名義定代理身份交易都冇分別
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶38：RCASP A 用 RCASP B 嘅平台執行 relevant transaction，A 係 B 嘅 crypto-asset user，B 要報 A 嘅交易；因為 A 係 RCASP，佢以自己名義定以代理等身份交易都無關。s.50M(6)(a) 嘅穿透規則排除 FI 同 RCASP。A 通常屬 excluded person 與否要另外判斷。

quotes.text: Therefore, A is a Crypto-Asset User for B, and B will report the Relevant Transactions effectuated by A. Because A is a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider, it is immaterial whether A effectuates such Relevant Transactions in its own name or as an agent, custodian, nominee, signatory, investment advisor or intermediary.

an individual or entity (other than a financial institution or a reporting crypto-asset service provider), acting as a crypto-asset user for the benefit or account of another individual or entity as an agent, custodian, nominee, signatory, investment advisor or intermediary, is not regarded as a crypto-asset user, and such other individual or entity is regarded as a crypto-asset user;

option_explains: 錯：B 要報 A 嘅交易。
options: A 本身：A 係 RCASP，佢以自己名義定代理身份交易都冇分別
冇人，RCASP 之間交易唔使報
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶38：RCASP A 用 RCASP B 嘅平台執行 relevant transaction，A 係 B 嘅 crypto-asset user，B 要報 A 嘅交易；因為 A 係 RCASP，佢以自己名義定以代理等身份交易都無關。s.50M(6)(a) 嘅穿透規則排除 FI 同 RCASP。A 通常屬 excluded person 與否要另外判斷。

items.title: RCASP 想確認某 crypto-asset user 本身係咪 RCASP 或 FI（影響穿透規則）。OECD 建議可以點做？
items.short: 可以將 user 提供嘅資料同列出其他 RCASP 或 FI 嘅受監管機構名單…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶37：RCASP 可以依賴手上資料（包括 AML/KYC 資料）合理判斷某人係咪為他人利益行事；確認 user 係咪 RCASP 或 FI 時，可以例如將 user 提供嘅資料同（如有）受監管機構名單交叉核對。

quotes.text: In confirming whether a Crypto-Asset User may be a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider or a Financial Institution, a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service provider may, for instance, rely on cross-checking the information provided by its Crypto-Asset User with regulated institutions lists that indicate other Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers or Financial Institutions, where available.

an individual or entity (other than a financial institution or a reporting crypto-asset service provider), acting as a crypto-asset user for the benefit or account of another individual or entity as an agent, custodian, nominee, signatory, investment advisor or intermediary, is not regarded as a crypto-asset user, and such other individual or entity is regarded as a crypto-asset user;

options: 一律要求對方出律師意見書
只可以靠 user 口頭聲明
可以將 user 提供嘅資料同列出其他 RCASP 或 FI 嘅受監管機構名單交叉核對
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶37：RCASP 可以依賴手上資料（包括 AML/KYC 資料）合理判斷某人係咪為他人利益行事；確認 user 係咪 RCASP 或 FI 時，可以例如將 user 提供嘅資料同（如有）受監管機構名單交叉核對。

items.title: 實體 user 係 X 國嘅 partnership，X 國將 partnership 當稅務透明、唔徵稅。按 OECD，佢係咪 X 國稅務居民？
items.short: 唔係 X 國居民；冇稅務居民地嘅 partnership 當作實際管理地所在稅…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶45：partnership 喺某申報稅區被當稅務透明，就唔「liable to tax」，所以唔可以係嗰度居民。¶46：冇稅務居民地嘅 partnership、LLP 或類似法律安排，當作實際管理地所在稅區嘅居民。Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.2(3) 亦容許用實際管理地或主要辦事處地址。

quotes.text: Where, however, a partnership is treated as fiscally transparent in a Reportable Jurisdiction, the partnership is not “liable to tax” in that jurisdiction, and so cannot be a resident thereof.

An Entity such as a partnership, limited liability partnership or similar legal arrangement that has no residence for tax purposes shall be treated as resident in the jurisdiction in which its place of effective management is situated.

option_explains: 錯：稅務透明就唔係居民。
options: 唔係 X 國居民；冇稅務居民地嘅 partnership 當作實際管理地所在稅區嘅居民
係，因為喺 X 國成立
佢係所有合夥人居住地嘅居民
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶45：partnership 喺某申報稅區被當稅務透明，就唔「liable to tax」，所以唔可以係嗰度居民。¶46：冇稅務居民地嘅 partnership、LLP 或類似法律安排，當作實際管理地所在稅區嘅居民。Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.2(3) 亦容許用實際管理地或主要辦事處地址。

items.title: OECD Commentary 點定義「place of effective management」？
items.short: 實質上作出整體業務所需關鍵管理同商業決策嘅地方，要考慮所有相關事實
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶47：「place of effective management」係實質上作出經營實體整體業務所需關鍵管理同商業決策嘅地方，要審視所有相關事實同情況。

quotes.text: The “place of effective management” is the place where key management and commercial decisions that are necessary for the conduct of the Entity’s business as a whole are in substance made.

option_explains: 錯：註冊地唔等於實際管理地。
錯：唔係 Commentary 嘅定義。
options: 公司註冊辦事處所在地
實質上作出整體業務所需關鍵管理同商業決策嘅地方，要考慮所有相關事實
大部分員工工作嘅地方
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶47：「place of effective management」係實質上作出經營實體整體業務所需關鍵管理同商業決策嘅地方，要審視所有相關事實同情況。

items.title: reportable person 包括已故申報稅區居民嘅 estate。「estate」點解釋？
items.short: 按各稅區有關死亡時權利義務轉移或繼承嘅規則（例如概括繼承）
items.detail: s.50M(1) reportable person (a)(ii)：包括已故申報稅區稅務居民嘅 estate。Commentary on Section IV ¶48：「estate」要參考各稅區有關死亡時權利義務轉移或繼承嘅規則（例如 universal succession）。

quotes.text: an individual or entity that is a resident for tax purposes of a reportable jurisdiction; or (ii) the estate of a deceased person who was a resident for tax purposes of a reportable jurisdiction; but (b) does not include an excluded person;

In determining what is meant by “estate”, reference must be made to each jurisdiction’s particular rules on the transfer or inheritance of rights and obligations in the event of death (e.g. the rules on universal succession).

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 話按各稅區規則。
options: 按各稅區有關死亡時權利義務轉移或繼承嘅規則（例如概括繼承）
items.explain: s.50M(1) reportable person (a)(ii)：包括已故申報稅區稅務居民嘅 estate。Commentary on Section IV ¶48：「estate」要參考各稅區有關死亡時權利義務轉移或繼承嘅規則（例如 universal succession）。

items.title: Commissioner 根據 s.50M(13) 公佈嘅 reportable jurisdiction 名單，法律性質係？
items.short: 唔係附屬法例；OECD 期望名單公開並適時更新
items.detail: s.50M(13)：Commissioner 可以按佢指明方式公佈 partner／reportable jurisdiction 名單；(14)：名單唔係附屬法例。Commentary on Section IV ¶49：每個稅區要公開名單，並適時更新（例如簽署或生效交換協議時）。香港 CARF reportable／partner jurisdiction 名單未公佈（U3）。

quotes.text: The Commissioner may, by a list published in the manner specified by the Commissioner, specify any of the following— (a) for the purposes of the definition of partner jurisdiction in subsection (1)—the partner jurisdictions; (b) for the purposes of the definition of reportable jurisdiction in subsection (1)—the reportable jurisdictions. (14) A list published under subsection (13) is not subsidiary legislation.

Each jurisdiction must make such a list publicly available, and update it as appropriate (e.g. every time the jurisdiction signs an agreement with respect to exchanging information under these rules, or such an agreement enters into force).

option_explains: 啱：s.50M(14) 同 Commentary on Section IV ¶49。
options: 唔係附屬法例；OECD 期望名單公開並適時更新
附屬法例，要經立法會先訂立後審議
OECD 統一公佈，香港冇自己名單
items.explain: s.50M(13)：Commissioner 可以按佢指明方式公佈 partner／reportable jurisdiction 名單；(14)：名單唔係附屬法例。Commentary on Section IV ¶49：每個稅區要公開名單，並適時更新（例如簽署或生效交換協議時）。香港 CARF reportable／partner jurisdiction 名單未公佈（U3）。

items.title: 一個稅區要成為 CARF「partner jurisdiction」，Ord 8 要求咩？
items.short: 喺香港以外、已就 CARF 實施同等法律要求，而且喺 Commissioner…
items.detail: s.50M(1) partner jurisdiction：香港以外、(a) 已就 CARF 實施同等法律要求，而且 (b) 喺 Commissioner 根據 s.50M(13)(a) 公佈嘅名單上嘅地方。Commentary on Section IV ¶73 亦係「equivalent legal requirements」加公開名單。香港 CARF reportable／partner jurisdiction 名單未公佈（U3）。

quotes.text: outside Hong Kong— (a) that has put in place equivalent legal requirements in relation to CARF; and (b) that is specified in a list published under subsection (13)(a) by the Commissioner;

options: 喺香港以外、已就 CARF 實施同等法律要求，而且喺 Commissioner 公佈嘅名單入面
items.explain: s.50M(1) partner jurisdiction：香港以外、(a) 已就 CARF 實施同等法律要求，而且 (b) 喺 Commissioner 根據 s.50M(13)(a) 公佈嘅名單上嘅地方。Commentary on Section IV ¶73 亦係「equivalent legal requirements」加公開名單。香港 CARF reportable／partner jurisdiction 名單未公佈（U3）。

items.title: 以下邊個唔屬 Ord 8 嘅「entity」？
items.short: 自然人
items.detail: s.50M(1) entity：(a) 自然人以外、可以同金融機構建立長期客戶關係或擁有財產嘅實體，或者法律安排；(b) 包括法團、合夥、其他團體同信託。Commentary on Section IV ¶75：亦包括 foundation、co-operative、association 等。

quotes.text: an entity, other than a natural person, that can establish a permanent customer relationship with a financial institution or otherwise own property; or (ii) a legal arrangement; and (b) includes a corporation, partnership and any other body of persons (incorporated or unincorporated) and a trust;

Thus, e.g. a corporation, partnership, trust, fideicomiso, foundation (fondation, Stiftung), company, co-operative, association, or asociación en participación, falls within the meaning of the term “Entity”.

option_explains: 啱：entity 係自然人以外嘅法人或法律安排。
items.explain: s.50M(1) entity：(a) 自然人以外、可以同金融機構建立長期客戶關係或擁有財產嘅實體，或者法律安排；(b) 包括法團、合夥、其他團體同信託。Commentary on Section IV ¶75：亦包括 foundation、co-operative、association 等。

items.title: 遊客喺 crypto ATM 做一次過（one-off）港元買 BTC，之後唔會再嚟。RCASP 使唔使攞 self-cert？
items.short: 要：建立關係可以包括一次過交易，交易前要攞 self-cert 並確認合理
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.2(1)：同個人 crypto-asset user 建立關係時要攞 self-cert 並確認合理。Commentary on Section III ¶3：建立關係「may include a one-off transaction」。

quotes.text: When establishing the relationship with an individual crypto-asset user, or with respect to a pre-existing individual crypto-asset user, an HKRCASP must— (a) (subject to paragraph (b)) obtain from the individual crypto-asset user a self-certification that enables the HKRCASP to determine the jurisdiction of residence of the user;
Subparagraph A(1) specifies that, upon the establishment of a relationship with the user, which may include a one-off transaction, a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider must:

錯：$390,000 係 RRPT 門檻。
啱：Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.2(1) 同 Commentary on Section III ¶3。

items.title: 新客戶 self-cert 話佢係 A 國稅務居民，但 KYC 地址喺香港。佢解釋佢係香港大學嘅 A 國交換生，持學生簽證。RCASP 可以點？
items.short: 取得呢個合理解釋同相關文件（並保留副本或記錄），self-cert 就可以通過…
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.2(2)：self-cert 唔通過合理性測試，要喺提供服務前攞有效 self-cert，或者合理解釋同文件（並保留副本或記錄）。Commentary on Section III ¶10：合理解釋例子包括喺相關稅區教育機構讀書並持適當簽證嘅學生。

quotes.text: In the case of a self-certification that fails the reasonableness test, the HKRCASP must either— (a) obtain a valid self-certification; or (b) obtain a reasonable explanation and documentation (as appropriate) supporting the reasonableness of the self-certification and retain a copy or a notation of such explanation and documentation, before providing the service of effectuating relevant transactions to the individual crypto-asset user.
is a student at an educational institution in the relevant jurisdiction and holds the appropriate visa (if applicable);

items.title: 客戶 self-cert 話係 X 國稅務居民，但 KYC 地址喺香港。佢話自己係 X 國派駐香港嘅外交官，並出示外交護照。self-cert 通唔通過合理性測試？
items.short: 通過：有合理解釋同文件支持
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶10 例子：self-cert 居民地同 AML/KYC 住址衝突，客戶解釋佢係某稅區外交官因而係嗰度居民，並出示外交護照；RCASP 取得合理解釋同文件，self-cert 通過合理性測試。Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.2(2)(b) 要保留副本或記錄。

quotes.text: The Individual Crypto-Asset User explains that she is a diplomat from a particular jurisdiction and that, as a consequence, she is resident in such jurisdiction; she also presents her diplomatic passport.

In the case of a self-certification that fails the reasonableness test, the HKRCASP must either— (a) obtain a valid self-certification; or (b) obtain a reasonable explanation and documentation (as appropriate) supporting the reasonableness of the self-certification and retain a copy or a notation of such explanation and documentation, before providing the service of effectuating relevant transactions to the individual crypto-asset user.

option_explains: 啱：Commentary on Section III ¶10 例子。
options: 唔通過，地址唔夾一定唔得

items.title: 以下邊項係 OECD Commentary 列出、可以支持 self-cert 合理性嘅「reasonable explanation」例子？
items.short: 佢係跨境工作者，或者係行走兩地嘅貨車／火車僱員

quotes.text: or (4) is a frontier worker or employee working on a truck or train travelling between jurisdictions.

items.title: 客戶 self-cert 寫明稅務居民地係新加坡，但 self-cert 上填嘅住址喺台灣，冇任何解釋。self-cert 通唔通過合理性測試？
items.short: 唔通過：self-cert 嘅住址唔喺聲稱嘅居民稅區，資料衝突
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶9 例子 2：self-cert 嘅住址唔喺客戶聲稱嘅稅務居民稅區，因為資料衝突，self-cert 唔通過合理性測試。RCASP 要按 Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.2(2) 喺提供服務前補救。

quotes.text: The residence address contained in the self-certification is not in the jurisdiction in which the Individual Crypto-Asset User claims to be resident for tax purposes. Because of the conflicting information, the self-certification fails the reasonableness test.

In the case of a self-certification that fails the reasonableness test, the HKRCASP must either— (a) obtain a valid self-certification; or (b) obtain a reasonable explanation and documentation (as appropriate) supporting the reasonableness of the self-certification and retain a copy or a notation of such explanation and documentation, before providing the service of effectuating relevant transactions to the individual crypto-asset user.

option_explains: 啱：Commentary on Section III ¶9 例子 2。
錯：簽名唔可以補救衝突。
options: 唔通過：self-cert 嘅住址唔喺聲稱嘅居民稅區，資料衝突
通過，因為 self-cert 本身有齊欄位
只要客戶簽咗名就通過

items.title: 實體 user 喺 BVI 成立（KYC 只顯示成立地），self-cert 聲稱係新加坡稅務居民，解釋按相關稅法以實際管理地決定居民地，而實際管理喺新加坡。可唔可以接受？
items.short: 可以：有合理解釋，self-cert 唔算錯誤或不可靠，通過合理性測試
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶31 例子 2：AML/KYC 只顯示成立地，實體聲稱係另一稅區居民，並解釋相關稅法以實際管理地決定居民地；有合理解釋，self-cert 通過合理性測試。Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.2(2)：唔通過就要喺提供服務前補救。

quotes.text: The Entity Crypto-Asset User explains to the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider that under relevant tax laws its residence for tax purposes is determined by reference to place of effective management, and that the jurisdiction where its effective management is situated differs from the jurisdiction in which it was incorporated.
Thus, because there is a reasonable explanation of the conflicting information, the self-certification is not incorrect or unreliable and, as a consequence, passes the reasonableness test.

option_explains: 錯：好多稅區以管理地決定居民。
啱：Commentary on Section III ¶31 例子 2。
options: 唔可以，居民地一定係成立地
可以：有合理解釋，self-cert 唔算錯誤或不可靠，通過合理性測試
可以，但要報 BVI 同新加坡兩個

items.title: OECD Commentary 用咩標準判斷 RCASP「有理由知道」（reason to know）self-cert 唔可靠？
items.short: 一個處於 RCASP 位置、合理審慎嘅人會質疑該聲稱
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶12：如果 RCASP 對相關事實或 self-cert 內容嘅認知，令處於佢位置嘅合理審慎人士會質疑該聲稱，RCASP 就有理由知道 self-cert 唔可靠或唔正確；文件或檔案入面有同聲稱衝突嘅資料亦一樣。Sch 17EA Pt 6 s.2：知道或有理由知道就唔可以依賴。

quotes.text: A Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider has reason to know that a self-certification is unreliable or incorrect if its knowledge of relevant facts or statements contained in the self-certification or other documentation is such that a reasonably prudent person in the position of the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider would question the claim being made.
An HKRCASP may not rely on self-certification or documentary evidence if the HKRCASP knows, or has reason to know, that the self-certification or documentary evidence is incorrect or unreliable,

option_explains: 錯：RCASP 自己嘅知識都計。
錯：簽名唔排除 reason to know。
options: 只有 IRD 通知先算
只要客戶簽咗聲明就永遠唔算

items.title: 客戶 self-cert 聲稱係日本稅務居民，但「日本 TIN」一欄留空，亦冇解釋。按 OECD Commentary，RCASP 係咪「有理由知道」self-cert 唔可靠？
items.short: 係：self-cert 喺同聲稱相關嘅項目上唔完整
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶13：self-cert 喺同聲稱相關嘅任何項目上唔完整、有同聲稱不一致嘅資料，或者 RCASP 有其他不一致資料，RCASP 就有理由知道佢唔可靠或唔正確。Sch 17EA Pt 5 s.5：申報稅區居民嘅 self-cert 要包括該稅區 TIN（除 s.4 情況）。

quotes.text: A Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider has reason to know that a self-certification provided by a person is unreliable or incorrect if the self-certification is incomplete with respect to any item on the self-certification that is relevant to the claims made by the person,

If a self-certification establishes that a crypto-asset user (whether an individual or entity) or a controlling person is a resident for tax purposes in a reportable jurisdiction, the self-certification must, subject to section 4 of this Part, include the user’s or controlling person’s TIN with respect to the reportable jurisdiction and, if any, each other reportable jurisdiction.

option_explains: 錯：同聲稱相關嘅項目唔完整就有理由知道。
options: 係：self-cert 喺同聲稱相關嘅項目上唔完整
要等 IRD 查詢先知

items.title: 揾錯處：「我哋將 self-cert 審核外判俾服務商，服務商知道客戶資料有問題但冇話我哋知，所以我哋唔算『有理由知道』。」
items.short: 錯：依賴服務商審核同保存 self-cert，服務商知道嘅事實會當 RCASP…
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶13：依賴服務商審核同保存 self-cert 嘅 RCASP，「is considered to know or have reason to know the facts within the knowledge of the service provider」。s.50U(1) 容許委聘服務商，但盡職審查責任仍喺 RCASP（Commentary on Section III ¶51）。

quotes.text: A Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider that relies on a service provider to review and maintain a self-certification is considered to know or have reason to know the facts within the knowledge of the service provider.

A service provider may be engaged to carry out, for or on behalf of an HKRCASP, the HKRCASP’s obligations under any or all of the following provisions— (a) section 50O(1); (b) section 50P(1); (c) section 50P(2); (d) section 50Q(1). (2) To avoid doubt, even if a service provider has been engaged, the HKRCASP is not relieved from the HKRCASP’s obligation under section 50O(1), 50P(1) or (2) or 50Q(1), as the case requires.

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 講明知識歸屬 RCASP。
options: 冇錯，RCASP 唔使為服務商負責
錯：依賴服務商審核同保存 self-cert，服務商知道嘅事實會當 RCASP 知道或有理由知道
錯：服務商要負全部法律責任
items.explain: Commentary on Section III ¶13：依賴服務商審核同保存 self-cert 嘅 RCASP，「is considered to know or have reason to know the facts within the knowledge of the service provider」。s.50U(1) 容許委聘服務商，但盡職審查責任仍喺 RCASP（Commentary on Section III ¶51）。

items.title: 客戶親身到 OTC 櫃枱開戶，出示嘅身份證相片明顯唔似本人。RCASP 可唔可以依賴呢份文件？
items.short: 唔可以：親身出示而相片或簽名唔符合出示者，文件唔可靠
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶14：文件唔能夠合理確立出示者身份，RCASP 唔可以依賴；例如個人親身出示文件，但相片或簽名同本人外貌或簽名唔符合。Sch 17EA Pt 6 s.2：知道或有理由知道文件唔可靠就唔可以依賴。

quotes.text: For example, documentation is not reliable if it is provided in person by an individual and the photograph or signature on the documentation does not match the appearance or signature of the person presenting the document.
An HKRCASP may not rely on self-certification or documentary evidence if the HKRCASP knows, or has reason to know, that the self-certification or documentary evidence is incorrect or unreliable,

option_explains: 錯：要合理確立出示者身份。
options: 可以，只要客戶再簽一次 self-cert
唔可以：親身出示而相片或簽名唔符合出示者，文件唔可靠
items.explain: Commentary on Section III ¶14：文件唔能夠合理確立出示者身份，RCASP 唔可以依賴；例如個人親身出示文件，但相片或簽名同本人外貌或簽名唔符合。Sch 17EA Pt 6 s.2：知道或有理由知道文件唔可靠就唔可以依賴。

items.title: 客戶喺 RCASP App「個人檔案」加咗一個德國電話號碼同德國郵寄地址，但冇改 self-cert。呢個改動係咪 change of circumstances？
items.short: 係：任何關聯檔案嘅資料改變或增加，影響 user 身份，就屬 change o…
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.3(1)：change of circumstances 包括 (a) 增加同 user 身份相關或不一致嘅資料；(b) 同 user 有關嘅任何檔案資料改變或增加而影響其身份。德國聯絡資料可能顯示德國居民身份，RCASP 要按 Pt 3 s.2(3) 處理。

quotes.text: any change or addition of information to any profile associated with the user that affects the status of the user.

option_explains: 錯：關聯檔案資料改變都計。
options: 係：任何關聯檔案嘅資料改變或增加，影響 user 身份，就屬 change of circumstances
只有客戶書面通知先算
items.explain: Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.3(1)：change of circumstances 包括 (a) 增加同 user 身份相關或不一致嘅資料；(b) 同 user 有關嘅任何檔案資料改變或增加而影響其身份。德國聯絡資料可能顯示德國居民身份，RCASP 要按 Pt 3 s.2(3) 處理。

items.title: 按 OECD Commentary，RCASP 應該點樣準備好處理 change of circumstances？
items.short: 建立程序識別 change of circumstances，並通知提供 se…
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶16：RCASP「is expected to」建立程序確保識別到構成 change of circumstances 嘅改變；亦「is expected to」通知提供 self-cert 嘅人，佢有責任通知 RCASP 情況改變。Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.3(6)：冇理由知道有改變就唔使主動查。

quotes.text: Therefore, a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider is expected to institute procedures to ensure that any change that constitutes a change in circumstances is identified by the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider.

In addition, a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider is expected to notify any person providing a self-certification of the person’s obligation to notify the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider of a change in circumstances.

The HKRCASP may rely on a self-certification without having to inquire into possible changes of circumstances that may affect the validity of the self-certification unless the HKRCASP knows, or has reason to know, that such changes have occurred.

options: 等客戶自己講，乜都唔使做
建立程序識別 change of circumstances，並通知提供 self-cert 嘅人有責任通知 RCASP 情況改變
每月要求所有客戶重新交 self-cert
items.explain: Commentary on Section III ¶16：RCASP「is expected to」建立程序確保識別到構成 change of circumstances 嘅改變；亦「is expected to」通知提供 self-cert 嘅人，佢有責任通知 RCASP 情況改變。Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.3(6)：冇理由知道有改變就唔使主動查。
items.caveat: 呢個係 OECD Commentary 嘅期望做法（香港 s.50Y 要求按 CARF publications 一致解釋），Ord 8 條文冇逐字規定。

quotes.text: The HKRCASP may rely on a self-certification without having to inquire into possible changes of circumstances that may affect the validity of the self-certification unless the HKRCASP knows, or has reason to know, that such changes have occurred.

items.title: 客戶 self-cert 嘅住址改咗（仍喺同一稅區），但稅務居民地、TIN 等其他資料冇變。change of circumstances 令成份 self-cert 全部失效？
items.short: 唔係：change of circumstances 只令唔再可靠嘅資料失效，…
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.3(3)：影響 self-cert 嘅 change of circumstances，令 self-cert 就「the information that is no longer reliable」失效，直至資料更新。Commentary on Section III ¶15 亦一樣。

quotes.text: A change of circumstances affecting the self-certification provided to the HKRCASP renders the self-certification invalid with respect to the information that is no longer reliable until the information is updated.

option_explains: 錯：只限唔再可靠嘅資料。
錯：地址可能影響，要判斷。

items.title: RCASP 可唔可以只用電子形式保存 self-cert，冇紙本正本？
items.short: 可以：self-cert（包括正本）可以只以電子形式存在
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶18：RCASP 可以保存 self-cert 正本、核證副本、影印本（包括縮微、電子掃描或類似電子儲存）或電子副本；self-cert（包括正本）亦可以只以電子形式存在。s.50P(1)(a)(iii) 嘅保存期照適用。

quotes.text: The self-certification (including the original) may also exist solely in electronic format.

secure that any evidence relied on, and any record of the steps taken, for carrying out the procedures in relation to a crypto-asset user and a controlling person are kept until the expiry of— (A) subject to sub-subparagraph (B), a period of 6 years immediately after the calendar year to which the evidence and record relate;

options: 唔可以，一定要紙本正本
可以：self-cert（包括正本）可以只以電子形式存在

items.title: 客戶 self-cert 居民地欄寫「SG」，RCASP 手上有佢嘅新加坡政府身份證明文件。self-cert 可唔可以當有效？
items.short: 可以：縮寫同政府身份證明嘅稅區合理吻合，屬無關重要錯誤，可以用確定性文件補救
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.4：self-cert 有 inconsequential error，而 HKRCASP 有足夠確定性文件補充，就可以當有效。Commentary on Section III ¶19：例如縮寫居民地，而 RCASP 有該人來自合理吻合稅區嘅政府身份證明。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP may treat a self-certification that contains an inconsequential error as valid if the HKRCASP has sufficient documentation on file to supplement the information missing from the self-certification owing to the error, in which case the documentation must be conclusive.

abbreviated the jurisdiction of residence may be treated as valid, notwithstanding the abbreviation, if the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider has government issued identification for the person from a jurisdiction that reasonably matches the abbreviation.

options: 可以，即使冇任何其他文件

items.title: 客戶 self-cert 居民地寫「AU」，但佢護照係奧地利（Austria）。RCASP 可唔可以當無關重要錯誤補救？
items.short: 唔可以：縮寫同護照顯示嘅稅區唔合理吻合，唔屬無關重要錯誤
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶19：居民地縮寫同護照顯示嘅稅區唔合理吻合，唔係 inconsequential error；冇填居民地亦唔係；self-cert 內容同自身或 RCASP 檔案資料矛盾都唔係。要攞有效 self-cert（Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.2）。

quotes.text: On the other hand, an abbreviation for the jurisdiction of residence that does not reasonably match the jurisdiction of residence shown on the person’s passport is not an inconsequential error. A failure to provide a jurisdiction of residence is not an inconsequential error.

An HKRCASP may treat a self-certification that contains an inconsequential error as valid if the HKRCASP has sufficient documentation on file to supplement the information missing from the self-certification owing to the error, in which case the documentation must be conclusive.

錯：RCASP 唔可以自行改居民地。

可以，自行改做 AT 就得
items.explain: Commentary on Section III ¶19：居民地縮寫同護照顯示嘅稅區唔合理吻合，唔係 inconsequential error；冇填居民地亦唔係；self-cert 內容同自身或 RCASP 檔案資料矛盾都唔係。要攞有效 self-cert（Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.2）。

items.title: 以下邊項「可以」當 inconsequential error，用檔案文件補救？
items.short: 居民地縮寫，而手上政府身份證明嘅稅區同縮寫合理吻合
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶19：縮寫居民地而有合理吻合嘅政府身份證明，可以當有效；但冇填居民地、或資料同 self-cert 本身或 RCASP 檔案矛盾，都唔係 inconsequential error。Sch 17EA Pt 3 s.4：補救用嘅文件要具確定性。

quotes.text: abbreviated the jurisdiction of residence may be treated as valid, notwithstanding the abbreviation, if the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider has government issued identification for the person from a jurisdiction that reasonably matches the abbreviation.

In addition, information on a self-certification that contradicts other information contained on the self-certification or in the files of the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider is not an inconsequential error.

options: 居民地縮寫，而手上政府身份證明嘅稅區同縮寫合理吻合
self-cert 資料同 RCASP 檔案資料矛盾

items.title: 一個 LLP user（稅務透明、冇稅務居民地）self-cert 話自己冇居民地。RCASP 冇任何文件顯示佢嘅實際管理地，只知主要辦事處地址。可以點？
items.short: 可以用主要辦事處地址決定佢嘅居民地
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.2(3)：實體聲明冇稅務居民地，HKRCASP 可以依賴實際管理地或主要辦事處地址決定居民地。CARF FAQ Section III Q1：如果冇其他文件可以決定實際管理地，可以依賴主要辦事處地址。

quotes.text: If the entity crypto-asset user certifies that it is not a resident for tax purposes in any jurisdiction, the HKRCASP may rely on the place of effective management, or on the address of the principal office, of the user to determine the user’s jurisdiction of residence.

Yes, to the extent the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider has no other documentation available to determine the place of effective management of the Entity Crypto-Asset User, the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider may rely on the address of the principal office of the Entity for purposes of determining what jurisdiction such Entity is resident in for purposes of the CARF.

option_explains: 錯：法例同 FAQ 有處理方法。
啱：Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.2(3) 同 CARF FAQ Section III Q1。
options: 可以用主要辦事處地址決定佢嘅居民地
items.explain: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.2(3)：實體聲明冇稅務居民地，HKRCASP 可以依賴實際管理地或主要辦事處地址決定居民地。CARF FAQ Section III Q1：如果冇其他文件可以決定實際管理地，可以依賴主要辦事處地址。

items.title: 按 OECD Commentary，以下邊個係「實體冇稅務居民地」嘅典型例子？
items.short: 被當作稅務透明嘅實體，或者喺冇公司所得稅制度稅區嘅實體
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶28：實體冇稅務居民地嘅例子包括被當作稅務透明嘅實體，以及位於冇公司所得稅制度稅區嘅實體；RCASP 可以用實際管理地或（作為替代）主要辦事處地址決定居民地。

quotes.text: Examples of cases where an Entity Crypto-Asset User has no residence for tax purposes includes Entities treated as fiscally transparent and Entities resident in a jurisdiction with no corporate income tax system.

If the entity crypto-asset user certifies that it is not a resident for tax purposes in any jurisdiction, the HKRCASP may rely on the place of effective management, or on the address of the principal office, of the user to determine the user’s jurisdiction of residence.

items.title: 實體 user 係紐約證交所上市公司。RCASP 可唔可以先確定佢係 excluded person，而唔使先逐步確定佢嘅稅務居民地？
items.short: 可以：判斷實體 user 係咪 reportable user 時，可以按最適…
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶25：判斷實體 user 係咪 reportable user，可以按情況最適合嘅次序跟從 B(1)(a)、(b) 指引，例如先確定佢係 excluded person，所以唔係 reportable user。Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.2(4)：可以基於 self-cert、手上或公開資料合理判定。

quotes.text: In determining whether an Entity Crypto-Asset User is a Reportable User, the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider may follow the guidance on subparagraphs B(1)(a) and (b) in the order most appropriate under the circumstances.

option_explains: 錯：要合理判定佢係 excluded person。
options: 唔可以，一定要按次序做
可以：判斷實體 user 係咪 reportable user 時，可以按最適合嘅次序，例如先確定佢係 excluded person
上市公司唔使做任何盡職審查
items.explain: Commentary on Section III ¶25：判斷實體 user 係咪 reportable user，可以按情況最適合嘅次序跟從 B(1)(a)、(b) 指引，例如先確定佢係 excluded person，所以唔係 reportable user。Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.2(4)：可以基於 self-cert、手上或公開資料合理判定。

items.title: RCASP 判斷 controlling person 稅務居民地，可唔可以用實體 user 代 CP 填嘅 self-cert，而唔係 CP 本人親自交？

items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.5(1)：判斷 CP 係咪 reportable person，HKRCASP 要依賴「obtained from the user or the controlling person」嘅 self-cert，並按資料（包括 AML/KYC 文件）確認合理。Commentary on Section III ¶35 亦一樣。

quotes.text: For the purpose of determining whether a controlling person of an entity crypto-asset user is a reportable person, an HKRCASP must— (a) rely on a self-certification obtained from the user or the controlling person that enables the HKRCASP to determine the jurisdiction of residence of the controlling person;

items.explain: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.5(1)：判斷 CP 係咪 reportable person，HKRCASP 要依賴「obtained from the user or the controlling person」嘅 self-cert，並按資料（包括 AML/KYC 文件）確認合理。Commentary on Section III ¶35 亦一樣。

items.title: 實體 user 嘅 CP self-cert 唔通過合理性測試，RCASP 仲未攞到有效 self-cert 或合理解釋。可唔可以先為實體 user 執行交易？

quotes.text: In the case of a self-certification that fails the reasonableness test, the HKRCASP must either— (a) obtain a valid self-certification; or (b) obtain a reasonable explanation and documentation (as appropriate) supporting the reasonableness of the self-certification and retain a copy or a notation of such explanation and documentation, before providing the service of effectuating relevant transactions to the entity crypto-asset user.

option_explains: 錯：90 日係 change of circumstances 嘅寬限，唔適用於開戶時。

可以，CP 問題唔影響實體交易
可以，90 日內補交就得

items.title: 一間 passive 實體 user（唔係 active entity 或 excluded person）交 self-cert，CP 冇另外交 self-cert，AML/KYC 亦未確定 CP 角色。實體 self-cert 要額外包括咩？

items.explain: Sch 17EA Pt 5 s.3(c)(v)：實體唔係 active entity 或 excluded person，self-cert 要包括每位 CP 嘅 s.2 資料（除非該 CP 已自己交 self-cert），以及每位 reportable person 作為 CP 嘅角色（如未按 AML/KYC 確定）；(vi) 如適用，仲要包括符合 active entity 或 excluded person 嘅準則。

items.title: 實體 user 聲稱係 active entity。邊條要求佢嘅 self-cert（如適用）包括佢符合 active entity 嘅準則資料？

items.title: 一間公司嘅 self-cert 由佢嘅財務經理簽，佢唔係董事，但持有公司董事會書面授權簽署文件。可唔可以接受？
items.short: 可以：有實體書面授權代簽文件嘅人，一般屬有權簽 self-cert 嘅人
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶46：有權簽實體 self-cert 嘅人一般包括公司高級人員或董事、合夥人、受託人或同等職銜，以及任何獲實體書面授權代簽文件嘅人。Sch 17EA Pt 5 s.3(a)：要由 user 簽署或以其他方式確認。

quotes.text: A person with authority to sign a self-certification of an Entity Crypto-Asset User generally includes an officer or director of a corporation, a partner of a partnership, a trustee of a trust, any equivalent of the former titles, and any other person that has been provided written authorisation by the Entity Crypto-Asset User to sign documentation on such person’s behalf.

A self-certification provided by an entity crypto-asset user is valid only if the self-certification— (a) is signed or otherwise positively affirmed by the user; (b) is dated and the date is not later than the date of receipt; and (c) contains the following information with respect to the user— (i) legal name; (ii) address; (iii) jurisdiction or jurisdictions of residence;

option_explains: 錯：書面授權人士都可以。
options: 可以：有實體書面授權代簽文件嘅人，一般屬有權簽 self-cert 嘅人

items.title: 長者客戶由佢按本地法律授權嘅受託代理人代簽 CARF self-cert。self-cert 有冇效？
items.short: 可以有效：self-cert 可以由按本地法律獲授權代表該人簽署嘅任何人簽署（…
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶42：self-cert 可以由按本地法律獲授權代表個人 user 或 CP 簽署嘅任何人簽署（或以其他方式確認）。Sch 17EA Pt 5 s.2(a) 要求簽署或確認；其他內容要求照適用。

quotes.text: A self-certification may be signed (or otherwise positively affirmed) by any person authorised to sign on behalf of the Individual Crypto-Asset User or Controlling Person under domestic law.

A self-certification provided by an individual crypto-asset user or a controlling person is valid only if the self-certification— (a) is signed or otherwise positively affirmed by the user or controlling person; (b) is dated and the date is not later than the date of receipt; and (c) contains the following information with respect to the user or controlling person— (i) first and last name; (ii) residential address; (iii) jurisdiction or jurisdictions of residence; (iv) with respect to each reportable person—the TIN with respect to each reportable jurisdiction of such reportable person; and (v) date of birth.

options: 可以有效：self-cert 可以由按本地法律獲授權代表該人簽署嘅任何人簽署（或確認）
items.explain: Commentary on Section III ¶42：self-cert 可以由按本地法律獲授權代表個人 user 或 CP 簽署嘅任何人簽署（或以其他方式確認）。Sch 17EA Pt 5 s.2(a) 要求簽署或確認；其他內容要求照適用。

quotes.text: The self-certification may be pre-populated by the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider to include the Individual Crypto-Asset User’s or Controlling Person’s information, except for the jurisdiction(s) of residence for tax purposes, to the extent already available in its records.

items.title: HKRCASP 同時係 CRS RFI，客戶之前已交 CRS self-cert，包括 Pt 5 s.2 所需全部資料。CARF 可唔可以依賴呢份 self-cert？
items.short: 可以：已為其他稅務目的收集、符合 Sch 17EA Pt 5 要求嘅 self…
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 2 s.4：HKRCASP 可以依賴為其他稅務目的已收集嘅 self-cert，只要符合 Pt 5 要求。Commentary on Section III ¶39：包括 CRS、本地申報、FATCA 或 FATCA IGA 收集嘅 self-cert，只要包含 C(1) 全部資料。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP may also rely on a self-certification already collected for other tax purposes, provided that such self-certification meets the requirements of Part 5 of this Schedule.

Further, the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider may rely on a self-certification collected in respect of the Individual Crypto-Asset User or Controlling Person under the Common Reporting Standard or a self-certification already collected for other tax purposes, such as for domestic reporting purposes, in the context of the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA), or for purposes of a FATCA Intergovernmental Agreement, to the extent it contains all of the information referred to in subparagraph C(1).

option_explains: 啱：Sch 17EA Pt 2 s.4 同 Commentary on Section III ¶39。
錯：要符合全部 Pt 5 要求。

items.title: 客戶之前為 FATCA 交咗一份聲明，有姓名、地址同稅務居民地，但冇出生日期。HKRCASP 可唔可以直接當 CARF self-cert 用？
items.short: 唔可以直接用：要符合 Pt 5 s.2 全部要求（包括出生日期），先可以依賴
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 2 s.4：依賴其他稅務目的 self-cert 嘅前提係「meets the requirements of Part 5」。Pt 5 s.2(c)：個人 self-cert 要有姓名、住址、居民地、TIN（申報人士）同出生日期。缺項要補齊。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP may also rely on a self-certification already collected for other tax purposes, provided that such self-certification meets the requirements of Part 5 of this Schedule.

A self-certification provided by an individual crypto-asset user or a controlling person is valid only if the self-certification— (a) is signed or otherwise positively affirmed by the user or controlling person; (b) is dated and the date is not later than the date of receipt; and (c) contains the following information with respect to the user or controlling person— (i) first and last name; (ii) residential address; (iii) jurisdiction or jurisdictions of residence; (iv) with respect to each reportable person—the TIN with respect to each reportable jurisdiction of such reportable person; and (v) date of birth.

option_explains: 錯：要符合 Pt 5 要求。
啱：Sch 17EA Pt 2 s.4 同 Pt 5 s.2。
錯：Pt 5 s.2(c)(v) 要求出生日期。

items.title: HKRCASP 同時係 CRS RFI，已按 Sch 17D Part 6 完成實體帳戶嘅盡職審查。CARF 下可以點？
items.short: 可以依賴該程序，履行 Sch 17EA Part 4（實體 user）盡職審查
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 2 s.2：可以依賴 Sch 17D Part 4 程序履行 Pt 3（個人）；s.3：可以依賴 Sch 17D Part 6 程序履行 Pt 4（實體）。Commentary on Section III ¶48：確保同時係 CRS RFI 嘅 RCASP 一致應用。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP that is also a reporting financial institution for the purposes of the Common Reporting Standard may rely on the due diligence procedures completed pursuant to Part 6 of Schedule 17D for the purposes of performing the due diligence procedures pursuant to Part 4 of this Schedule.

An HKRCASP that is also a reporting financial institution for the purposes of the Common Reporting Standard may rely on the due diligence procedures completed pursuant to Part 4 of Schedule 17D for the purposes of performing the due diligence procedures pursuant to Part 3 of this Schedule.

items.title: RCASP 用網上系統收 self-cert。按 OECD Commentary，電子系統要符合咩要求？
items.short: 確保收到嘅資料就係發出嘅資料；記錄所有提交、更新或修改嘅存取；確保填表者係 s…
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶41：self-cert 可以任何方式同形式提供；電子提供嘅話，系統要確保收到嘅資料係發出嘅資料，記錄所有導致提交、更新或修改 self-cert 嘅存取；系統設計同存取程序要確保填表者係 self-cert 上嘅人，並能夠應要求提供所有電子 self-cert 嘅硬本。實體 self-cert 亦適用（¶47）。

quotes.text: The self-certification may be provided in any manner and in any form. If the self-certification is provided electronically, the electronic system must ensure that the information received is the information sent, and must document all occasions of user access that result in the submission, renewal, or modification of a self-certification.

In addition, the design and operation of the electronic system, including access procedures, must ensure that the person accessing the system and furnishing the self-certification is the person named in the self-certification, and must be capable of providing upon request a hard copy of all self-certifications provided electronically.

options: 確保收到嘅資料就係發出嘅資料；記錄所有提交、更新或修改嘅存取；確保填表者係 self-cert 上嘅人；可應要求提供硬本
一定要用政府電子簽署
items.explain: Commentary on Section III ¶41：self-cert 可以任何方式同形式提供；電子提供嘅話，系統要確保收到嘅資料係發出嘅資料，記錄所有導致提交、更新或修改 self-cert 嘅存取；系統設計同存取程序要確保填表者係 self-cert 上嘅人，並能夠應要求提供所有電子 self-cert 嘅硬本。實體 self-cert 亦適用（¶47）。

items.title: X 國會向居民發 TIN，但 X 國本地法律唔要求呢類機構收集 TIN。X 國居民客戶嘅 CARF self-cert 冇 TIN，HKRCASP 可唔可以接受？
items.short: 可以：TIN 由申報稅區發出，但該稅區本地法律唔要求收集，就唔使收
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 5 s.4：(a) 居民稅區唔向該人發 TIN；或 (b) 申報稅區有發 TIN，但其本地法律唔要求收集，都唔使收集 TIN。否則 Pt 5 s.5 要求包括每個申報稅區嘅 TIN。

quotes.text: Despite sections 2 and 3 of this Part, no TIN is required to be collected if— (a) the jurisdiction of residence of the reportable person does not issue a TIN to the reportable person; or (b) where a TIN is issued by the relevant reportable jurisdiction—such TIN is not required to be collected under the domestic law of the jurisdiction.

options: 唔可以，有發 TIN 就一定要收
可以，所有 TIN 都係自願

items.title: 客戶 self-cert 聲明係英國同澳洲雙重稅務居民（兩個都係 reportable jurisdiction）。self-cert 要包括幾多個 TIN？
items.short: 英國同澳洲各一個 TIN（除非 Pt 5 s.4 例外適用）
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 5 s.5：self-cert 顯示 user 係申報稅區居民，要包括該稅區及每個其他申報稅區嘅 TIN（受 s.4 限制）。Pt 6 s.3：雙重居民要申報全部居民地。Commentary on Section III ¶5：要就每個申報稅區當 reportable user。

quotes.text: If a self-certification establishes that a crypto-asset user (whether an individual or entity) or a controlling person is a resident for tax purposes in a reportable jurisdiction, the self-certification must, subject to section 4 of this Part, include the user’s or controlling person’s TIN with respect to the reportable jurisdiction and, if any, each other reportable jurisdiction.

In those circumstances, the expectation is that all jurisdictions of residence are to be declared in a self-certification and that the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider must treat the Individual Crypto-Asset User as a Reportable User in respect of each Reportable Jurisdiction.

options: 英國同澳洲各一個 TIN（除非 Pt 5 s.4 例外適用）

items.title: HKRCASP 想對所有客戶（包括居於非申報稅區嘅客戶）一律收 self-cert，方便日後新增 reportable jurisdiction。Ord 8 容唔容許？
items.short: 容許：s.50P(3) 准許對任何 crypto-asset user 應用 …
items.detail: s.50P(3)：HKRCASP 可以對任何 crypto-asset user 應用 required procedures，即使 user（或非 active／excluded 實體嘅 CP）係香港以外非申報稅區嘅稅務居民，並為佢哋識別同收集 required information。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP may, in carrying out the HKRCASP’s obligations under this Part, apply the required procedures— (a) in relation to any crypto-asset user, even if— (i) the user is a resident for tax purposes in a territory outside Hong Kong that is not a reportable jurisdiction;

items.title: HKRCASP 為執行盡職審查而依賴嘅證據同步驟紀錄，一般要保存幾耐？

items.title: HKRCASP 委聘服務商收集 self-cert，服務商漏收部分客戶。盡職審查責任喺邊個？
items.short: 仍然喺 HKRCASP：可以用服務商收集嘅文件，但盡職審查責任唔轉移
items.detail: s.50U(1)：HKRCASP 可以委聘服務商代為履行 s.50O(1)、50P(1)、(2) 或 50Q(1) 責任；s.50U(2)：即使委聘咗，HKRCASP 都唔會免除責任。Commentary on Section III ¶51：RCASP 可以用服務商收集嘅文件（包括 self-cert），但「The due diligence obligations remain, however, the responsibility of the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers」。

quotes.text: A service provider may be engaged to carry out, for or on behalf of an HKRCASP, the HKRCASP’s obligations under any or all of the following provisions— (a) section 50O(1); (b) section 50P(1); (c) section 50P(2); (d) section 50Q(1). (2) To avoid doubt, even if a service provider has been engaged, the HKRCASP is not relieved from the HKRCASP’s obligation under section 50O(1), 50P(1) or (2) or 50Q(1), as the case requires.

In such cases, Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers may use the documentation (including a self-certification) collected by service providers, subject to the conditions described in domestic law. The due diligence obligations remain, however, the responsibility of the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers.

option_explains: 啱：s.50U(1) 同 Commentary on Section III ¶51。
options: 仍然喺 HKRCASP：可以用服務商收集嘅文件，但盡職審查責任唔轉移

items.title: 代理人為多間 RCASP 共用一個資訊系統保存 self-cert。按 OECD Commentary，代理人要有咩安排？
items.short: 每間 RCASP 可以容易查閱文件性質、內容同有效性；代理人要有系統將影響文件…
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶52：代理人可以為一間或多間 RCASP 維持資訊系統保存文件，條件包括每間 RCASP 可以容易查閱文件性質、內容（包括副本）同有效性，並可以傳送影響可靠性嘅事實；代理人亦要有系統確保收到影響可靠性或 user 身份嘅資訊會提供俾所有相關 RCASP。

quotes.text: The agent may retain the documentation as part of an information system maintained for a single Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider or multiple Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers provided that under the system, any Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider on behalf of which the agent retains documentation may easily access data regarding the nature of the documentation,

The agent must have a system in effect to ensure that any information it receives regarding facts that affect the reliability of the documentation or the status assigned to the Crypto-Asset User are provided to all Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers for which the agent retains the documentation.

items.title: 多間 RCASP 處理同一交易，想指定其中一間做全部盡職審查。按 OECD Commentary，合約安排應該包括咩？
items.short: RCASP 要向第三方提供所需資料；而且 RCASP 可以從第三方取得已收集核…
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶56：要依賴第三方（包括另一 RCASP）執行盡職審查，應該有適當合約安排，包括 RCASP 向第三方提供所需資料，以及確保 RCASP 可以取得第三方收集同核實嘅資料，以證明合規（例如審計）。香港 s.50S(13)–(19) 有指定安排條文。

quotes.text: In order for a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider to be able to rely on a third party (including another Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider) for the performance of the due diligence obligations under Section III, appropriate contractual arrangements should be put in place.

The arrangements should also ensure that the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider can obtain any information collected and verified in respect of Crypto-Asset Users from the third party(ies) to allow the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider to demonstrate compliance with the requirements of Section III, for instance in the framework of an audit.

option_explains: 錯：Commentary 要求適當合約安排。
options: 第三方承擔全部法律責任
RCASP 要向第三方提供所需資料；而且 RCASP 可以從第三方取得已收集核實嘅資料，以便證明合規（例如審計）

items.explain: Commentary on Section III ¶58：RCASP 要確保所有文件同資料喺申報期完結後最少 5 年可供查閱（即使清盤或結業），包括識別 user 嘅資料，以及同 A(3)(i) 須申報轉帳相關嘅外部錢包地址或同等識別碼。香港 s.50S 保存期係 6 年。

items.title: 一位外交官按派出國稅法「被視為」該國稅務居民（deemed resident）。CARF self-cert 嘅居民地應該點睇？
items.short: 居民地按各稅區本地法律決定，包括被視為居民嘅情況（例如外交官）
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶5：個人係咪稅務居民由各稅區本地法律決定，包括按稅法被視為居民嘅情況（例如外交官或其他政府人員）。個人通常只有一個居民地，但可以有多個；要全部申報（Sch 17EA Pt 6 s.3）。

quotes.text: They also cover cases where an individual is deemed, according to the taxation laws of a jurisdiction, to be resident of that jurisdiction (e.g. diplomats or other persons in government service).

If a crypto-asset user or a controlling person is a resident for tax purposes in 2 or more jurisdictions under the domestic laws of such jurisdictions, such user or controlling person— (a) cannot rely on the tiebreaker rules contained in any applicable tax arrangements to determine the user’s or controlling person’s jurisdiction of residence; and (b) must declare all of the user’s or controlling person’s jurisdictions of residence.

options: 居民地按各稅區本地法律決定，包括被視為居民嘅情況（例如外交官）

items.title: 客戶唔肯定自己係咪某申報稅區嘅稅務居民。按 OECD Commentary，邊個應該幫佢？
items.short: 申報稅區應該協助納稅人決定其稅務居民地並提供資料
items.detail: Commentary on Section III ¶6：申報稅區應該協助納稅人決定其稅務居民地並提供相關資料，例如透過各種納稅人服務渠道；OECD 會盡力協助發佈資料。RCASP 唔需要做獨立稅法分析（Commentary on Section III ¶8）。

items.title: HKRCASP 想委託第三方代為提交 CARF 報表。按 OECD FAQ，報表應該用邊個名義、責任喺邊個？
items.short: 用 RCASP 名義提交，申報責任仍然喺 RCASP
items.detail: CARF FAQ Section II Q3：稅區可以考慮容許 RCASP 依賴第三方履行申報責任；如果咁做，報表應以 RCASP 名義提交，責任仍然喺 RCASP。香港 s.50U(1) 容許服務商代為履行 s.50Q(1) 等責任；s.50U(2) 下 HKRCASP 仍然負責。

quotes.text: Where a Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider relies on a third party to fulfil the reporting obligations pursuant to Section II, the reporting should be done in the name of the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider and the reporting obligations remain the responsibility of the Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Provider.

A service provider may be engaged to carry out, for or on behalf of an HKRCASP, the HKRCASP’s obligations under any or all of the following provisions— (a) section 50O(1); (b) section 50P(1); (c) section 50P(2); (d) section 50Q(1). (2) To avoid doubt, even if a service provider has been engaged, the HKRCASP is not relieved from the HKRCASP’s obligation under section 50O(1), 50P(1) or (2) or 50Q(1), as the case requires.

option_explains: 錯：FAQ 講明責任喺 RCASP。
options: 用第三方名義，責任轉移
用 RCASP 名義提交，申報責任仍然喺 RCASP
第三方同 RCASP 平分責任

items.title: 實體 user 嘅 CP 搬咗去加拿大，HKRCASP 經 AML 重新核實得知。實體同 CP 嘅 self-cert 點處理？
items.short: 唔可以再依賴原 self-cert，要攞有效 self-cert，或者合理解釋…
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.6(1)：取得實體 user 或 CP 嘅 self-cert 後，user 或 CP 出現 change of circumstances 令 HKRCASP 知道或有理由知道原 self-cert 唔正確或唔可靠，就唔可以依賴，要攞有效 self-cert 或合理解釋同文件。90 日寬限同之後處理見 Pt 4 s.6(5)–(6)。

quotes.text: If, subsequent to an HKRCASP’s obtaining a self-certification (original self-certification) from an entity crypto-asset user or a controlling person, there is a change of circumstances with respect to the user or controlling person that causes the HKRCASP to know, or to have reason to know, that the original self-certification is incorrect or unreliable, the HKRCASP— (a) cannot rely on the original self-certification; and (b) must obtain a valid self-certification or a reasonable explanation and (as appropriate) a documentation supporting the validity of the original self-certification.

option_explains: 錯：CP 嘅改變都係 change of circumstances。
錯：改變嘅係 CP 居民地，唔係實體。
options: 唔使理，因為實體本身冇變
即時當實體係加拿大居民

items.title: CARF 嘅「controlling persons」概念對應 FATF 邊個概念，要點樣解釋？
items.short: 對應 FATF Recommendation 10 嘅「beneficial …
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶50：Controlling Persons 對應 FATF Recommendation 10 及其解釋性註釋嘅「beneficial owner」（2012 年 2 月版），要同 FATF Recommendations 一致解釋，目的係保護國際金融體系免被濫用（包括稅務罪行）。香港 s.50M(1) 引用 s.50A(1) 嘅 CRS 定義。

quotes.text: This term corresponds to the term “beneficial owner” as described in Recommendation 10 and the Interpretative Note on Recommendation 10 of the FATF Recommendations (as adopted in February 2012), and must be interpreted in a manner consistent with such Recommendations, with the aim of protecting the international financial system from misuse including with respect to tax crimes.
controlling person (控權人) has the meaning given by section 50A(1);

options: 對應 FATF Recommendation 10 嘅「beneficial owner」，要同 FATF Recommendations 一致解釋
對應會計準則嘅「母公司」
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶50：Controlling Persons 對應 FATF Recommendation 10 及其解釋性註釋嘅「beneficial owner」（2012 年 2 月版），要同 FATF Recommendations 一致解釋，目的係保護國際金融體系免被濫用（包括稅務罪行）。香港 s.50M(1) 引用 s.50A(1) 嘅 CRS 定義。

items.title: 對法人實體，OECD Commentary 點樣描述「controlling ownership interest」？
items.short: 視乎法人擁有權結構，通常按風險為本門檻識別，例如擁有超過某百分比（例如 25%…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶51：對法人，控制一般由最終擁有 controlling ownership interest 嘅自然人行使；controlling ownership interest 視乎擁有權結構，通常按風險為本門檻識別（例如擁有超過 25%）。實際門檻跟適用 AML/KYC 規則。

quotes.text: A “controlling ownership interest” depends on the ownership structure of the legal person and is usually identified on the basis of a threshold applying a risk-based approach (e.g. any person(s) owning more than a certain percentage of the legal person, such as 25%).
“Control” over an Entity is generally exercised by the natural person(s) who ultimately has a controlling ownership interest in the Entity.

只計持有最多股份嗰位

items.title: 公司 Z 股權極度分散，冇任何人擁有超過門檻，但創辦人透過股東協議有權委任全部董事。Z 嘅 controlling person 係邊個？

items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶51：冇自然人透過擁有權控制時，CP 係透過其他方式控制實體嘅自然人；仍然冇人被識別，先至用高級管理人員。創辦人透過委任全部董事嘅權力控制 Z。

quotes.text: Where no natural person(s) exercises control through ownership interests, the Controlling Person(s) of the Entity will be the natural person(s) who exercises control of the Entity through other means.

items.title: 一個酌情信託：受託人係專業信託公司，保護人有權但從未行使，受益人係「委託人嘅後代」。邊啲人一定要當作 controlling persons？

quotes.text: The settlor(s), the trustee(s), the protector(s) (if any), and the beneficiary(ies) or class(es) of beneficiaries, must always be treated as Controlling Persons of a trust, regardless of whether or not any of them exercises control over the trust.

items.title: 非牟利實體向業主支付合理租金使用其物業。按 OECD Commentary，呢筆付款會唔會令佢唔符合 active entity (f) 嘅「唔准分派」條件？
items.short: 唔會：作為使用物業嘅合理補償，可以付俾私人或非慈善實體
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶60：(f) 嘅分派限制容許按慈善活動、合理服務報酬、購買物業嘅公平市值付款；此外「could be distributed to … a private person or noncharitable Entity as payment of reasonable compensation for the use of property」。香港 s.50M(1) active entity (f)(iv) 列 (A)–(C)；租用物業補償透過 s.50Y 參考 Commentary。

quotes.text: In addition, the income or assets of the Entity could be distributed to, or applied for the benefit of, a private person or noncharitable Entity as payment of reasonable compensation for the use of property.

options: 會，任何付俾私人嘅款項都唔得
唔會：作為使用物業嘅合理補償，可以付俾私人或非慈善實體
items.explain: Commentary on Section IV ¶60：(f) 嘅分派限制容許按慈善活動、合理服務報酬、購買物業嘅公平市值付款；此外「could be distributed to … a private person or noncharitable Entity as payment of reasonable compensation for the use of property」。香港 s.50M(1) active entity (f)(iv) 列 (A)–(C)；租用物業補償透過 s.50Y 參考 Commentary。

items.title: 以下邊類組織可以符合 active entity (f)（非牟利）嘅 (i) 項描述？
items.short: 商會或專業組織
items.detail: s.50M(1) active entity (f)(i)：(A) 專門為宗教、慈善、科學、藝術、文化、體育或教育目的設立及運作；或 (B) 專業組織、商業聯盟、商會、勞工組織、農業或園藝組織、公民聯盟，或專門促進社會福利嘅組織。仲要符合 (ii)–(v)。

quotes.text: the entity is established and operated in its jurisdiction of residence, and— (A) is established and operated exclusively for religious, charitable, scientific, artistic, cultural, athletic or educational purposes; or (B) is a professional organization, business league, chamber of commerce, labour organization, agricultural or horticultural organization, civic league or an organization operated exclusively for the promotion of social welfare; (ii) the entity is exempt from income tax in its jurisdiction of residence; (iii) the entity has no shareholders or members who have a proprietary or beneficial interest in its income or assets;

items.explain: s.50M(1) active entity (f)(i)：(A) 專門為宗教、慈善、科學、藝術、文化、體育或教育目的設立及運作；或 (B) 專業組織、商業聯盟、商會、勞工組織、農業或園藝組織、公民聯盟，或專門促進社會福利嘅組織。仲要符合 (ii)–(v)。

items.title: 實體要成為 active entity，要符合 s.50M(1) active entity (a)–(f) 幾多項？
items.short: 任何一項
items.detail: s.50M(1)：active entity 係「an entity that falls within any of the following descriptions」。Commentary on Section IV ¶55：實體符合 D(11) 任何一項準則就係 Active Entity。

quotes.text: An Entity is an Active Entity, provided that it meets any of the criteria listed in subparagraph D(11).

in terms of the entity’s gross income and its assets— (i) for the calendar year or other appropriate reporting period preceding the year in which the determination as to whether the entity is an active entity is made, less than 50% of the entity’s gross income is passive income; and (ii) less than 50% of the assets held by the entity during that calendar year or period are assets that produce, or are held for the production of, passive income;

items.explain: s.50M(1)：active entity 係「an entity that falls within any of the following descriptions」。Commentary on Section IV ¶55：實體符合 D(11) 任何一項準則就係 Active Entity。

quotes.text: With respect to an entity crypto-asset user (other than an excluded person), an HKRCASP must determine whether the user has one or more controlling persons who are reportable persons unless the HKRCASP determines that the user is an active entity on the basis of a self-certification provided by the user.

identify the jurisdiction of residence of— (A) a crypto-asset user who is a customer of the HKRCASP; and (B) for an entity crypto-asset user that is an entity other than an active entity and an excluded person—the controlling person of the user;

items.title: 實體 user 係 Y 國居民（Y 唔係 reportable jurisdiction），但佢係 passive（唔係 active entity 或 excluded person），而 CP 係英國居民。HKRCASP 仲要唔要理 CP？
items.short: 要：就 excluded person 以外嘅實體，除非係 active en…
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.1：Part 4 用嚟判斷實體 user 係咪 reportable user，「or」係咪有 reportable person CP 嘅實體（excluded person 或 active entity 除外）。Pt 4 s.3 冇以實體居民地為條件。所以 CP 係英國居民（申報稅區）就要按 s.50Q(4) 申報。

quotes.text: With respect to an entity crypto-asset user (other than an excluded person), an HKRCASP must determine whether the user has one or more controlling persons who are reportable persons unless the HKRCASP determines that the user is an active entity on the basis of a self-certification provided by the user.

options: 唔使，實體唔係申報稅區居民就完

items.title: Passive 實體 user 嘅 CP 係新加坡稅務居民（假設唔係香港 reportable jurisdiction）。HKRCASP 可唔可以照樣收集佢嘅 self-cert 同資料？

一定要收兼申報俾 IRD

items.title: 一間公司嘅收入幾乎全部係持有銀行存款嘅利息同上市股票股息，資產主要係存款同股票。按 active entity (a)，佢點？

items.title: 一個 passive 實體 user 有 3 位 25% 股東同一位行政總裁。股東全部係透過擁有權控制嘅自然人。邊啲人係 CP？
items.short: 3 位透過擁有權控制嘅股東（按適用門檻）；行政總裁只喺冇人透過擁有權或其他方式…
items.detail: Commentary on Section IV ¶51：CP 首先係最終擁有 controlling ownership interest 嘅自然人（門檻按風險為本，例如超過 25%；具體跟適用 AML/KYC 規則）；冇人透過擁有權控制，就睇其他方式；仍冇人，先係 senior managing official。

quotes.text: A “controlling ownership interest” depends on the ownership structure of the legal person and is usually identified on the basis of a threshold applying a risk-based approach (e.g. any person(s) owning more than a certain percentage of the legal person, such as 25%).

Where no natural person(s) exercises control through ownership interests, the Controlling Person(s) of the Entity will be the natural person(s) who exercises control of the Entity through other means.

option_explains: 錯：高級管理人員只係最後備選。
options: 3 位透過擁有權控制嘅股東（按適用門檻）；行政總裁只喺冇人透過擁有權或其他方式控制時先係

items.detail: s.50S(8)：解散後，(a) 冇有效指定時，specified officer 嘅聯絡資料有改變，該 specified officer 要喺 1 個月內通知 Commissioner；(b) 有有效指定時，由 designated officer 通知佢自己嘅改變。

quotes.text: After the dissolution of the entity as mentioned in subsection (7)— (a) if no designation of a designated officer is in effect and there is any change in the contact details of a specified officer—the specified officer must give a notice of the change to the Commissioner within 1 month after the change; or (b) if a designation of a designated officer is in effect and there is any change in the contact details of the designated officer—the designated officer must give a notice of the change to the Commissioner within 1 month after the change.

option_explains: 錯：有 1 個月期限，責任喺該 specified officer。
options: 喺改變後 1 個月內通知 Commissioner
由其他董事代為通知就得，冇期限
items.explain: s.50S(8)：解散後，(a) 冇有效指定時，specified officer 嘅聯絡資料有改變，該 specified officer 要喺 1 個月內通知 Commissioner；(b) 有有效指定時，由 designated officer 通知佢自己嘅改變。

items.title: 已解散前 HKRCASP 有 4 位 specified officers。其中一位已經向 Commissioner 交咗解散通知（s.50S(7)(a)）。其他 3 位仲要唔要各自再交？
items.short: 唔使：任何一位 specified officer 交嘅解散通知，當作全部 s…
items.detail: s.50S(9)：就 s.50S(7)(a) 而言，「a notice given by any specified officer of a dissolved entity is to be regarded as being given by every specified officer of the entity」。但紀錄保存（s.50S(7)(b)）責任仍然喺每位 specified officer（除非有效指定 designated officer）。

quotes.text: For the purposes of subsection (7)(a), a notice given by any specified officer of a dissolved entity is to be regarded as being given by every specified officer of the entity.

options: 唔使：任何一位 specified officer 交嘅解散通知，當作全部 specified officers 已交
items.explain: s.50S(9)：就 s.50S(7)(a) 而言，「a notice given by any specified officer of a dissolved entity is to be regarded as being given by every specified officer of the entity」。但紀錄保存（s.50S(7)(b)）責任仍然喺每位 specified officer（除非有效指定 designated officer）。

items.title: Specified officers 指定 designated officer，指定通知要包括咩？
items.short: 由 designated officer 簽署表示同意；列明佢同實體嘅關係身份…
items.detail: s.50S(14)：指定通知要 (a) 由 designated officer 簽署表示同意；(b) 列明其身份（capacity）、聯絡資料同指定日期；(c) 附上同意指定嘅證據（s.50S(13) 要全部 specified officers 書面同意，或按 s.50S(15) 獲 Commissioner 接納）。

quotes.text: A designation under subsection (13) must be made by a notice that— (a) is signed by the designated officer signifying the designated officer’s consent to be designated; (b) sets out the following details— (i) the capacity of the designated officer in relation to the entity; (ii) the contact details of the designated officer; (iii) the date on which the designation is made; and (c) is accompanied by the evidence of the agreement to designate the designated officer.

option_explains: 錯：要 designated officer 簽署表示同意等。
options: 由 designated officer 簽署表示同意；列明佢同實體嘅關係身份、聯絡資料同指定日期；附上同意指定嘅協議證據
items.explain: s.50S(14)：指定通知要 (a) 由 designated officer 簽署表示同意；(b) 列明其身份（capacity）、聯絡資料同指定日期；(c) 附上同意指定嘅證據（s.50S(13) 要全部 specified officers 書面同意，或按 s.50S(15) 獲 Commissioner 接納）。

items.title: 指定通知寫明指定日期係 3 月 1 日，Commissioner 3 月 10 日收到（全部 specified officers 都同意）。指定幾時有效、幾時生效？
items.short: 3 月 10 日起有效，並當作由 3 月 1 日起生效
items.detail: s.50S(17)：(a) 指定由 Commissioner 收到指定通知當日起有效（如非全部 specified officers 同意，就由 Commissioner 按 s.50S(15) 當作已同意嗰日起）；(b) 有效後「is taken to have effect from the date of designation set out in the designation notice」。

quotes.text: A designation under subsection (13)— (a) is valid from— (i) (subject to subparagraph (ii)) the date of receipt of the designation notice by the Commissioner;
if the designation is valid under paragraph (a)—is taken to have effect from the date of designation set out in the designation notice.

option_explains: 錯：有效日係收到通知嗰日。
錯：有效後當作由指定日期生效。
options: 3 月 10 日起有效，並當作由 3 月 1 日起生效
3 月 1 日起有效同生效
3 月 10 日起有效同生效
items.explain: s.50S(17)：(a) 指定由 Commissioner 收到指定通知當日起有效（如非全部 specified officers 同意，就由 Commissioner 按 s.50S(15) 當作已同意嗰日起）；(b) 有效後「is taken to have effect from the date of designation set out in the designation notice」。

items.title: Designated officer 交通知終止指定，通知寫明終止生效日係 6 月 30 日，Commissioner 7 月 20 日先收到。指定幾時終止？
items.short: 7 月 20 日：通知喺終止生效日後超過 14 日先收到，就以收到日為準
items.detail: s.50S(18)(a)：收到 designated officer 嘅終止通知，(i) 喺終止生效日後 14 日內收到，以終止生效日為準；(ii) 超過 14 日先收到，以收到日為準；(iii) 喺終止生效日或之前收到，以終止生效日為準。7 月 20 日已超過 14 日。

quotes.text: if a notice of cessation of the designation is received by the Commissioner from that person— (i) within a period of 14 days after the effective date of cessation of the designation stated in the notice (cessation effective date)—the cessation effective date; (ii) after the period mentioned in subparagraph (i)—the date on which the notice is received by the Commissioner;

options: 7 月 20 日：通知喺終止生效日後超過 14 日先收到，就以收到日為準
items.explain: s.50S(18)(a)：收到 designated officer 嘅終止通知，(i) 喺終止生效日後 14 日內收到，以終止生效日為準；(ii) 超過 14 日先收到，以收到日為準；(iii) 喺終止生效日或之前收到，以終止生效日為準。7 月 20 日已超過 14 日。

items.title: 除咗 designated officer 自己交終止通知，指定仲會因咩終止？
items.short: Commissioner 收到指定另一人取代佢嘅指定通知，以該通知嘅指定日期為準
items.detail: s.50S(18)：指定喺最早嘅以下日期終止：(a) 收到該人終止通知（按 14 日規則）；(b)「if a designation notice designating another person … to replace that person is received by the Commissioner—the date of designation set out in the notice」。

quotes.text: if a designation notice designating another person under subsection (13) to replace that person is received by the Commissioner—the date of designation set out in the notice.

options: 公司解散滿 1 年自動終止
Commissioner 收到指定另一人取代佢嘅指定通知，以該通知嘅指定日期為準
items.explain: s.50S(18)：指定喺最早嘅以下日期終止：(a) 收到該人終止通知（按 14 日規則）；(b)「if a designation notice designating another person … to replace that person is received by the Commissioner—the date of designation set out in the notice」。

items.title: 已解散前 HKRCASP 嘅 specified officers 有效指定咗 designated officer。之後 specified officers 仲要唔要自己負責紀錄保存？
items.short: 唔使：有有效指定，specified officers 就相關條文同要求獲解除…
items.detail: s.50S(19)：有 s.50S(17) 有效指定，全部 specified officers 就獲解除遵守相關條文（s.50S(13)(a) 或 (b) 列明嘅）同要求嘅責任，例如紀錄保存（s.50S(7)(b)）、聯絡資料改變（s.50S(8)）同 s.50S(12) 資料要求。IRD 簡報例子：Ms W 由指定生效日起負責。

quotes.text: If there is a valid designation under subsection (17), all specified officers are relieved from their obligations to comply with—

options: 唔使：有有效指定，specified officers 就相關條文同要求獲解除責任
要，同 designated officer 一齊負責
items.explain: s.50S(19)：有 s.50S(17) 有效指定，全部 specified officers 就獲解除遵守相關條文（s.50S(13)(a) 或 (b) 列明嘅）同要求嘅責任，例如紀錄保存（s.50S(7)(b)）、聯絡資料改變（s.50S(8)）同 s.50S(12) 資料要求。IRD 簡報例子：Ms W 由指定生效日起負責。

items.title: Specified officers 已經交咗解散通知（s.50S(7)(a)）之後先指定 designated officer。呢個指定涵蓋邊啲責任？
items.short: s.50S(7)(b) 紀錄保存、s.50S(8) 聯絡資料通知、同 s.50…

quotes.text: if a notice under subsection (7)(a) has been given— (i) subsection (7)(b); (ii) subsection (8); and (iii) the requirement under subsection (12).

options: 包括重新交 s.50S(7)(a) 解散通知
s.50S(7)(b) 紀錄保存、s.50S(8) 聯絡資料通知、同 s.50S(12) 遵從資料要求通知

items.title: Assessor 根據 s.50S(11) 可以向邊啲人發通知要求提供資料？
items.short: HKRCASP、曾經係 HKRCASP 嘅個人或實體、specified of…
items.detail: s.50S(11)：assessor 可以向 HKRCASP、曾經係 HKRCASP 嘅個人或實體、specified officer 或 designated officer（如有）發通知，要求提供資料以確定 (a) s.50N nexus；或 (b) s.50Q(1) 報表資料係咪準確完整。

quotes.text: An assessor may give a notice to an HKRCASP, an individual or entity that was an HKRCASP, a specified officer or a designated officer (if any) requiring the HKRCASP, the individual or entity or the officer concerned (as the case may be) to provide information for the purposes of ascertaining—

options: HKRCASP、曾經係 HKRCASP 嘅個人或實體、specified officer 或 designated officer
items.explain: s.50S(11)：assessor 可以向 HKRCASP、曾經係 HKRCASP 嘅個人或實體、specified officer 或 designated officer（如有）發通知，要求提供資料以確定 (a) s.50N nexus；或 (b) s.50Q(1) 報表資料係咪準確完整。

items.title: HKRCASP 收到 s.50S(11) 通知，要求 21 日內以指定電子表格提供資料。HKRCASP 可唔可以 2 個月後用 PDF 信件回覆？
items.short: 唔可以：要喺通知指明期間內，並按通知指明嘅方法同形式遵從
items.detail: s.50S(12)：收到 s.50S(11) 通知嘅人要 (a) 喺通知指明期間內；(b) 按通知指明嘅方法同形式（如有）遵從。冇合理辯解唔遵從可能涉及罰則（見 s.80R）。

quotes.text: The HKRCASP, individual, entity, specified officer or designated officer (if any) must comply with a notice under subsection (11)— (a) within the period specified in the notice; and (b) by the means and in the form (if any) specified in the notice.

option_explains: 錯：要按通知指明期間同形式。
錯：期間同形式都要符合。
options: 唔可以：要喺通知指明期間內，並按通知指明嘅方法同形式遵從
items.explain: s.50S(12)：收到 s.50S(11) 通知嘅人要 (a) 喺通知指明期間內；(b) 按通知指明嘅方法同形式（如有）遵從。冇合理辯解唔遵從可能涉及罰則（見 s.80R）。

items.title: 公司解散前一刻有董事 A、B；董事 C 一年前已辭職。邊個係 s.50S 嘅 specified officers？
items.short: A 同 B：specified officer 係解散前一刻嘅每位董事（冇董事…
items.detail: s.50S(20)：specified officer 指實體「immediately before the dissolution」嘅每位董事；如冇董事，就係每位受託人或負責管理實體嘅人。IRD 簡報例子：Mr X 解散前已辭職，紀錄保存責任由 Mr Y、Mr Z 負責。

quotes.text: specified officer (指明人員), in relation to an entity that falls within the description in subsection (7), means every person who was a director of (or, if there was no director, every person who was a trustee of, or who was responsible for the management of) the entity immediately before the dissolution.

option_explains: 錯：C 唔係解散前一刻嘅董事。
options: A 同 B：specified officer 係解散前一刻嘅每位董事（冇董事就係受託人或負責管理嘅人）
items.explain: s.50S(20)：specified officer 指實體「immediately before the dissolution」嘅每位董事；如冇董事，就係每位受託人或負責管理實體嘅人。IRD 簡報例子：Mr X 解散前已辭職，紀錄保存責任由 Mr Y、Mr Z 負責。

items.title: HKRCASP 根據 s.50S(3) 通知改地址、或 s.50S(4) 通知停止做 HKRCASP，要用咩形式？
items.short: 經 Commissioner 指定系統發送嘅電子紀錄，按 Commission…
items.detail: s.50V(3)：s.50S(3) 或 (6)(a) 嘅通知、或 s.50S(4)、(5) 嘅通知，要以經 Commissioner 指定系統發送嘅電子紀錄，並按 Commissioner 指明方式發出。s.50V(8)：Commissioner 可以喺唔符合時仍然接受。

quotes.text: A notification under section 50S(3) or (6)(a), or a notice under section 50S(4) or (5), must be given— (a) in the form of an electronic record that is sent by using a system designated by the Commissioner; and (b) in the manner specified by the Commissioner.

option_explains: 錯：條文係指定系統電子紀錄。
options: 一定要親身到稅務大樓
經 Commissioner 指定系統發送嘅電子紀錄，按 Commissioner 指明方式
items.explain: s.50V(3)：s.50S(3) 或 (6)(a) 嘅通知、或 s.50S(4)、(5) 嘅通知，要以經 Commissioner 指定系統發送嘅電子紀錄，並按 Commissioner 指明方式發出。s.50V(8)：Commissioner 可以喺唔符合時仍然接受。

items.title: 就 CARF 登記、報表同通知嘅電子通訊，Commissioner 有咩權力？
items.short: 可以批准密碼同指定任何系統
items.detail: s.50V(4)：「The Commissioner may approve a password and designate any system in respect of any communication with the Commissioner for the purposes of subsections (1), (2) and (3)」，即登記、報表同 s.50S 通知。IRD 表示會建立 CARF Portal。

quotes.text: The Commissioner may approve a password and designate any system in respect of any communication with the Commissioner for the purposes of subsections (1), (2) and (3).

options: 可以批准密碼同指定任何系統
可以要求紙本加蓋公司印
items.explain: s.50V(4)：「The Commissioner may approve a password and designate any system in respect of any communication with the Commissioner for the purposes of subsections (1), (2) and (3)」，即登記、報表同 s.50S 通知。IRD 表示會建立 CARF Portal。

items.title: 已停止營業嘅前 HKRCASP 用電郵（唔係指定系統）通知 IRD 佢已停止。Commissioner 可唔可以接受？
items.short: 可以：Commissioner 可以一般地或個別地，接受唔符合 s.50V(3…
items.detail: s.50V(8)：Commissioner 可以一般地或就個別個案，接受 s.50S 嘅通知或通報，即使唔符合 s.50V(3) 或 (5) 要求。s.50V(9)：Commissioner 可以用佢認為適當嘅方法指明接受嘅情況或條件。

quotes.text: The Commissioner may, either generally or in a particular case, accept a notification or notice for the purposes of section 50S, despite a requirement under subsection (3) or (5) not being complied with in relation to the notification or notice.

The Commissioner may, by a means that the Commissioner considers appropriate, specify the circumstances or conditions in or on which— (a) a registration may be accepted under subsection (6); or (b) a return, notification or notice may be accepted under subsection (7) or (8). (10) A notice under subsection (5) and a specification under subsection (9) are not subsidiary legislation.

options: 唔可以，一定要經指定系統
可以：Commissioner 可以一般地或個別地，接受唔符合 s.50V(3) 或 (5) 要求嘅 s.50S 通知
items.explain: s.50V(8)：Commissioner 可以一般地或就個別個案，接受 s.50S 嘅通知或通報，即使唔符合 s.50V(3) 或 (5) 要求。s.50V(9)：Commissioner 可以用佢認為適當嘅方法指明接受嘅情況或條件。

items.title: Commissioner 根據 s.50V(9) 指明「幾時可以接受唔合規格嘅登記、報表或通知」，呢個指明嘅法律性質係？
items.short: 唔係附屬法例；Commissioner 可以用佢認為適當嘅方法指明
items.detail: s.50V(9)：Commissioner 可以用佢認為適當嘅方法，指明可以按 s.50V(6)、(7)、(8) 接受登記、報表或通知嘅情況或條件。s.50V(10)：s.50V(5) 公告同 (9) 指明都唔係附屬法例。

quotes.text: The Commissioner may, by a means that the Commissioner considers appropriate, specify the circumstances or conditions in or on which— (a) a registration may be accepted under subsection (6); or (b) a return, notification or notice may be accepted under subsection (7) or (8). (10) A notice under subsection (5) and a specification under subsection (9) are not subsidiary legislation.

options: 唔係附屬法例；Commissioner 可以用佢認為適當嘅方法指明
items.explain: s.50V(9)：Commissioner 可以用佢認為適當嘅方法，指明可以按 s.50V(6)、(7)、(8) 接受登記、報表或通知嘅情況或條件。s.50V(10)：s.50V(5) 公告同 (9) 指明都唔係附屬法例。

items.title: 一個以非法團合夥形式運作嘅 HKRCASP，由合夥人 P 負責同客戶維持關係。Part 8B 嘅責任落喺邊個身上？
items.short: 代 HKRCASP 同其 crypto-asset users 維持關係嘅人（…

quotes.text: In relation to an HKRCASP that is an entity but not a corporation, this Part applies to a person who acts for the HKRCASP to maintain a relationship with the HKRCASP’s crypto-asset users as if the obligations under this Part were imposed on that person.

options: 代 HKRCASP 同其 crypto-asset users 維持關係嘅人（P），當作責任加諸佢身上

items.explain: s.50T：就屬實體但唔係法團嘅 HKRCASP，Part 8B「applies to a person who acts for the HKRCASP to maintain a relationship with the HKRCASP’s crypto-asset users as if the obligations under this Part were imposed on that person」。

items.title: Ord 8 嘅「HKRCASP」係指咩？
items.short: 符合 s.50N(1) 及 (2) 任何準則嘅 RCASP

持有證監會 VATP 牌照嘅平台

items.title: HKRCASP 根據 s.50P(1) 建立嘅程序，要點樣處理 Sch 17EA？

items.detail: s.50P(1)：HKRCASP 要 (a) 建立程序識別居民地、reportable user／person、保存證據、識別收集 required information；(b)「incorporate into those procedures the due diligence requirements in Schedule 17EA」。

quotes.text: incorporate into those procedures the due diligence requirements in Schedule 17EA.

options: Sch 17EA 只係參考，可以唔跟
只需要納入 CRS 嘅 Sch 17D
將 Sch 17EA 嘅盡職審查要求納入程序

items.title: 揾錯處：「我哋已經寫好 CARF 盡職審查手冊，法例只要求建立程序，實際用唔用係我哋嘅事。」

quotes.text: Firstly, a jurisdiction implementing the CARF should ensure the identification of all Entities and individuals that, by virtue of their activities, are Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers and have a nexus with such jurisdiction. Finally, a jurisdiction should raise awareness of, and promote and enforce compliance with, the CARF.
