items.detail: Commentary on Section V ¶12：稅區應要求 RCASP 保存執行 Section III 盡職審查嘅步驟同所依賴證據，以及就 Section IV 嘅 relevant transaction、crypto-asset 同 relevant crypto-asset 分類嘅紀錄。香港 s.50P(1)(a)(iii) 同 s.50S(1) 有保存要求。

quotes.text: to keep records of the steps undertaken and any evidence relied upon for the performance of the due diligence procedures set out in Section III, as well as for the classification of Relevant Transactions, Crypto-Assets and Relevant Crypto-Assets set out in Section IV.

options: 就 relevant transaction、crypto-asset 同 relevant crypto-asset 分類所採取嘅步驟同證據
items.explain: Commentary on Section V ¶12：稅區應要求 RCASP 保存執行 Section III 盡職審查嘅步驟同所依賴證據，以及就 Section IV 嘅 relevant transaction、crypto-asset 同 relevant crypto-asset 分類嘅紀錄。香港 s.50P(1)(a)(iii) 同 s.50S(1) 有保存要求。

items.title: OECD Commentary 期望稅區喺核實 RCASP 合規方面首先做咩？
items.short: 指定一個或多個有權核實 RCASP 合規嘅行政機關（例如稅局或金融監管機構），…
items.detail: Commentary on Section V ¶11：第一步係指定一個或多個行政機關（例如稅局或金融監管機構）有權核實 RCASP 合規，並確保資源充足；可以考慮依賴其他部門或第三方，但本地當局仍要負責。香港由 IRD（Commissioner／assessor）負責，見 s.51B、51BB 等。

quotes.text: As an initial step, jurisdictions should designate one or more administrative bodies (e.g. a tax authority or financial supervisor), with the power to verify the compliance of Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers with the due diligence and reporting obligations in such jurisdiction.

options: 外判俾私人公司並唔再負責
指定一個或多個有權核實 RCASP 合規嘅行政機關（例如稅局或金融監管機構），並提供足夠資源
items.explain: Commentary on Section V ¶11：第一步係指定一個或多個行政機關（例如稅局或金融監管機構）有權核實 RCASP 合規，並確保資源充足；可以考慮依賴其他部門或第三方，但本地當局仍要負責。香港由 IRD（Commissioner／assessor）負責，見 s.51B、51BB 等。

items.title: HKRCASP 搬咗辦公室，冇合理辯解冇喺 1 個月內通知 Commissioner（s.50S(3)）。法律後果？
items.short: 屬 s.80R(1)(a)(iv) 罪行，定罪可處第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令…
items.detail: s.80R(1)(a)(iv)：HKRCASP 冇合理辯解唔遵守 s.50S(1)、(3) 或 (5) 屬犯罪。s.80R(3)：定罪可處第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令喺指明時間內做返未做嘅事。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP commits an offence if the HKRCASP, without reasonable excuse— (a) fails to comply with a requirement under— (i) section 50O(1); (ii) section 50P(1) or (2); (iii) section 50Q(1); or (iv) section 50S(1), (3) or (5); (b) fails to comply with a requirement under section 50S(12); (c) fails to comply with a requirement of a notice given to the HKRCASP under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6); or (d) obstructs or hinders an assessor in the exercise of the powers under section 51BB(2).

An HKRCASP that commits an offence under subsection (1) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3, and the court may order the HKRCASP, within the time specified in the order— (a) (for subsection (1)(a), (b) or (c)) to do the act that the HKRCASP has failed to do; or (b) (for subsection (1)(d)) to allow and facilitate an assessor to exercise the powers under section 51BB(2).

options: 即時吊銷 CARF 登記
屬 s.80R(1)(a)(iv) 罪行，定罪可處第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令佢補做
items.explain: s.80R(1)(a)(iv)：HKRCASP 冇合理辯解唔遵守 s.50S(1)、(3) 或 (5) 屬犯罪。s.80R(3)：定罪可處第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令喺指明時間內做返未做嘅事。

items.title: HKRCASP 收到 s.50S(11) 資料要求通知，冇合理辯解唔回覆。係咪罪行？
items.short: 係：唔遵守 s.50S(12) 要求屬 s.80R(1)(b) 罪行
items.detail: s.80R(1)(b)：HKRCASP 冇合理辯解唔遵守 s.50S(12) 嘅要求（即按 s.50S(11) 通知提供資料）屬犯罪；s.80R(3)：第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令補做。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP commits an offence if the HKRCASP, without reasonable excuse— (a) fails to comply with a requirement under— (i) section 50O(1); (ii) section 50P(1) or (2); (iii) section 50Q(1); or (iv) section 50S(1), (3) or (5); (b) fails to comply with a requirement under section 50S(12); (c) fails to comply with a requirement of a notice given to the HKRCASP under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6); or (d) obstructs or hinders an assessor in the exercise of the powers under section 51BB(2).

An HKRCASP that commits an offence under subsection (1) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3, and the court may order the HKRCASP, within the time specified in the order— (a) (for subsection (1)(a), (b) or (c)) to do the act that the HKRCASP has failed to do; or (b) (for subsection (1)(d)) to allow and facilitate an assessor to exercise the powers under section 51BB(2).

option_explains: 錯：(1)(b) 唔需要詐騙意圖。
options: 係：唔遵守 s.50S(12) 要求屬 s.80R(1)(b) 罪行
唔係，資料要求只係自願
只有涉及詐騙先係罪行
items.explain: s.80R(1)(b)：HKRCASP 冇合理辯解唔遵守 s.50S(12) 嘅要求（即按 s.50S(11) 通知提供資料）屬犯罪；s.80R(3)：第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令補做。

items.title: Assessor 根據 s.51BB(6) 發通知要 HKRCASP 糾正合規系統，HKRCASP 冇合理辯解冇做，被定罪後仍然冇做。仲有咩額外罰則？
items.short: 定罪後罪行持續期間每日（或不足一日）再罰 $500
items.detail: s.80R(1)(c)：唔遵守 s.51B(1AAAD) 或 s.51BB(6) 通知屬犯罪。s.80R(4)(c)：定罪後罪行持續，每日或不足一日再罰 $500。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP commits an offence if the HKRCASP, without reasonable excuse— (a) fails to comply with a requirement under— (i) section 50O(1); (ii) section 50P(1) or (2); (iii) section 50Q(1); or (iv) section 50S(1), (3) or (5); (b) fails to comply with a requirement under section 50S(12); (c) fails to comply with a requirement of a notice given to the HKRCASP under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6); or (d) obstructs or hinders an assessor in the exercise of the powers under section 51BB(2).

In the case of an offence under— (a) subsection (1)(a)(i) for failing to comply with section 50O(1); (b) subsection (1)(a)(iii) for contravening section 50Q(1); or (c) subsection (1)(c) for failing to comply with a notice given under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6), the HKRCASP is liable to a further fine of $500 for every day or part of a day during which the offence continues after conviction.

options: 定罪後罪行持續期間每日（或不足一日）再罰 $500
items.explain: s.80R(1)(c)：唔遵守 s.51B(1AAAD) 或 s.51BB(6) 通知屬犯罪。s.80R(4)(c)：定罪後罪行持續，每日或不足一日再罰 $500。

items.title: Assessor 按 s.51BB 發通知入 HKRCASP 處所檢查，HKRCASP 職員故意鎖門唔俾入。HKRCASP 會面對咩？
items.short: 屬 s.80R(1)(d) 罪行（阻撓 assessor），第 3 級罰款，法…
items.detail: s.80R(1)(d)：HKRCASP 冇合理辯解阻撓或妨礙 assessor 行使 s.51BB(2) 權力屬犯罪。s.80R(3)(b)：法庭可以命令佢喺指明時間內允許並協助 assessor 行使權力。s.51BB(5)：7 日通知要列明 s.80R(1)(d) 嘅後果。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP commits an offence if the HKRCASP, without reasonable excuse— (a) fails to comply with a requirement under— (i) section 50O(1); (ii) section 50P(1) or (2); (iii) section 50Q(1); or (iv) section 50S(1), (3) or (5); (b) fails to comply with a requirement under section 50S(12); (c) fails to comply with a requirement of a notice given to the HKRCASP under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6); or (d) obstructs or hinders an assessor in the exercise of the powers under section 51BB(2).

An HKRCASP that commits an offence under subsection (1) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3, and the court may order the HKRCASP, within the time specified in the order— (a) (for subsection (1)(a), (b) or (c)) to do the act that the HKRCASP has failed to do; or (b) (for subsection (1)(d)) to allow and facilitate an assessor to exercise the powers under section 51BB(2).

options: 屬 s.80R(1)(d) 罪行（阻撓 assessor），第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令佢允許並協助 assessor 行使權力
items.explain: s.80R(1)(d)：HKRCASP 冇合理辯解阻撓或妨礙 assessor 行使 s.51BB(2) 權力屬犯罪。s.80R(3)(b)：法庭可以命令佢喺指明時間內允許並協助 assessor 行使權力。s.51BB(5)：7 日通知要列明 s.80R(1)(d) 嘅後果。

items.title: 以下邊項罪行，定罪後「冇」s.80R(4) 每日 $500 持續罰款？
items.short: 唔做盡職審查（s.50P(1) 或 (2)）
items.detail: s.80R(4)：持續罰款只適用於 (a) 唔遵守 s.50O(1)；(b) 違反 s.50Q(1)；(c) 唔遵守 s.51B(1AAAD) 或 51BB(6) 通知。s.50P 盡職審查罪行（s.80R(1)(a)(ii)）改用 s.80R(5)：第 3 級或 $1,000 × 涉及人數，以較高者為準。

quotes.text: In the case of an offence under— (a) subsection (1)(a)(i) for failing to comply with section 50O(1); (b) subsection (1)(a)(iii) for contravening section 50Q(1); or (c) subsection (1)(c) for failing to comply with a notice given under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6), the HKRCASP is liable to a further fine of $500 for every day or part of a day during which the offence continues after conviction.

In the case of an offence under subsection (1)(a)(ii), despite the fine prescribed in subsection (3), the HKRCASP is liable on conviction to— (a) a fine at level 3; or (b) a fine of $1,000 multiplied by the number of the crypto-asset users and the controlling persons of the users who are the subjects of the offence, whichever is the higher.

option_explains: 啱：s.80R(4) 冇包括 (1)(a)(ii)；佢適用 s.80R(5) 按人數計罰款。
items.explain: s.80R(4)：持續罰款只適用於 (a) 唔遵守 s.50O(1)；(b) 違反 s.50Q(1)；(c) 唔遵守 s.51B(1AAAD) 或 51BB(6) 通知。s.50P 盡職審查罪行（s.80R(1)(a)(ii)）改用 s.80R(5)：第 3 級或 $1,000 × 涉及人數，以較高者為準。

items.title: HKRCASP 冇合理辯解，喺回覆 assessor 嘅 s.50S(11) 查詢時（唔係報表）提供咗重要事項上唔完整嘅資料，冇欺詐意圖。屬咩罪行？
items.short: s.80R(7)(b)：以其他方式提供同 Part 8B 責任有關、重要事項上…
items.detail: s.80R(7)：HKRCASP 冇合理辯解 (a) 喺報表提供；或 (b)「otherwise provides any information, or makes any statement, that relates to the HKRCASP’s obligations under Part 8B」而重要事項上不正確或不完整，屬犯罪；罰則見 s.80R(8)（第 3 級或 $1,000 × 涉及人數，以較高者為準）。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP commits an offence if the HKRCASP, without reasonable excuse— (a) in purported compliance with section 50Q(1), provides any information in a return that is incorrect or incomplete in a material particular; or (b) otherwise provides any information, or makes any statement, that relates to the HKRCASP’s obligations under Part 8B and that is incorrect or incomplete in a material particular.

options: 唔屬罪行，因為唔係報表
s.80R(7)(b)：以其他方式提供同 Part 8B 責任有關、重要事項上不正確或不完整嘅資料
items.explain: s.80R(7)：HKRCASP 冇合理辯解 (a) 喺報表提供；或 (b)「otherwise provides any information, or makes any statement, that relates to the HKRCASP’s obligations under Part 8B」而重要事項上不正確或不完整，屬犯罪；罰則見 s.80R(8)（第 3 級或 $1,000 × 涉及人數，以較高者為準）。

items.title: HKRCASP 未有核實就照抄第三方數據入報表，結果資料重要事項上有誤導。佢唔係明知，亦唔算罔顧，但冇合理理由相信資料真確。會唔會犯 s.80R(9)？
items.short: 會：冇合理理由相信資料真確或準確，都符合 s.80R(9)(c)；可處第 4 …
items.detail: s.80R(9)：提供重要事項上誤導、虛假或不準確嘅資料，而 HKRCASP (a) 明知；(b) 罔顧；或 (c)「has no reasonable ground to believe that the information or statement is true or accurate」，屬犯罪。s.80R(10)：第 4 級罰款或 $5,000 × 涉及 users 同 CP 數目，以較高者為準。

quotes.text: and the HKRCASP— (a) knows the information or statement is misleading, false or inaccurate in the material particular; (b) is reckless as to whether the information or statement is misleading, false or inaccurate in the material particular; or (c) has no reasonable ground to believe that the information or statement is true or accurate in the material particular.

An HKRCASP that commits an offence under subsection (9) is liable on conviction to— (a) a fine at level 4; or (b) a fine of $5,000 multiplied by the number of the crypto-asset users and the controlling persons of the users who are the subjects of the offence, whichever is the higher.

option_explains: 錯：(9)(c) 涵蓋冇合理理由相信。
options: 只會犯 s.80R(13) 詐騙罪
會：冇合理理由相信資料真確或準確，都符合 s.80R(9)(c)；可處第 4 級罰款或 $5,000 × 涉及人數，以較高者為準
items.explain: s.80R(9)：提供重要事項上誤導、虛假或不準確嘅資料，而 HKRCASP (a) 明知；(b) 罔顧；或 (c)「has no reasonable ground to believe that the information or statement is true or accurate」，屬犯罪。s.80R(10)：第 4 級罰款或 $5,000 × 涉及 users 同 CP 數目，以較高者為準。

items.title: 控方揀喺裁判法院以簡易程序起訴一宗 HKRCASP 詐騙申報案（s.80R(13)）。法庭最多可以判咩？
items.short: 第 5 級罰款或 $10,000 × 涉及人數（以較高者為準），以及監禁 6 …
items.detail: s.80R(14)(a)：簡易程序定罪，罰款為第 5 級或 $10,000 × 涉及 users 同 CP 數目（以較高者為準），以及監禁 6 個月。公訴程序見 s.80R(14)(b)：第 6 級或 $20,000 × 人數，以及監禁 3 年。

quotes.text: on summary conviction— (i) to the following fine— (A) a fine at level 5; or (B) a fine of $10,000 multiplied by the number of the crypto-asset users and the controlling persons of the users who are the subjects of the offence, whichever is the higher; and (ii) to imprisonment for 6 months;

options: 第 5 級罰款或 $10,000 × 涉及人數（以較高者為準），以及監禁 6 個月
第 6 級罰款或 $20,000 × 人數，以及監禁 3 年
items.explain: s.80R(14)(a)：簡易程序定罪，罰款為第 5 級或 $10,000 × 涉及 users 同 CP 數目（以較高者為準），以及監禁 6 個月。公訴程序見 s.80R(14)(b)：第 6 級或 $20,000 × 人數，以及監禁 3 年。

items.title: 一個非法團合夥 HKRCASP 冇登記。s.80R 罪行責任落喺邊個身上？
items.short: 代 HKRCASP 同其 crypto-asset users 維持關係嘅人
items.detail: s.80R(15)：就屬實體但唔係法團嘅 HKRCASP，s.80R 適用於代 HKRCASP 同其 crypto-asset users 維持關係嘅人，猶如對 HKRCASP 嘅提述係指該人。同 s.50T 一致。

quotes.text: In relation to an HKRCASP that is an entity but not a corporation, this section applies to a person who acts for the HKRCASP to maintain a relationship with its crypto-asset users as if the references to an HKRCASP were references to that person.

options: 冇人，因為合夥唔係法團
代 HKRCASP 同其 crypto-asset users 維持關係嘅人
items.explain: s.80R(15)：就屬實體但唔係法團嘅 HKRCASP，s.80R 適用於代 HKRCASP 同其 crypto-asset users 維持關係嘅人，猶如對 HKRCASP 嘅提述係指該人。同 s.50T 一致。

items.title: s.80S（HKRCASP 僱員等嘅詐騙罪）適用於以下邊類人？
items.short: HKRCASP 僱員、以服務提供者以外身份受聘為 HKRCASP 工作嘅人、或…
items.detail: s.80S(1)：適用於 (a) HKRCASP 僱員（或非法團 HKRCASP 嘅受僱人）；(b) 以服務提供者以外方式受聘為 HKRCASP 工作嘅人；(c) 參與管理 HKRCASP 嘅人。服務提供者嘅詐騙罪另見 s.80V(8)。

quotes.text: Subsection (2) applies to a person who— (a) is an employee of an HKRCASP or, as the case requires, an individual employed as an employee in respect of an HKRCASP that is not a corporation; (b) is engaged to work for an HKRCASP otherwise than as a service provider; or (c) is concerned in the management of an HKRCASP.

option_explains: 錯：客戶唔喺 s.80S 範圍。
options: HKRCASP 僱員、以服務提供者以外身份受聘為 HKRCASP 工作嘅人、或參與管理 HKRCASP 嘅人
items.explain: s.80S(1)：適用於 (a) HKRCASP 僱員（或非法團 HKRCASP 嘅受僱人）；(b) 以服務提供者以外方式受聘為 HKRCASP 工作嘅人；(c) 參與管理 HKRCASP 嘅人。服務提供者嘅詐騙罪另見 s.80V(8)。

items.title: HKRCASP 嘅合約員工意圖詐騙，令 HKRCASP 喺報表提供虛假資料，經簡易程序定罪。最高刑罰係？
items.short: 第 3 級罰款及監禁 6 個月
items.detail: s.80S(3)：(a) 簡易程序定罪：第 3 級罰款及監禁 6 個月；(b) 公訴程序定罪：第 5 級罰款及監禁 3 年。（QCB-021 處理公訴程序情況。）

quotes.text: A person who commits an offence under subsection (2) is liable— (a) on summary conviction— (i) to a fine at level 3; and (ii) to imprisonment for 6 months; or (b) on conviction on indictment— (i) to a fine at level 5; and (ii) to imprisonment for 3 years.

Subsection (2) applies to a person who— (a) is an employee of an HKRCASP or, as the case requires, an individual employed as an employee in respect of an HKRCASP that is not a corporation; (b) is engaged to work for an HKRCASP otherwise than as a service provider; or (c) is concerned in the management of an HKRCASP.

options: 第 3 級罰款及監禁 6 個月
第 5 級罰款及監禁 3 年
items.explain: s.80S(3)：(a) 簡易程序定罪：第 3 級罰款及監禁 6 個月；(b) 公訴程序定罪：第 5 級罰款及監禁 3 年。（QCB-021 處理公訴程序情況。）

items.title: 公司已通知 IRD 停止做 HKRCASP，之後搬咗地址，冇合理辯解冇喺 1 個月內通知（s.50S(6)(a)）。屬咩罪行？
items.short: s.80T(1)：前 HKRCASP 唔遵守 s.50S(6)，第 3 級罰款…
items.detail: s.80T(1)：曾經係 HKRCASP 嘅個人或實體，冇合理辯解唔遵守 s.50S(4) 或 (6) 或 s.50S(12) 要求，屬犯罪。s.80T(2)：第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令喺指明時間內補做。

quotes.text: An individual or entity that was an HKRCASP commits an offence if the individual or entity, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with section 50S(4) or (6) or a requirement under section 50S(12). (2) An individual or entity that commits an offence under subsection (1) for failing to do an act is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3, and the court may order the individual or entity to do the act within the time specified in the order.

options: 唔屬罪行，已經唔係 HKRCASP
s.80T(1)：前 HKRCASP 唔遵守 s.50S(6)，第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令補做
items.explain: s.80T(1)：曾經係 HKRCASP 嘅個人或實體，冇合理辯解唔遵守 s.50S(4) 或 (6) 或 s.50S(12) 要求，屬犯罪。s.80T(2)：第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令喺指明時間內補做。

items.title: 前 HKRCASP 因冇交停止通知被定罪，法庭命令佢 14 日內補交，佢仍然冇交。後果？
items.short: 唔遵守法庭命令另屬犯罪，可處第 4 級罰款
items.detail: s.80T(3)：個人或實體唔遵守 s.80T(2) 下法庭命令屬犯罪，定罪可處第 4 級罰款。（HKRCASP 唔遵守 s.80R(3) 命令見 s.80R(6)。）

quotes.text: An individual or entity commits an offence if the individual or entity does not comply with an order of the court under subsection (2), and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 4.

An individual or entity that was an HKRCASP commits an offence if the individual or entity, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with section 50S(4) or (6) or a requirement under section 50S(12). (2) An individual or entity that commits an offence under subsection (1) for failing to do an act is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3, and the court may order the individual or entity to do the act within the time specified in the order.

options: 唔遵守法庭命令另屬犯罪，可處第 4 級罰款

items.title: 已解散前 HKRCASP 嘅 specified officer 改咗聯絡資料，冇合理辯解冇喺 1 個月內通知（s.50S(8)）。屬咩罪行？
items.short: s.80U(1)：specified officer 唔遵守 s.50S(8)
items.detail: s.80U(1)：s.50S(20) 所指嘅 specified officer 或 designated officer，冇合理辯解唔遵守 s.50S(7) 或 (8) 或 s.50S(12) 要求，屬犯罪；s.80U(2)：第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令補做。亦可以按 s.82G 以金錢罰則代替檢控。

quotes.text: A person who is a specified officer, or a designated officer, as defined by section 50S(20) commits an offence if the person, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with section 50S(7) or (8) or a requirement under section 50S(12).

option_explains: 錯：s.80U 專門針對解散後責任。
items.explain: s.80U(1)：s.50S(20) 所指嘅 specified officer 或 designated officer，冇合理辯解唔遵守 s.50S(7) 或 (8) 或 s.50S(12) 要求，屬犯罪；s.80U(2)：第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令補做。亦可以按 s.82G 以金錢罰則代替檢控。

items.title: Specified officer A 被控冇遵守 s.50S(7)(a)（解散通知）。佢有合理理由相信、亦確實相信另一位稱職可靠嘅董事 B 負責並有能力處理。A 可唔可以以此作為合理辯解？
items.short: 可以：證明佢有合理理由相信並確實相信另一位稱職可靠嘅人負責並有能力履行該責任，…
items.detail: s.80U(4)(a)：被控唔遵守 s.50S(7)(a)、(b)、(8) 或 s.50S(12) 要求，可以證明佢有合理理由相信並確實相信另一位稱職可靠嘅人 (i) 負責確保遵守；(ii) 有能力履行該責任，就當已確立合理辯解。s.82G(10) 對金錢罰則有相同辯解。另外 s.50S(9)：任何一位交咗解散通知，當作全部已交。

quotes.text: the person had reasonable grounds to believe, and did believe, that a competent and reliable person other than the person— (i) was charged with the duty of ensuring that the section or requirement, as the case may be, was complied with; and (ii) was in a position to discharge that duty; or

options: 唔可以，每人都要親自做
可以：證明佢有合理理由相信並確實相信另一位稱職可靠嘅人負責並有能力履行該責任，就當已確立合理辯解
items.explain: s.80U(4)(a)：被控唔遵守 s.50S(7)(a)、(b)、(8) 或 s.50S(12) 要求，可以證明佢有合理理由相信並確實相信另一位稱職可靠嘅人 (i) 負責確保遵守；(ii) 有能力履行該責任，就當已確立合理辯解。s.82G(10) 對金錢罰則有相同辯解。另外 s.50S(9)：任何一位交咗解散通知，當作全部已交。

items.title: Specified officer 被控冇遵守 s.50S(7)(b)（解散後保存紀錄），但相關紀錄其實按另一條例已經要由清盤人保存。佢有冇合理辯解？
items.short: 有：s.50S(1) 紀錄按其他條例須由另一人保存，就當已確立合理辯解
items.detail: s.80U(4)(b)：被控唔遵守 s.50S(7)(b) 或 s.50S(12) 要求，如果「the records mentioned in section 50S(1) are otherwise required to be kept by another person under any other Ordinance」，就當已確立合理辯解。

quotes.text: if the person is charged with an offence under subsection (1) for failing to comply with section 50S(7)(b) or a requirement under section 50S(12)—the records mentioned in section 50S(1) are otherwise required to be kept by another person under any other Ordinance.

options: 冇，CARF 紀錄一定要自己保存
要 IRD 書面批准先算

items.title: 服務商受聘履行 HKRCASP 嘅 s.50P(1) 責任，冇合理辯解冇將 Sch 17EA 盡職審查要求納入程序。服務商本身有冇刑事責任？
items.short: 有：屬 s.80V(2) 罪行，可處第 3 級罰款
items.detail: s.80V(2)：受聘履行 s.50P(1) 責任嘅服務商，冇合理辯解 (a) 冇建立 s.50P(1)(a) 程序；或 (b) 冇納入 Sch 17EA 要求，屬犯罪。s.80V(7)：第 3 級罰款。HKRCASP 本身亦唔會因委聘服務商而免責（s.50U(2)、s.80R(2)）。

quotes.text: A person who is a service provider engaged to carry out an HKRCASP’s obligations under section 50P(1) commits an offence if the person, without reasonable excuse, fails to— (a) establish the procedures described in section 50P(1)(a); or (b) incorporate into those procedures the due diligence requirements in Schedule 17EA.

A person who is a service provider commits an offence if the person, without reasonable excuse— (a) fails to comply with a requirement of a notice given to the person under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6); or (b) obstructs or hinders an assessor in the exercise of the powers under section 51BB(2). (7) A person who commits an offence under subsection (1), (2), (3), (4), (5) or (6) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3.

options: 有：屬 s.80V(2) 罪行，可處第 3 級罰款
items.explain: s.80V(2)：受聘履行 s.50P(1) 責任嘅服務商，冇合理辯解 (a) 冇建立 s.50P(1)(a) 程序；或 (b) 冇納入 Sch 17EA 要求，屬犯罪。s.80V(7)：第 3 級罰款。HKRCASP 本身亦唔會因委聘服務商而免責（s.50U(2)、s.80R(2)）。

items.title: 服務商受聘代 HKRCASP 交 CARF 報表（s.50Q(1)），冇合理辯解冇交。服務商點？
items.short: 屬 s.80V(4) 罪行（冇促使報表按規定提交），第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命…
items.detail: s.80V(4)：受聘履行 s.50Q(1) 責任嘅服務商，冇合理辯解冇促使報表按規定提交，屬犯罪；s.80V(7)：第 3 級罰款；s.80V(10)：法庭可以命令補做。HKRCASP 本身亦可能犯 s.80R(1)(a)(iii)。

quotes.text: A person who is a service provider engaged to carry out an HKRCASP’s obligations under section 50Q(1) commits an offence if the person, without reasonable excuse, fails to cause a return to be furnished as required by that section.

The court may order a service provider that commits an offence under subsection (1), (2), (3), (4) or (6), within the time specified in the order— (a) (for subsection (1), (2), (3), (4) or (6)(a)) to do the act that the service provider has failed to do; or (b) (for subsection (6)(b)) to allow and facilitate an assessor to exercise the powers under section 51BB(2). (11) A service provider commits an offence if the service provider does not comply with an order of the court under subsection (10), and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 4.

option_explains: 錯：嗰個係詐騙罪公訴程序。
options: 屬 s.80V(4) 罪行（冇促使報表按規定提交），第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令補做
items.explain: s.80V(4)：受聘履行 s.50Q(1) 責任嘅服務商，冇合理辯解冇促使報表按規定提交，屬犯罪；s.80V(7)：第 3 級罰款；s.80V(10)：法庭可以命令補做。HKRCASP 本身亦可能犯 s.80R(1)(a)(iii)。

items.title: 服務商冇按 HKRCASP 指示，自行代 HKRCASP 向 IRD 作出同 Part 8B 責任有關、重要事項上誤導嘅陳述，而且罔顧真偽。服務商係咪犯罪？
items.short: 係：屬 s.80V(5)(b) 罪行
items.detail: s.80V(5)(b)：服務商代 HKRCASP、唔按 HKRCASP 指示提供同 Part 8B 責任有關嘅資料或陳述，而資料重要事項上誤導、虛假或不準確，並且服務商明知、罔顧或冇合理理由相信其真確，屬犯罪；s.80V(7)：第 3 級罰款。

quotes.text: the person otherwise provides any information, or makes any statement, that relates to the HKRCASP’s obligations under Part 8B on behalf of the HKRCASP not in accordance with the instruction given by the HKRCASP to the person (or causes or allows the HKRCASP to otherwise provide or make such information or statement) where the information or statement is misleading, false or inaccurate in a material particular,

option_explains: 錯：明知、罔顧或冇合理理由相信都得。
options: 唔係，只有 HKRCASP 會犯罪
只有有欺詐意圖先犯罪
items.explain: s.80V(5)(b)：服務商代 HKRCASP、唔按 HKRCASP 指示提供同 Part 8B 責任有關嘅資料或陳述，而資料重要事項上誤導、虛假或不準確，並且服務商明知、罔顧或冇合理理由相信其真確，屬犯罪；s.80V(7)：第 3 級罰款。

items.title: 服務商代 HKRCASP 交咗報表後，發現資料有錯，但冇合理辯解冇喺合理時間內通知 Commissioner。服務商點？
items.short: 屬 s.80V(5)(c) 罪行，第 3 級罰款
items.detail: s.80V(5)(c)：服務商提交報表或提供資料後，發現誤導、虛假或不準確，而冇合理辯解冇喺合理時間內通知 Commissioner，屬犯罪；s.80V(7)：第 3 級罰款。（HKRCASP 自己嘅相應罪行見 s.80R(11)。）

quotes.text: the person, after furnishing a return in purported compliance with section 50Q(1), or otherwise providing any information, or making any statement, that relates to the HKRCASP’s obligations under Part 8B— (i) discovers that the return, information or statement is misleading, false or inaccurate; and (ii) without reasonable excuse, fails to notify the Commissioner of the discovery within a reasonable time.

A person who is a service provider commits an offence if the person, without reasonable excuse— (a) fails to comply with a requirement of a notice given to the person under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6); or (b) obstructs or hinders an assessor in the exercise of the powers under section 51BB(2). (7) A person who commits an offence under subsection (1), (2), (3), (4), (5) or (6) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3.

option_explains: 錯：要喺合理時間內通知。
options: 屬 s.80V(5)(c) 罪行，第 3 級罰款
冇責任，報表係 HKRCASP 嘅
items.explain: s.80V(5)(c)：服務商提交報表或提供資料後，發現誤導、虛假或不準確，而冇合理辯解冇喺合理時間內通知 Commissioner，屬犯罪；s.80V(7)：第 3 級罰款。（HKRCASP 自己嘅相應罪行見 s.80R(11)。）

items.title: Assessor 按 s.51BB 入服務商處所檢查，服務商阻撓。法律後果？
items.short: 屬 s.80V(6)(b) 罪行，第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令佢允許並協助 a…
items.detail: s.80V(6)：服務商冇合理辯解 (a) 唔遵守 s.51B(1AAAD) 或 51BB(6) 通知；或 (b) 阻撓 assessor 行使 s.51BB(2) 權力，屬犯罪；s.80V(7)：第 3 級罰款；s.80V(10)(b)：法庭可以命令允許並協助 assessor。

quotes.text: A person who is a service provider commits an offence if the person, without reasonable excuse— (a) fails to comply with a requirement of a notice given to the person under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6); or (b) obstructs or hinders an assessor in the exercise of the powers under section 51BB(2). (7) A person who commits an offence under subsection (1), (2), (3), (4), (5) or (6) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3.

The court may order a service provider that commits an offence under subsection (1), (2), (3), (4) or (6), within the time specified in the order— (a) (for subsection (1), (2), (3), (4) or (6)(a)) to do the act that the service provider has failed to do; or (b) (for subsection (6)(b)) to allow and facilitate an assessor to exercise the powers under section 51BB(2). (11) A service provider commits an offence if the service provider does not comply with an order of the court under subsection (10), and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 4.

options: 冇後果，服務商唔受 s.51BB 規管
屬 s.80V(6)(b) 罪行，第 3 級罰款，法庭可以命令佢允許並協助 assessor
items.explain: s.80V(6)：服務商冇合理辯解 (a) 唔遵守 s.51B(1AAAD) 或 51BB(6) 通知；或 (b) 阻撓 assessor 行使 s.51BB(2) 權力，屬犯罪；s.80V(7)：第 3 級罰款；s.80V(10)(b)：法庭可以命令允許並協助 assessor。

items.title: 服務商意圖詐騙，促使 HKRCASP 喺報表提供虛假資料（s.80V(8)），經公訴程序定罪最高刑罰係？
items.short: 第 5 級罰款及監禁 3 年
items.detail: s.80V(9)：(a) 簡易程序定罪：第 3 級罰款及監禁 6 個月；(b) 公訴程序定罪：第 5 級罰款及監禁 3 年。HKRCASP 自己嘅詐騙罪（s.80R(14)）另有按人數計嘅罰款。

quotes.text: A person who commits an offence under subsection (8) is liable— (a) on summary conviction— (i) to a fine at level 3; and (ii) to imprisonment for 6 months; or (b) on conviction on indictment— (i) to a fine at level 5; and (ii) to imprisonment for 3 years.

option_explains: 錯：呢個係 HKRCASP 嘅 s.80R(14)(b)。
options: 第 6 級罰款或 $20,000 × 人數及監禁 3 年
第 5 級罰款及監禁 3 年
items.explain: s.80V(9)：(a) 簡易程序定罪：第 3 級罰款及監禁 6 個月；(b) 公訴程序定罪：第 5 級罰款及監禁 3 年。HKRCASP 自己嘅詐騙罪（s.80R(14)）另有按人數計嘅罰款。

items.title: 法庭命令服務商喺 30 日內促使報表提交，服務商仍然冇做。後果？
items.short: 唔遵守法庭命令另屬犯罪，可處第 4 級罰款

quotes.text: The court may order a service provider that commits an offence under subsection (1), (2), (3), (4) or (6), within the time specified in the order— (a) (for subsection (1), (2), (3), (4) or (6)(a)) to do the act that the service provider has failed to do; or (b) (for subsection (6)(b)) to allow and facilitate an assessor to exercise the powers under section 51BB(2). (11) A service provider commits an offence if the service provider does not comply with an order of the court under subsection (10), and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 4.

that an HKRCASP or a service provider of an HKRCASP (if any) has failed to comply with an order of a court made under section 80R(3)(a) or 80V(10)(a) directing the HKRCASP or the service provider (if any) to comply with a requirement under section 50Q(1);

options: 唔遵守法庭命令另屬犯罪，可處第 4 級罰款
自動轉由 IRD 代交

items.title: 服務商（法團）犯 s.80V 罪行，係因為其董事縱容（connivance）。董事本人點？
items.short: 董事亦犯同一罪行，可處該罪行嘅罰則
items.detail: s.80W：如果法團（包括犯 s.80V(1)–(6)、(8) 或 (11) 罪行嘅服務商）嘅罪行係得到董事或參與管理嘅高級人員同意或縱容而犯，該人亦犯該罪行，並可處相同罰則。（QCB-024 處理 HKRCASP 董事同意嘅情況。）

quotes.text: a service provider that commits an offence under section 80V(1), (2), (3), (4), (5), (6), (8) or (11); and

the offence was committed with the consent or connivance of a director, or other officer concerned in the management, of the corporation or any person purporting to act as such director or officer (that person), the director or officer or that person, as the case requires, also commits the offence and is liable on conviction to the penalty provided for that offence.

option_explains: 錯：consent 或 connivance 都得。
options: 董事亦犯同一罪行，可處該罪行嘅罰則
只有同意（consent）先有責任，縱容唔算
items.explain: s.80W：如果法團（包括犯 s.80V(1)–(6)、(8) 或 (11) 罪行嘅服務商）嘅罪行係得到董事或參與管理嘅高級人員同意或縱容而犯，該人亦犯該罪行，並可處相同罰則。（QCB-024 處理 HKRCASP 董事同意嘅情況。）

items.title: HKRCASP 發現已交報表有錯，冇合理辯解冇喺合理時間內通知 Commissioner，IRD 未有檢控。Commissioner 可唔可以用 s.82E 金錢罰則處理？
items.short: 可以：s.82E(1)(a)(vi) 包括冇喺合理時間內通知發現錯誤
items.detail: s.82E(1)(a)：金錢罰則涵蓋 HKRCASP 冇合理辯解 (i) 唔登記；(ii) 唔做盡職審查；(iii) 唔交報表；(iv)、(v) 提供不正確或不完整資料；(vi) 冇喺合理時間內通知發現誤導、虛假或不準確資料；條件係 (b) 未就相同事實提出 s.80R 檢控。

quotes.text: fails to notify the Commissioner of discovery of misleading, false or inaccurate information in a return furnished under section 50Q(1), or in any information otherwise provided, or any statement made, that relates to the HKRCASP’s obligations under Part 8B, within a reasonable time; and (b) no prosecution for an offence under section 80R has been instituted in respect of the same facts

option_explains: 錯：s.82E 係代替檢控嘅選擇。
options: 唔可以，s.82E 只限唔登記
可以：s.82E(1)(a)(vi) 包括冇喺合理時間內通知發現錯誤
items.explain: s.82E(1)(a)：金錢罰則涵蓋 HKRCASP 冇合理辯解 (i) 唔登記；(ii) 唔做盡職審查；(iii) 唔交報表；(iv)、(v) 提供不正確或不完整資料；(vi) 冇喺合理時間內通知發現誤導、虛假或不準確資料；條件係 (b) 未就相同事實提出 s.80R 檢控。

items.title: IRD 已經就 HKRCASP 唔交報表提出 s.80R 檢控。之後 Commissioner 可唔可以改為就相同事實評定 s.82E 金錢罰則？
items.short: 唔可以：s.82E 只適用於未就相同事實提出 s.80R 檢控嘅情況
items.detail: s.82E(1)(b)：金錢罰則條件之一係「no prosecution for an offence under section 80R has been instituted in respect of the same facts」。反過來，已評定金錢罰則就唔可以再檢控（s.82E(9)，見 B-065）。

items.title: HKRCASP 因負責人重病住院，錯過咗 s.82E 評定通知後 1 個月嘅上訴期限。仲有冇機會上訴？

If an assessment of financial penalty is made in respect of an HKRCASP under section 82E, the HKRCASP may within— (a) 1 month after the notice of assessment is given to the HKRCASP; or (b) the period as extended under subsection (3), lodge, either by the HKRCASP or by an authorized representative, an appeal against the assessment by giving a notice of appeal to the Board of Review in accordance with subsection (2).

items.title: 客戶填 CARF self-cert 時打錯出生年份，純屬無心之失。佢有冇犯 s.80(2ZD)？
items.short: 冇：罪行要求陳述喺重要事項上誤導、虛假或不正確，而且佢明知或罔顧
items.detail: s.80(2ZD)：作出 Sch 17EA 要求 HKRCASP 收集嘅 self-cert 時，(a) 作出重要事項上誤導、虛假或不正確嘅陳述；及 (b) 明知或罔顧，屬犯罪；(2ZE)：第 3 級罰款。無心之失唔符合 (b)；但 HKRCASP 知道錯誤後要按 Sch 17EA 處理。

quotes.text: A person commits an offence if the person, in making a self-certification that is required to be collected under Schedule 17EA by an HKRCASP— (a) makes a statement that is misleading, false or incorrect in a material particular; and (b) knows, or is reckless as to whether, the statement is misleading, false or incorrect in a material particular. (2ZE) A person who commits an offence under subsection (2ZD) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3.

option_explains: 錯：s.80(2ZD) 針對作出 self-cert 嘅人。
options: 冇：罪行要求陳述喺重要事項上誤導、虛假或不正確，而且佢明知或罔顧
items.explain: s.80(2ZD)：作出 Sch 17EA 要求 HKRCASP 收集嘅 self-cert 時，(a) 作出重要事項上誤導、虛假或不正確嘅陳述；及 (b) 明知或罔顧，屬犯罪；(2ZE)：第 3 級罰款。無心之失唔符合 (b)；但 HKRCASP 知道錯誤後要按 Sch 17EA 處理。

items.title: 按 IRD CARF 網頁，部分 RCASP 罪行嘅罰款點樣計算？
items.short: 按定罪後罪行持續日數，或涉及嘅 crypto-asset users 或 co…
items.detail: IRD CARF 網頁：「Penalties for certain offences committed by the RCASPs will be calculated based on the number of days of continuing offence after conviction or the number of crypto-asset users or controlling persons involved」。例如 s.80R(4) 每日 $500；s.80R(5)、(8)、(10)、(14) 按人數計。

quotes.text: Penalties for certain offences committed by the RCASPs will be calculated based on the number of days of continuing offence after conviction or the number of crypto-asset users or controlling persons involved.

In the case of an offence under— (a) subsection (1)(a)(i) for failing to comply with section 50O(1); (b) subsection (1)(a)(iii) for contravening section 50Q(1); or (c) subsection (1)(c) for failing to comply with a notice given under section 51B(1AAAD) or 51BB(6), the HKRCASP is liable to a further fine of $500 for every day or part of a day during which the offence continues after conviction.

option_explains: 錯：唔係 Ord 8 嘅計法。
啱：IRD CARF 網頁 Penalty provisions。
options: 按 RCASP 年度營業額百分比

items.title: HKRCASP 冇合理辯解冇為 3 個 crypto-asset users 做 s.50P 盡職審查。按 s.80R(5)，罰款點計？
items.short: 第 3 級罰款同 $3,000（$1,000 × 3）之間，以較高者為準
items.detail: s.80R(5)：s.80R(1)(a)(ii) 罪行，罰款為 (a) 第 3 級罰款；或 (b) $1,000 × 涉及 users 同 CP 數目，「whichever is the higher」。人數少時通常以第 3 級為準（大量人數例子見 B-056）。

quotes.text: In the case of an offence under subsection (1)(a)(ii), despite the fine prescribed in subsection (3), the HKRCASP is liable on conviction to— (a) a fine at level 3; or (b) a fine of $1,000 multiplied by the number of the crypto-asset users and the controlling persons of the users who are the subjects of the offence, whichever is the higher.

option_explains: 錯：要同第 3 級比較，取較高者。
錯：s.50P 罪行唔適用持續罰款。
